Route correspondence to responsible business unit and legal or compliance lead
Coordinate document retrieval and data compilation to support regulatory response
Draft regulatory response under review by compliance and legal counsel
Obtain required sign-off levels for formal regulatory submissions
Submit regulatory response within statutory deadline and retain proof of submission
Track open regulatory correspondence items through resolution and update status log
Maintain regulatory correspondence archive with searchable index for examination readiness
Produce required statutory notices — cancellation, renewal, adverse action — within mandated timelines
Verify state-specific notice requirements for all outbound regulatory correspondence
Report open regulatory correspondence inventory and deadline compliance to compliance leadership

subProcesses.name: Records Retention & Document Lifecycle Management
steps: Maintain document retention schedule aligned to state regulatory requirements by document type and product line
Apply retention classifications to all documents at time of creation or intake
Monitor document lifecycle and trigger disposition review at end of retention period
Obtain required approval before authorizing destruction of records at retention end
Execute approved document destruction via certified shredding or secure digital purge
Maintain destruction certificates as evidence of compliant record disposal
Process legal hold notifications — identify, preserve, and quarantine records subject to litigation or investigation
Track and report legal hold inventory to legal counsel and compliance
Lift legal holds upon counsel notification and return records to normal retention management
Audit document management system annually for orphaned records, misclassified retention, and access controls
Train operations staff on records retention obligations and document handling procedures
Report retention compliance posture and outstanding disposition approvals to records management committee

subProcesses.name: E-Delivery & Electronic Consent Administration
steps: Manage customer consent enrollment for electronic document delivery per ESIGN Act and state e-delivery laws
Obtain and record affirmative consent with required system capability disclosures before first e-delivery
Maintain e-consent records with consent date, version of disclosures acknowledged, and revocation history
Validate customer email address and portal accessibility before switching delivery to electronic
Monitor e-delivery success rates — bounce rates, undelivered items, and portal access failures
Trigger paper delivery fallback for failed electronic deliveries within required timeframe
Process e-consent revocations and revert affected customers to paper delivery
Apply state-specific e-delivery eligibility restrictions for certain document types
Audit e-consent records annually for completeness and compliance with state e-delivery statutes
Report e-delivery adoption rates, failure rates, and paper fallback volumes to operations management
Update consent processes when e-delivery regulations change in applicable states
Respond to customer inquiries regarding document delivery status and consent preferences

subProcesses.name: 1099-R & Tax Document Administration
steps: Capture and maintain federal and state withholding elections from policyowners and annuitants
Apply withholding rules to taxable distributions — IRA withdrawals, annuity payments, surrenders, and death benefits
Remit withheld federal and state income taxes to IRS and state tax authorities on required schedule
Reconcile tax deposit amounts to withholding ledger and resolve deposit discrepancies
Compile taxable distribution data by contract holder at year end for 1099-R production
Produce 1099-R forms for all reportable distributions with correct distribution codes
File 1099-R information returns with IRS via FIRE system by January 31 deadline
Distribute 1099-R copies to recipients by January 31 statutory deadline
Process 1099-R corrections for calculation errors, incorrect distribution codes, or wrong TIN
Respond to IRS B-Notices and TIN validation failures with required backup withholding implementation
Process tax inquiries from policyowners regarding distribution reporting and withholding amounts
Archive 1099-R records per IRS record-retention requirements and report filing completion to finance

subProcesses.name: Formal Complaint Intake & Acknowledgment
steps: Initiate and capture formal complaint received via direct customer contact, state DOI, or regulatory body
Classify complaint as internal first-party or regulatory DOI-forwarded and apply corresponding SLA
Acknowledge complaint to complainant in writing within statutory or company-defined timeframe
Record complaint in complaint management register with required fields — policy number, coverage line, and reason code
Assign complaint to dedicated consumer affairs specialist based on product and regulatory jurisdiction
Retrieve complete policy, claims, and service history relevant to the complaint
Identify any related open service cases or prior complaints from same customer or policy
Flag complaints involving potential bad faith or litigation risk for legal escalation
Notify legal and compliance of complaints with regulatory or litigation exposure
Confirm receipt of complaint assignment by assigned specialist and establish resolution target date
Enter complaint data into state regulatory complaint tracking system where required
Communicate acknowledgment timeline and next steps to complainant

subProcesses.name: Complaint Investigation & Analysis
steps: Review all policy documents, correspondence, claim files, and service records pertinent to the complaint
Identify the root cause of customer dissatisfaction — service failure, coverage dispute, billing error, or claims handling issue
Interview internal staff involved in the customer interaction or decision under review
Request additional information or documentation from complainant if needed to complete investigation
Assess complaint merits against policy terms, carrier procedures, and applicable state regulations
Evaluate whether company error, miscommunication, or legitimate policy limitation drove the complaint
Determine required resolution action — correction, explanation, goodwill remedy, or denial
Document investigation findings in complaint management system with supporting evidence
Coordinate with claims, underwriting, or billing to resolve underlying issue where applicable
Obtain required management approval for resolution actions above authority thresholds
Draft complaint response letter addressing each element of the complainant's concern
Apply regulatory response standards — clear explanation of rights and avenues for further appeal

subProcesses.name: Complaint Resolution & Response
steps: Finalize resolution determination and confirm required corrective actions are completed
Prepare and dispatch formal written response to complainant within statutory deadline
Address DOI inquiry or complaint in regulatory portal with required case summary and attachments
Issue any financial remedy — premium refund, claim supplement, or goodwill payment
Coordinate corrective action with responsible business unit to prevent recurrence
Communicate resolution outcome clearly to complainant including any remaining obligations or rights
Escalate unresolved or denied complaints through second-tier review if complainant disputes resolution
Record final resolution in complaint register with resolution type, outcome, and close date
Report complaint outcomes to DOI or regulatory body as required by market conduct standards
Notify legal of pending litigation or arbitration referrals arising from unresolved complaints
Confirm regulatory portal case is marked resolved where applicable
Close complaint record and trigger handoff to complaint analytics

subProcesses.name: Complaint Root-Cause Analysis & Corrective Action
steps: Aggregate resolved complaint records and classify by root-cause category — process failure, system error, staff error, or product design
Identify recurring failure patterns across complaint categories using structured cause-and-effect analysis
Prioritize root-cause findings by complaint volume, financial impact, and regulatory exposure
Assign corrective action owners in accountable business units for each systemic failure identified
Design corrective actions targeting root causes — process redesign, system fix, staff retraining, or product clarification
Track corrective action implementation progress against agreed milestones and deadlines
Validate effectiveness of implemented corrective actions through post-implementation complaint monitoring
Escalate unresolved or high-risk root causes to senior operations leadership for intervention
Provide root-cause findings and corrective action status to underwriting, claims, and product management
Document corrective action outcomes and lessons learned in the complaint management system
Report corrective action portfolio and effectiveness metrics to compliance committee
Archive root-cause analysis records per regulatory retention schedule

subProcesses.name: Complaint Analytics & Regulatory Reporting
steps: Aggregate complaint data monthly by product line, coverage type, reason code, and resolution outcome
Calculate complaint ratios per 1,000 in-force policies and compare to prior periods and regulatory benchmarks
Identify top complaint drivers and systemic issues requiring process correction
Prepare quarterly complaint trend report for compliance committee and senior leadership
Respond to state DOI annual complaint data calls with required data in prescribed format
Provide complaint records and resolution documentation to support regulatory examination data requests
Provide complaint pattern analysis to underwriting, claims, and product management for root-cause remediation
Track implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions arising from complaint findings
Maintain complaint register data quality — reason code accuracy, timeliness, and completeness
Benchmark complaint performance against peer carriers using NAIC market conduct annual data
Escalate complaint volume spikes or regulatory threshold breaches to compliance leadership
Archive closed complaint records per regulatory retention schedule

subProcesses.name: Producer Complaint & Suitability Escalation Handling
steps: Identify complaints implicating producer conduct — misrepresentation, churning, suitability failure, or unauthorized changes
Separate producer-conduct complaints from product or service complaints for specialized handling
Notify producer supervisory function and distribution management of producer-implicated complaints
Compile producer appointment records, sales activity, and prior complaint history for investigation
Evaluate whether producer conduct complaint requires regulatory self-reporting to state DOI or FINRA
Coordinate investigation findings with distribution compliance and legal for disciplinary review
Suspend producer transaction authority during active investigation if warranted by severity
Issue appropriate producer corrective action — retraining, increased supervision, or appointment termination
File required regulatory notifications for terminated-for-cause producers per state appointment laws
Document investigation outcome and disciplinary action in producer file
Report producer complaint trends and disciplinary actions to distribution compliance and chief compliance officer
Track open producer conduct investigations through closure and confirm all actions are complete

subProcesses.name: Operations Performance Monitoring & Reporting
steps: Define key performance indicators for each operations function — processing cycle time, error rate, SLA adherence, and unit cost
Configure operational dashboards to display real-time and trended performance metrics by business unit
Collect daily, weekly, and monthly performance data from policy administration, billing, servicing, and contact center systems
Identify performance gaps against internal targets and industry benchmarks
Investigate root causes of SLA breaches, volume spikes, and quality failures
Prepare monthly operations performance report for division leadership and executive review
Escalate critical performance issues — regulatory deadline misses and significant error spikes — to senior management
Track corrective action commitments and verify implementation through follow-up measurement
Benchmark divisional performance against industry peer data and best-practice frameworks
Report staff productivity metrics — transactions per FTE, handle time, and first-contact resolution — to workforce management
Coordinate performance review with downstream business partners — finance, compliance, and actuarial
Archive performance reports and maintain trend history for multi-year analysis

subProcesses.name: Process Improvement & Lean Operations
steps: Identify process improvement opportunities from error reports, complaint data, quality reviews, and staff feedback
Prioritize improvement initiatives using impact-effort analysis and alignment to strategic objectives
Charter improvement projects with defined scope, success metrics, and accountable process owner
Conduct current-state process mapping using SIPOC, value-stream mapping, or swimlane documentation
Perform root-cause analysis using structured methods — fishbone diagrams, 5-why analysis, or failure mode analysis
Design future-state process with measurable improvement to cycle time, quality, or cost
Pilot process changes in controlled environment and measure results against baseline
Implement approved process changes across full operational scope with updated procedures and training
Measure post-implementation results and confirm improvement targets are achieved
Document improved processes in standard operating procedures and update training materials
Sustain improvements through ongoing monitoring and quarterly process health reviews
Report improvement portfolio status and realized benefits to operations leadership

subProcesses.name: Workforce Management & Capacity Planning
steps: Forecast transaction volumes by function using historical trends, seasonal patterns, and business pipeline
Model staffing requirements by skill set and function based on volume forecast and productivity standards
Produce capacity plans for quarterly and annual planning cycles and present to operations leadership
Monitor real-time workload against staffing levels and trigger load-balancing actions for queue imbalances
Manage staff scheduling — shift assignments, breaks, and time-off — to meet intraday coverage requirements
Coordinate cross-training programs to expand multi-skill staff availability and reduce single-point dependencies
Track overtime usage, voluntary time-off, and shrinkage against capacity plan assumptions
Report staffing variance from plan — volumes above or below forecast — and recommend adjustments
Coordinate with HR for hiring timelines, onboarding ramp curves, and attrition backfill
Evaluate outsourcing and offshoring opportunities for eligible transaction processing functions
Analyze cost-per-transaction trends and identify efficiency improvement opportunities
Present workforce management effectiveness report to operations and finance management monthly

subProcesses.name: Training & Knowledge Management
steps: Identify training needs from quality monitoring results, error analysis, regulatory changes, and product updates
Design training curriculum for new-hire onboarding — product knowledge, systems, procedures, and compliance
Develop and maintain process-specific training modules in learning management system
Conduct new-hire training and certify readiness before deployment to production work queues
Deliver ongoing training for regulatory changes, system updates, and new product launches
Maintain knowledge base of standard operating procedures, job aids, and FAQs for front-line staff
Update knowledge base within defined timeframe when processes or products change
Administer annual compliance training requirements — anti-money-laundering, privacy, and suitability
Track training completion rates and report non-compliance to HR and compliance
Assess training effectiveness through post-training assessment scores and production quality trends
Coordinate cross-functional training with underwriting, claims, and actuarial subject-matter experts
Archive training records and certifications per regulatory and HR record-retention requirements

subProcesses.name: Vendor & Third-Party Service Management
steps: Maintain inventory of third-party service providers supporting operations — print vendors, mail houses, and BPO partners
Define and document service level agreements for each vendor covering quality, timeliness, and compliance requirements
Conduct regular vendor performance reviews using SLA scorecards and quality audit results
Escalate vendor performance failures and manage remediation plans through to resolution
Conduct annual vendor risk assessments covering financial stability, data security, and regulatory compliance
Review vendor SOC 2 reports and information security certifications annually
Coordinate business continuity planning with critical vendors and confirm disaster recovery capabilities
Manage vendor contract renewals — negotiate terms, review pricing, and confirm regulatory compliance provisions
Process vendor invoices and confirm billing aligns with contracted volumes and rates
Identify vendor consolidation or alternative sourcing opportunities to reduce cost and operational risk
Maintain vendor relationship documentation — contracts, SLAs, risk assessments, and performance history
Report vendor portfolio risk and performance status to operations and procurement leadership

subProcesses.name: Regulatory Change & Compliance Operations
steps: Monitor state and federal regulatory developments affecting operations — DOI bulletins, DOL rules, and IRS guidance
Assess regulatory change impact on operations processes, systems, and customer communications
Assign regulatory change implementation to accountable process owners with defined compliance deadlines
Update standard operating procedures, forms, and customer notices for regulatory changes
Coordinate systems and configuration changes required by regulatory updates with IT and administration teams
Conduct staff training on regulatory changes before effective date
Validate implementation completeness through quality review or testing before effective date
File required regulatory notifications and certifications confirming compliance with new requirements
Monitor post-implementation compliance through quality monitoring and audit sampling
Respond to regulatory examination requests with evidence of compliant process implementation
Report regulatory change implementation status to compliance committee and senior management
Maintain regulatory change log with implementation status, accountable owner, and close-out date

subProcesses.name: Net-Retention & Risk-Appetite Setting
steps: Review board-approved risk appetite and capital strategy ahead of planning cycle
Analyze gross exposure aggregations by peril, line, and geography
Determine net retention levels and per-event tolerance thresholds
Quantify capital and solvency relief achievable under alternative retention scenarios
Stress-test retention under 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 loss scenarios
Benchmark retention against peer reinsurers and rating-agency guidance
Present retention options and cost-benefit analysis to CUO and CFO
Approve final net-retention strategy and document rationale
Communicate approved retention limits to underwriting and ceded operations teams

subProcesses.name: Program Structuring (Treaty vs Facultative)
steps: Identify risks and portfolios requiring reinsurance cover based on retention analysis
Evaluate proportional structures including quota share and surplus share layers
Design non-proportional layers covering per-risk XoL, cat XoL, and aggregate stop-loss
Model blended treaty and facultative coverage scenarios for complex risks
Optimize coverage versus cost and capital efficiency across candidate structures
Assess regulatory and rating-agency treatment of each structural option
Conduct internal peer review of proposed program structure
Document program structure, layer definitions, and design rationale
Obtain CUO, CFO, and board-level approval for final program structure
Distribute approved program blueprint to placement and ceded admin teams

subProcesses.name: Cat Model Application & Reinsurance Optimization
steps: Extract and cleanse policy-level exposure data from underwriting systems
Geocode and validate location data for cat-model ingestion
Ingest vendor cat model outputs (RMS, AIR, Verisk) for PML and AAL by peril
Stress-test model results against historical event sets and scenario analyses
Model net volatility under candidate layer options and retentions
Identify peak-peril accumulations and zones of excess concentration
Perform sensitivity analysis on key model parameters and assumptions
Recommend optimal program structure based on modelled net position
Document modelling assumptions, version, and output for audit trail
Present analytics to senior underwriting and capital management stakeholders

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Budgeting & Cost Allocation
steps: Gather prior-year actual reinsurance spend and rate-change market intelligence
Forecast reinsurance premium spend by program and layer for planning period
Allocate cost-of-cover to business units and lines based on usage metrics
Model sensitivity of budget to market rate changes and exposure growth
Review budget with finance and underwriting leadership for alignment
Obtain budget approval and integrate into enterprise financial plan
Track actual ceded premium versus approved budget monthly
Investigate and explain material budget variances
Report reinsurance cost and budget status to CFO and ERM

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Portfolio Monitoring & Mid-Year Steering
steps: Monitor ceded portfolio accumulations, PML, and program utilization mid-year
Identify remediation actions for underperforming treaties or excess accumulations
Analyze mid-year gross exposure growth against program capacity consumed
Assess whether in-year exposure changes require supplemental treaty placements
Report mid-year portfolio position to CUO and CRO with recommended actions
Execute approved in-year remediation including supplemental placements or adjustments
Track implementation of mid-year steering decisions against plan
Document mid-year steering actions and rationale for governance record

subProcesses.name: Annual Renewal Planning & Market Engagement
steps: Analyze market capacity, pricing trends, and broker intelligence ahead of renewal
Plan 1/1 and off-cycle renewal strategy for each program and major treaty
Prepare market engagement plan including target panel, lead selection, and timeline
Review renewal strategy with senior management and obtain pre-approval
Execute renewal decisions and confirm placement targets with brokers
Debrief renewal outcomes against strategy and document lessons learned
Update multi-year program roadmap based on renewal results and market feedback
Communicate renewal outcomes to finance, actuarial, and capital management teams

subProcesses.name: Assumed Reinsurance Appetite & Portfolio Strategy
steps: Define assumed reinsurance underwriting appetite by line, territory, and cedant tier
Set gross and net accumulation limits for peak perils and cedant concentrations
Establish pricing benchmarks and target combined ratios by class
Review cedant panel quality criteria and counterparty eligibility standards
Align assumed strategy with retrocession capacity and net-PML objectives
Approve assumed underwriting plan and authority matrix for the year
Communicate assumed appetite to underwriters and brokers via market briefings
Monitor assumed portfolio growth, mix, and profitability against plan quarterly
Recommend in-year strategy adjustments where appetite or accumulation limits are breached

subProcesses.name: Assumed Treaty Underwriting & Cedant Due Diligence
steps: Review cedant's underwriting philosophy, guidelines, and portfolio composition
Analyze cedant's five-year portfolio experience, loss triangles, and trend history
Assess cedant's financial strength, solvency margin, and operational controls
Conduct cedant audit or management meeting to verify underwriting practices
Evaluate cedant's claims handling philosophy and reserve adequacy
Assess territorial and line-of-business mix against assumed appetite
Document underwriting assessment and identify key risk drivers
Present due-diligence findings to chief underwriting officer for referral decision
Record cedant rating, tier classification, and credit limit in counterparty system

subProcesses.name: Assumed Quote, Authorization & Line Setting
steps: Prepare assumed treaty quote within underwriter's delegated authority
Escalate to referral or chief underwriting officer where quote exceeds authority
Obtain formal authorization approval and document authority basis
Set assumed line amount as lead or follow and confirm with broker
Issue formal quote letter or market indication to cedant or broker
Negotiate final terms, commission scale, and reinstatement provisions
Confirm order and record accepted terms in underwriting system
Notify technical accounting team of bound treaty for system setup
Distribute signed-line confirmation to broker and cedant

subProcesses.name: Assumed Contract Wording, Slips & Endorsements
steps: Draft treaty wording based on market standard form and negotiated terms
Review wording against slip to confirm all agreed terms are correctly captured
Circulate draft wording to cedant, broker, and internal legal for comment
Negotiate wording amendments and obtain consensus on final text
Process endorsements for mid-term changes including reinstatements and extensions
Obtain sign-off from legal and compliance on non-standard clauses
Execute final signed wording and slip with cedant or broker countersignature
Store executed contract in document management system
Publish approved wording to assumed treaty register for operations team reference

subProcesses.name: Assumed Facultative Submission Intake & Triage
steps: Receive assumed facultative submission from cedant or reinsurance broker
Clear submission against existing assumed book to avoid duplication
Triage against current assumed appetite, line-of-business strategy, and capacity
Confirm eligibility of cedant against approved counterparty panel
Assign submission to treaty or facultative underwriter based on risk type
Log submission in pipeline with expected response timeline
Request additional cedant information where submission data is insufficient
Acknowledge submission receipt and communicate expected quote timeline to broker

subProcesses.name: Assumed Facultative Individual-Risk Appraisal & Pricing
steps: Review risk submission for completeness including values, location, and loss history
Appraise individual risk quality, hazard characteristics, and coverage scope
Evaluate loss potential and exposure under candidate coverage structures
Price assumed facultative risk using experience and exposure rating
Assess portfolio accumulation impact and confirm capacity availability
Benchmark rate against treaty pricing and market comparables
Negotiate assumed facultative terms and commission with cedant or broker
Record assumed facultative decision including accept, decline, or counteroffer
Bind and document assumed facultative placement in administration system

subProcesses.name: Assumed Exposure Data Ingestion & Accumulation Check
steps: Receive and ingest cedant exposure data files in standard format
Map cedant data fields to internal risk classification schema
Validate data completeness, geocoding quality, and coverage consistency
Load validated exposure data into catastrophe modelling and accumulation system
Run accumulation check against existing assumed book by peril and zone
Flag peak-peril concentrations exceeding appetite or cat capacity limits
Confirm available capacity across relevant layers and treaties
Produce accumulation report for underwriter and portfolio management review
Update assumed portfolio exposure database with new submission data

subProcesses.name: Inward Bordereaux Intake & Validation
steps: Receive premium and risk bordereaux from cedants per treaty reporting schedule
Validate inward bordereaux format and completeness against expected data fields
Normalize and transform bordereaux data to internal system format
Identify and log data exceptions, missing fields, and classification errors
Engage cedant or broker to resolve bordereaux exceptions and obtain corrected data
Load validated bordereaux to reinsurance administration system
Reconcile bordereaux totals to cedant statements of account
Flag late or missing bordereaux and escalate to treaty manager for follow-up
Archive received bordereaux in document management system by treaty and period

subProcesses.name: Assumed Premium & Commission Booking
steps: Post assumed premium income from received bordereaux to reinsurance system
Calculate and book ceding commission expense on proportional treaties
Process profit commission and contingent commission calculations for eligible treaties
Produce technical and financial accounts (EBOT) for cedant statement of account
Post assumed premium and commission to general ledger in treaty currency
Convert multicurrency postings to functional and reporting currencies
Reconcile assumed premium balances between reinsurance system and GL
Prepare assumed premium summary report by treaty, cedant, and line
Provide assumed premium data to actuarial for reserve and IBNR analysis

subProcesses.name: Assumed Claims Loss Advice Intake
steps: Receive loss advices and loss bordereaux from cedants per treaty loss reporting terms
Validate loss advices against treaty coverage, layer attachment, and cedant authority
Log and acknowledge each loss advice in the claims management system
Confirm cedant reporting compliance against contractual loss notification thresholds
Request supplemental claims documentation or clarification from cedant where needed
Assign received loss advices to assumed claims handlers for review
Update cat event loss register for assumed book aggregation and monitoring
Notify assumed underwriters and portfolio management of material loss advices
Track open loss advices and chase outstanding notifications from cedants

subProcesses.name: Assumed Claims Reserving & IBNR
steps: Set initial case reserves on assumed claims in reinsurance system
Assess IBNR reserve requirements for unreported cedant losses by treaty class
Review large-loss reserves with actuarial for adequacy and development trends
Update assumed claims reserve on receipt of cedant reserve development notices
Report assumed claims position, case reserves, and IBNR to actuarial and finance
Conduct quarterly reserve review with actuarial and underwriting for assumed book
Identify treaties with adverse loss development and escalate to underwriting management
Incorporate actuarial IBNR indications into assumed claims reserve postings
Archive reserve review documentation and actuarial sign-off for audit trail

subProcesses.name: Assumed Claims Payment & Cash-Call Handling
steps: Receive and validate cedant claim payment request against open reserve and coverage
Confirm coverage under assumed treaty wording before authorizing payment
Obtain authority approval for payment amounts exceeding delegated limit
Process payment for large-loss and cat event claims within agreed cash-call timescale
Post assumed claim payment to reinsurance system and general ledger
Issue payment confirmation to cedant and broker with settlement reference
Reconcile assumed claims payments to bordereaux and cedant statements of account
Monitor uncommitted cash-call requests and close within contractual payment period
Report assumed claims paid and outstanding cash calls to management monthly

subProcesses.name: Cedant Counterparty Assessment
steps: Conduct annual financial strength and operational review for cedants on assumed panel
Review cedant solvency ratios, surplus adequacy, and regulatory standing
Assess cedant underwriting discipline and claims handling quality
Set per-cedant assumed exposure limit and premium credit threshold
Review cedant audit results and incorporate findings into risk assessment
Update cedant tier classification in counterparty system based on review outcome
Remove or restrict cedants failing financial strength or operational quality criteria
Obtain assumed underwriting committee approval for cedant rating changes
Publish updated cedant panel to assumed underwriting and operations teams

subProcesses.name: Submission Preparation
steps: Compile policy-level exposure data, loss history, and triangles for the renewal submission
Prepare underwriting submission pack including executive summary and program narrative
Validate data quality, completeness, and consistency against prior year
Obtain actuarial sign-off on loss statistics and trend adjustments included in submission
Prepare catastrophe model output summary for inclusion in submission
Format submission to broker and reinsurer preferred templates
Stage submission for electronic delivery via market platforms (e.g., Whitespace, PPL)
Issue submission to appointed brokers and lead reinsurers on agreed date
Track submission receipt confirmations and initial market feedback

subProcesses.name: Treaty Quoting & Negotiation
steps: Receive and log quotes, terms, and pricing from brokers and markets
Evaluate quoted rate against technical pricing benchmark and capital cost
Identify gaps in quoted coverage terms versus target program wording
Engage broker to negotiate terms, rate, and coverage improvements
Assess cedant market feedback and peer pricing data to support negotiation position
Negotiate firm-order terms including rate, commission, and conditions
Obtain internal authority approval for final terms and total ceded premium
Document negotiation record and pricing justification for underwriting file

subProcesses.name: Line Setting & Panel Confirmation
steps: Circulate firm order to panel reinsurers and invite signed lines
Set signed lines by reinsurer in accordance with capacity and lead/follow structure
Monitor line-signing progress and chase laggard markets to achieve 100% placement
Confirm final market panel, line percentages, and lead/follow structure
Reconcile signed lines to total coverage required and manage any shortfall
Document final panel composition and signed-line percentages in underwriting file
Notify all panel reinsurers of confirmed line allocation and placement completion
Communicate confirmed panel and signed lines to ceded administration for setup

subProcesses.name: Treaty Binding & Slip Execution
steps: Confirm firm order to market and formally bind coverage effective from inception date
Execute slip and collect signed lines from all participating reinsurers
Verify that signed lines total 100% and reconcile any shortfall
Obtain internal authority approval for bound terms and ceded premium commitment
Issue binding confirmation to all participating reinsurers with inception date details
Hand off executed slip to wording and legal review team for full contract drafting
Register bound treaty in reinsurance administration system with inception terms
Notify ceded administration of bound treaty for cession calculation setup
Archive original slip documents in contract repository

subProcesses.name: Treaty Wording, Clauses & Legal Review
steps: Draft full treaty wording including all clauses and endorsements based on bound slip
Circulate wording to legal, compliance, and reinsurer counterparties for review
Incorporate agreed amendments and resolve wording disputes with reinsurers
Obtain final wording sign-off from legal and internal underwriting authority
Execute final treaty document and obtain counter-signatures from reinsurers
Confirm executed wording is consistent with bound slip and register terms
Archive executed treaty wording in contract repository with version control
Distribute final executed wording to ceded administration and claims teams
Record wording completion and legal sign-off in treaty register

subProcesses.name: Treaty Register & Contract Data Setup
steps: Set up new or renewed treaty in reinsurance administration system with inception terms
Configure cession calculation rules, layer definitions, and proportional splits
Enter commission scales, profit commission parameters, and reinstatement provisions
Set up cedant and counterparty codes, currency, and settlement frequency
Validate system configuration against signed wording and slip
Test cession calculation with sample premium data to confirm accuracy
Obtain operations sign-off on treaty setup before first accounting period
Publish treaty data to technical accounting and claims operations teams
Maintain treaty register for amendments, endorsements, and renewals throughout term

subProcesses.name: Renewal Debrief & Program Documentation
steps: Compile renewal outcome data including final terms, rates, and panel composition
Compare placed terms against pre-renewal strategy and identify variances
Document lessons learned from negotiation, market engagement, and broker performance
Assess broker effectiveness and market access quality during the renewal
Prepare renewal debrief report for CUO and reinsurance governance committee
Update program documentation with as-placed terms for audit and regulatory use
Identify program design improvements for the next renewal cycle
Communicate renewal debrief findings to finance, actuarial, and capital management

subProcesses.name: Facultative Submission Intake & Triage
steps: Receive submission from cedant or broker for facultative reinsurance cover
Clear submission against existing coverage and de-duplicate prior submissions
Triage risk against facultative appetite, line-of-business guidelines, and capacity
Assign submission to specialist facultative underwriter
Log submission in underwriting pipeline with target turnaround date
Request additional underwriting information where submission is incomplete
Confirm coverage required and any specific treaty exclusions driving fac need
Acknowledge receipt to cedant or broker and set expectations on timeline

subProcesses.name: Individual Risk Appraisal & Pricing
steps: Review risk submission including property values, liability limits, and loss history
Appraise individual risk quality, construction, occupancy, and hazard features
Evaluate coverage requirements and potential loss scenarios
Apply technical pricing model for the specific risk and coverage layer
Benchmark rate against treaty pricing and market comparables
Assess accumulation impact of adding risk to existing portfolio
Document underwriting rationale and pricing basis in risk file
Obtain referral approval where risk exceeds authority or accumulation trigger
Finalize rate, terms, conditions, and retention recommendation

subProcesses.name: Facultative Quote & Negotiation
steps: Issue facultative quote to cedant or broker with terms and conditions
Negotiate rate, commission, and coverage terms with counterparty
Obtain internal authority approval for final terms
Confirm firm order and communicate acceptance to cedant or broker
Document final agreed terms, conditions, and effective date in underwriting file
Notify ceded administration and claims of agreed fac terms pending binding
Resolve any outstanding coverage queries before proceeding to bind
Confirm firm order and record in underwriting pipeline as ready-to-bind

subProcesses.name: Facultative Binding, Certification & System Setup
steps: Bind facultative reinsurance coverage upon receipt of firm order
Issue facultative certificate or slip to cedant confirming cover
Execute and countersign facultative certificate where required by cedant
Set up bound facultative in reinsurance administration system
Notify ceded administration and claims of bound fac cession for tracking
Archive certificate and underwriting file in document repository
Confirm system setup to ceded administration for cession recording
Record bound facultative in treaty register under applicable treaty exclusion

subProcesses.name: Facultative Cession Recording & Administration
steps: Identify all policies and risks subject to facultative cession arrangements
Calculate ceded premium, commission, and net retention for each facultative placement
Record facultative cessions in reinsurance system against individual policies
Generate facultative bordereaux for submission to reinsurers or brokers
Validate cession data against bound certificates and original policy terms
Process endorsements and adjustments arising from policy changes mid-term
Reconcile facultative cession records to general ledger postings
Report facultative cession volume and premium statistics to management

subProcesses.name: Facultative Expiry Monitoring & Renewal Decisions
steps: Maintain expiry schedule for all active facultative placements in administration system
Flag facultative covers approaching expiry for underwriter review and action
Assess whether expiring risks still require facultative cover given current treaty scope
Initiate renewal submission for expiring facultative placements where continued cover is needed
Obtain underwriting decision on renewal, non-renewal, or restructure for each expiry
Communicate renewal or non-renewal decisions to cedant or broker ahead of expiry
Close expired facultative records in administration system where not renewed
Report facultative expiry and renewal activity to ceded operations management monthly

subProcesses.name: Cession Calculation & Ceded-Premium Booking
steps: Identify all cedable policies and risk periods falling within treaty scope
Calculate ceded premium for proportional treaties based on written and earned splits
Apply surplus and quota-share cession rules by line, territory, and layer
Calculate ceded premium and adjustments for non-proportional XoL treaties
Compute ceding commissions and sliding-scale adjustments where applicable
Book ceded premium entries in reinsurance administration system
Record reinstatement premiums triggered by loss events during the period
Post ceded premium to general ledger with correct treaty, period, and currency codes
Reconcile ceded premium bookings to policy system and underwriting records
Generate period cession summary for review by finance and reinsurance operations

subProcesses.name: Bordereaux & Statements of Account (EBOT)
steps: Extract ceded premium and claims data for the reporting period from admin system
Prepare premium bordereaux in agreed reinsurer or broker format
Prepare claims bordereaux (ECOT) with loss events, payments, and reserves
Validate bordereaux data against source records for completeness and accuracy
Resolve bordereaux data exceptions and reconcile to system totals
Produce technical account / statement of account (EBOT) incorporating all items
Include ceding commission, profit commission, and reinstatement entries in account
Submit bordereaux and statements to reinsurers and brokers by contractual deadline
Track submission confirmations and manage follow-up for overdue acknowledgements
File submitted bordereaux and accounts in document management system

subProcesses.name: Sliding-Scale Commission Calculation & Verification
steps: Compile treaty result data including earned premium, losses incurred, and expenses
Apply sliding-scale commission formula per treaty terms to calculate provisional commission
Verify calculation inputs against bordereaux data and loss advices
Obtain actuarial review of loss estimates used in commission calculation
Compare provisional commission against minimum and maximum commission thresholds
Document calculation methodology and present to treaty counterparty for agreement
Process agreed provisional commission entries in reinsurance administration system
Post commission to general ledger and reconcile to treaty account

subProcesses.name: Adjustment Premium & Profit Commission Settlement
steps: Calculate adjustment premium arising from auditable base and experience development
Apply profit commission formula using final treaty year results per treaty terms
Prepare adjustment statement incorporating premium and profit commission items
Present adjustment statement to cedant or broker for agreement and sign-off
Process agreed adjustment premium and commission entries in reinsurance system
Issue adjustment statements and collect or pay resulting cash differences
Post final adjustment entries to general ledger with treaty and period references
Document calculation basis, inputs, and approval for audit purposes
Close treaty year account upon settlement of all adjustment items

subProcesses.name: Ceded Data Quality, Leakage Detection & Controls
steps: Detect and quantify ceded premium leakage against policy and treaty scope
Review data quality metrics for cession records, bordereaux, and treaty terms
Identify systematic cession errors arising from system configuration or manual processing
Escalate material leakage findings to reinsurance operations management for remediation
Track corrective actions to close identified leakage and data quality issues
Maintain data quality controls and review exception logs at each period end
Report ceded data quality status and leakage findings to finance controller
Update cession rules and system configurations to prevent recurrence of leakage

subProcesses.name: Reconciliation & GL Close
steps: Reconcile ceded reinsurance system balances to general ledger on monthly close
Investigate and explain reconciling items and clear within agreed tolerance period
Prepare monthly reconciliation status report for finance controller review
Implement corrective entries and adjustments to resolve identified discrepancies
Confirm all ceded premium, commission, and claims entries are posted before cutoff
Obtain finance controller sign-off on reinsurance sub-ledger close
Report persistent reconciliation issues to reinsurance operations governance committee
Archive reconciliation workpapers and supporting documentation for audit

subProcesses.name: Loss Notification & Claim Advices
steps: Monitor claims system daily for losses approaching or exceeding treaty reporting triggers
Identify reportable losses against each treaty's loss notification clause threshold
Prepare loss advice notifications for large individual losses and cat event losses
Obtain claims department sign-off on notified reserve amounts before advising market
Submit formal loss advices to reinsurers and brokers within contractual notice periods
Maintain cat event coding in claims system for accurate aggregate accumulation tracking
Track acknowledgement of loss advices from reinsurers and chase outstanding confirmations
Update loss advice register with reserve developments and additional payments
Monitor compliance with notification obligations and escalate missed deadlines
Report notification status and open large-loss register to reinsurance management monthly

subProcesses.name: Cat Event Aggregation & Recovery Coordination
steps: Identify and code all claims belonging to a declared cat event in the claims system
Aggregate gross cat losses by treaty layer to determine layer attachment and exhaustion
Confirm cat event definition and trigger criteria with reinsurers and brokers
Coordinate with claims department on case-reserve adequacy for the event portfolio
Calculate preliminary ceded recoveries by layer and reinsurer for management reporting
Submit cat event loss bordereaux (ECOT) to reinsurers with supporting data
Manage Q&A from reinsurers on cat event claims data and coverage determination
Monitor aggregate loss development and update recovery estimates as claims mature
Report cat event recovery status and outstanding billings to CFO and CRO

subProcesses.name: Recoverable Identification & Cash Calls
steps: Calculate recoverable amounts due by layer for all reportable losses and cat events
Confirm layer attachment and exhaustion to determine applicable recoveries by treaty
Prepare recovery billing statements for submission to reinsurers
Issue cash call requests for large-loss recoverables requiring interim collection
Submit claim bordereaux (ECOT) with full proof-of-loss documentation to market
Track cash call payment status and chase overdue collections
Apply received recoveries against outstanding billings in reinsurance system
Post recovery receipts to general ledger and reconcile to claims recoverable account
Report recoverable position, cash call status, and open billings to CFO monthly

subProcesses.name: Recovery Collection & Ageing Control
steps: Produce aged recoverable report segmented by reinsurer, treaty, and loss event
Review collections exceeding agreed credit terms and identify priority follow-up
Issue formal collection letters and statements to reinsurers with outstanding balances
Engage broker to facilitate collection from slow-paying or disputing markets
Escalate balances aged beyond 90 days to reinsurance management for action
Assess whether slow collections indicate financial distress at counterparty level
Initiate formal dispute resolution for contested recovery amounts
Match cash received to open recoverable items in the reinsurance system
Update recoverable ageing report and provide monthly status to finance controller

subProcesses.name: Commutations & Run-Off Settlement (Ceded)
steps: Identify run-off ceded treaties suitable for commutation based on age and outstanding reserves
Evaluate commutation opportunity including estimated ultimate liability and market value
Engage broker or reinsurer counterparty to initiate commutation negotiation
Value commutation consideration using actuarial projections and discount factors
Negotiate commutation terms, lump-sum amount, and release provisions
Obtain board or senior management approval for material commutations
Execute commutation agreement and release all future obligations under the treaty
Process commutation settlement receipt in reinsurance and accounting systems
Archive commutation agreement and close contract records in treaty register
Report commutation to regulatory filings and update Schedule F or Solvency II data

subProcesses.name: Dispute & Arbitration Management
steps: Identify and log reinsurance disputes arising from coverage, quantum, or reporting issues
Classify dispute by type, treaty, counterparty, and estimated financial exposure
Assemble factual position including relevant policy wording, loss data, and correspondence
Engage internal legal counsel and external reinsurance counsel to assess merits
Initiate pre-arbitration negotiation or mediation with counterparty
Manage arbitration proceedings including panel selection, discovery, and hearings
Present case and evidence to arbitration panel within procedural timelines
Record arbitration award or negotiated settlement outcome in dispute register
Process settlement payment or recovery arising from dispute resolution
Update reserve and recoverable positions in reinsurance system post-resolution

subProcesses.name: Premium Settlement & Cash Management
steps: Generate cash settlement schedules based on agreed payment terms in treaty accounts
Issue payment demands or settlement statements to brokers and reinsurers
Receive incoming cash from reinsurers and cedants and apply to open statements
Process outgoing cash payments to reinsurers for ceded premium balances due
Apply offsetting of debit and credit balances within agreed netting arrangements
Manage multicurrency settlements including EUR, GBP, USD, and other treaty currencies
Execute FX conversions for non-functional currency settlements at agreed rate
Resolve settlement queries and disputes on balances raised by counterparties
Reconcile cash receipts and payments to reinsurance system outstanding balance
Report daily and weekly cash position on reinsurance settlements to treasury

subProcesses.name: Cash Collection & Reconciliation (Assumed)
steps: Issue periodic account statements to cedants with premium balances due
Monitor cedant payment receipts against contractual due dates in settlement system
Chase overdue inward cash collections from cedants via broker or direct contact
Match received cash to cedant account statements and open reinsurance balances
Reconcile cedant receivable balances in reinsurance system to general ledger
Escalate aged inward receivables beyond credit terms to treaty manager and credit control
Review disputed balances with cedant and broker to obtain resolution
Record partial payments and agree repayment plans for impaired cedant balances
Produce monthly assumed cash collection report with ageing analysis for management

subProcesses.name: Multicurrency & FX Management
steps: Identify treaty currencies and expected cash-flow timing for each settlement period
Coordinate with treasury on FX exposure arising from multicurrency treaty settlements
Apply treaty-specified exchange rates or spot rates for bordereaux conversion
Process currency translation adjustments on reinsurance balances at period end
Reconcile foreign-currency reinsurance balances to functional-currency GL accounts
Monitor open FX positions on unsettled reinsurance accounts receivable and payable
Report FX exposure on reinsurance balances to treasury and finance controller
Implement hedging instructions from treasury for material reinsurance FX positions
Document exchange-rate basis and conversion methodology for audit and regulatory review

subProcesses.name: Reinstatement Premium Calculation & Processing
steps: Identify loss events triggering reinstatement premium obligations under XoL treaties
Calculate reinstatement premium due per treaty layer using contractual formula
Verify reinstatement availability and remaining layer capacity post-event
Book reinstatement premium payable in reinsurance system against treaty
Notify brokers and reinsurers of reinstatement premium due with calculation detail
Process cash payment of reinstatement premium within contractual payment terms
Update treaty exhaustion status and remaining aggregate limits in admin system
Communicate reinstated capacity to underwriting team for ongoing risk acceptance
Document reinstatement events in treaty register for historical loss tracking

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Ledger Close & Financial Reporting
steps: Complete all period-end reinsurance bookings before month-end cutoff deadline
Ensure ceded and assumed premium, commission, and claims are fully accrued
Reconcile reinsurance sub-ledger to general ledger at line-item level
Produce ceded reinsurance premium and recoverable summary for finance close pack
Prepare assumed premium income and claims paid schedules for finance reporting
Validate IFRS 17 reinsurance-held asset and contract service margin calculations
Prepare reinsurance disclosures for quarterly and annual financial statements
Support external audit review of reinsurance balances and treaty documentation
Submit final reinsurance ledger close sign-off to financial controller

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Statutory & Regulatory Reporting (Schedule F & Solvency II)
steps: Compile ceded premium, reserve credit, and recoverable data for statutory reporting
Prepare NAIC Schedule F Part 1 through Part 5 covering reinsurance ceded
Calculate provision for reinsurance on unauthorized or overdue reinsurers
Assess RBC credit for reinsurance recoverables under SAP framework
Prepare Solvency II reinsurance-held contract data for IFRS 17 and QRT submissions
Validate counterparty classification as authorized, certified, accredited, or other
Coordinate regulatory review process with compliance and external auditors
Respond to regulatory queries on reinsurance data and supporting calculations
File completed regulatory reinsurance schedules within statutory deadlines
Maintain audit trail of regulatory filing inputs, outputs, and approval sign-offs

subProcesses.name: Counterparty Credit Assessment & Approved-Reinsurer List
steps: Conduct annual financial strength review for all reinsurers and retrocessionaires on panel
Obtain and analyze credit ratings from AM Best, S&P, Moody's, and Fitch
Classify each counterparty as authorized, certified, accredited, or alien reinsurer
Assess country and jurisdictional risk for foreign reinsurer counterparties
Review solvency ratios, capital adequacy, and claims-paying ability of each entity
Set per-counterparty exposure limits and concentration limits by rating band
Update approved reinsurer panel list with current ratings, limits, and classifications
Remove or place on watch list any counterparty failing financial strength criteria
Obtain CRO and underwriting committee approval for changes to approved panel
Publish updated approved reinsurer list to placement teams and operations

subProcesses.name: Collateral Management (LOC, Reg-114 Trust & Funds-Withheld)
steps: Determine collateral requirements for unauthorized and certified reinsurers under SAP
Calculate Reg-114 trust or LOC amounts required to support reserve credit
Instruct counterparties to establish or increase letters of credit or trust accounts
Review and execute Reg-114 trust agreements with authorized financial institutions
Verify that collateral posted meets regulatory requirements and is properly structured
Monitor collateral adequacy against current outstanding reserves and recoverables monthly
Request collateral top-up from reinsurers where adequacy falls below required level
Manage funds-withheld arrangements including interest crediting and release triggers
Process LOC or trust releases where recoverables are settled or treaties commuted
Report collateral positions to regulatory filings and include in Schedule F submissions

subProcesses.name: Reinsurer Credit Monitoring & Watchlist
steps: Monitor reinsurer financial strength ratings on continuous basis via rating agency alerts
Review public financial statements, analyst reports, and news for counterparty developments
Assess impact of rating downgrades on exposure limits and collateral requirements
Place counterparties under enhanced monitoring where adverse signals are detected
Notify CRO and senior management immediately on significant rating downgrades
Assess potential for counterparty default and estimate exposure under stress scenarios
Accelerate collateral calls or seek alternative security where counterparty risk rises
Review and update counterparty limits in response to changed financial strength
Prepare quarterly counterparty credit risk report for ERM and board risk committee

subProcesses.name: Regulatory Compliance & Unauthorized Reinsurer Management
steps: Maintain current list of authorized, certified, and accredited reinsurers by jurisdiction
Monitor regulatory changes affecting reinsurer authorization and credit requirements
Assess impact of new state or international regulation on approved panel and collateral
Ensure collateral is in place for all unauthorized reinsurer balances before filing
Review NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law compliance across states of domicile
Coordinate with compliance to address non-compliant counterparty or collateral positions
Document corrective actions taken to remediate regulatory compliance gaps
Report unauthorized reinsurer exposure to compliance and regulatory affairs teams
Support state insurance department examinations on reinsurance credit and collateral

subProcesses.name: Broker Panel Management & Performance Review
steps: Maintain formal governance framework for approved broker panel appointments
Conduct annual broker performance review covering service, market access, and responsiveness
Track brokerage and commission costs per broker and assess value delivered
Review broker concentration against diversification policy and maximum share limits
Assess broker financial strength and regulatory standing for counterparty risk purposes
Manage broker appointment, reappointment, and removal per panel governance policy
Escalate broker performance issues or governance exceptions to reinsurance management
Document broker review outcomes and panel decisions in governance register
Report broker panel composition and performance to reinsurance governance committee

subProcesses.name: Reinsurer Relationship Management & Panel Governance
steps: Hold annual review meetings with key reinsurer counterparties on program performance
Assess reinsurer service quality including claims handling and treaty administration
Review counterparty concentration against reinsurer diversification policy limits annually
Manage reinsurer panel composition including addition, reallocation, and removal
Escalate counterparty governance exceptions to reinsurance management committee
Document panel decisions, approvals, and minutes in governance register
Report panel composition, concentration, and counterparty risk to board risk committee
Communicate panel changes to placement teams and operations for implementation

subProcesses.name: Assumed-Book Accumulation & Net-PML Analysis
steps: Aggregate assumed-book exposure across all treaties by peril, territory, and cedant
Analyze peak-peril accumulations to identify zones of highest cat risk concentration
Quantify gross net PML at multiple return periods using vendor cat models
Assess IFRS-17 volatility in contract service margin from peak-peril exposures
Compare net PML against board-approved capital and solvency risk tolerances
Model additional gross exposure expected from pipeline assumed business
Identify treaties or cedants driving excess peak accumulation requiring retro protection
Define retrocession objectives in terms of net PML reduction and capital relief targets
Present accumulation analysis and retro objectives to CRO and capital committee

subProcesses.name: Retrocession Structuring (Proportional, Cat & Whole-Account)
steps: Design proportional retrocession options including quota share of assumed book
Structure non-proportional cat retrocession layers covering peak perils
Evaluate whole-account aggregate stop-loss structures for earnings protection
Model net position under each retro structure option versus retention targets
Optimize net PML reduction versus retrocession cost and basis risk
Assess basis risk arising from mismatches between assumed portfolio and retro triggers
Evaluate ILS and collateralized alternatives to traditional retrocession capacity
Approve final retro program structure with CUO, CFO, and capital committee
Document retro design rationale and submit for inclusion in ORSA and capital model

subProcesses.name: Alternative-Capital Design (ILS, Sidecars & Cat Bonds)
steps: Assess appetite for ILS, collateralized reinsurance, and sidecar structures
Identify portions of assumed risk suitable for capital-markets placement
Design sidecar, cat-bond, or industry loss warranty (ILW) structure
Engage investment banks and ILS fund managers on structuring and distribution
Model capital efficiency, basis risk, and investor return for proposed structure
Obtain legal and regulatory review of proposed alternative-capital structure
Seek rating-agency guidance on capital credit for proposed instruments
Approve alternative-capital plan with board and senior management
Coordinate capital-markets execution with treasury and legal teams

subProcesses.name: Retrocession Submission, Quoting & Binding
steps: Prepare retrocession submission including assumed portfolio data and cat model output
Market retrocession program to retrocessionaires and ILS funds via appointed broker
Manage Q&A process and capital-markets investor due diligence requests
Track market indications and available capacity by layer and peril
Evaluate retro quotes against technical pricing and basis risk tolerance
Negotiate firm-order terms with retrocessionaires on rate, coverage, and conditions
Finalize retro wording and endorsements in consultation with legal
Bind retrocession coverage and confirm signed lines with all participants
Hand off executed retro contracts to technical accounting and collateral teams

subProcesses.name: Retro Collateral & Trust Structuring (Collateralized & Sidecar)
steps: Determine collateral and trust requirements for collateralized retrocession structures
Establish ring-fenced trust accounts or SPV vehicles for collateralized coverage
Confirm funding level, eligible assets, and documentation requirements
Review trust and collateral agreements with legal and compliance
Validate that collateral is fully funded before retro coverage becomes effective
Monitor collateral adequacy against outstanding retro exposure monthly
Process collateral top-up requests where adequacy falls below required threshold
Manage collateral release upon expiry, commutation, or satisfaction of obligations
Report collateral positions to finance and regulatory reporting teams

subProcesses.name: Retro Cession Calculation, Premium Booking & Settlement
steps: Calculate retrocession cessions from assumed book based on contractual cession rules
Apply cession rules by layer, peril, and territory for each retrocession treaty
Book retro ceded premium and commission in reinsurance administration system
Reconcile retro cession calculations to assumed premium data and layer definitions
Produce retro technical accounts and statements for retrocessionaires
Process retro cash settlements and match payments to open account statements
Reconcile retrocessionaire account balances to general ledger
Resolve retro settlement queries and disputes with retrocessionaires or brokers
Report retro ceded premium, recoveries, and settlement status to finance monthly

subProcesses.name: Retro Loss Recoveries & Cash Calls
steps: Identify loss events triggering retrocession recoveries from assumed cat losses
Calculate retro recoverable amounts by layer and peril from qualifying assumed losses
Raise retro cash call requests where interim recovery from retrocessionaires is required
Bill and collect retro recoveries from retrocessionaires and ILS counterparties
Track recovery collection ageing and escalate slow or disputed retro balances
Apply received retro recoveries against open billing statements in reinsurance system
Post retro recovery receipts to general ledger and reconcile to recoverable account
Produce retro recoverable ageing report for management and credit control review
Report retro recovery position and cash-call status to reinsurance management

subProcesses.name: Retrocession Commutation Management
steps: Identify retrocession treaties suitable for commutation based on age and reserve maturity
Evaluate commutation opportunity including run-off liability, discount, and market value
Engage retrocessionaire or broker to initiate commutation discussion
Value and negotiate retro commutation terms with actuarial support
Obtain senior management approval for material retro commutation settlements
Execute commutation agreement and release all future retro treaty obligations
Settle and close commuted retro contracts in administration and accounting systems
Update retro treaty register and remove commuted treaties from active monitoring
Report completed retro commutations to finance, actuarial, and regulatory teams

subProcesses.name: Retrocessionaire Credit & Collateral Monitoring
steps: Assess financial strength and security quality of retrocessionaires and ILS fund managers
Monitor credit ratings of retrocessionaires using rating agency continuous alert services
Review collateral adequacy for collateralized retro structures against current exposure
Confirm LOC, trust, and ILS ring-fencing arrangements remain valid and funded
Set and track counterparty exposure limits for each retrocessionaire by rating tier
Escalate credit concerns on retrocessionaires to CRO and capital committee
Take protective action including collateral acceleration where retrocessionaire risk rises
Report retro credit risk and counterparty concentration to ERM and board quarterly
Update retrocessionaire approved panel with current ratings and limit changes

subProcesses.name: Spiral, Concentration Control & Net-Aggregation Reporting
steps: Detect potential spiral risk arising from mutual retrocession within the market
Assess counterparty concentration in retro panel against diversification policy
Compute post-retro net aggregation by peril, event, and territory
Report net cat capacity and net PML to ERM, capital management, and board
Compare net aggregation against approved risk appetite and capital allocation
Identify breaches of net accumulation limits and trigger corrective actions
Recommend adjustments to retro program or assumed book where limits are approached
Coordinate net-aggregation reporting with actuarial and capital modelling teams
Document concentration and spiral controls in reinsurance governance framework

subProcesses.name: Management Information & Performance Reporting
steps: Compile monthly reinsurance management report covering ceded and assumed performance
Report ceded premium, recoveries, and net loss position by program and line
Report assumed premium income, combined ratio, and profitability by treaty class
Provide retrocession cost and net-PML update to senior management
Track key reinsurance operational metrics including bordereaux timeliness and error rates
Present quarterly reinsurance performance pack to CUO, CFO, and CEO
Produce treaty-level profitability analysis for assumed portfolio steering
Report assumed treaty renewal decisions, rate changes, and portfolio actions
Distribute management MI to relevant stakeholders across underwriting, finance, and ERM

subProcesses.name: Actuarial & Reserving Collaboration
steps: Provide actuarial team with ceded and assumed premium, loss, and exposure data quarterly
Support actuarial review of ceded reserve credit and recoverable adequacy
Collaborate on assumed treaty IBNR and loss development factor selection
Supply cat event loss data for actuarial cat reserve estimation on assumed book
Review actuarial reserve projections for assumed and ceded programs with underwriting
Incorporate actuarial reserve indications into reinsurance financial reporting
Support external actuarial opinion on reinsurance reserves for statutory filings
Participate in annual loss reserve workshop for assumed and ceded reinsurance
Resolve data queries raised by actuarial on exposure, premium, and loss records

subProcesses.name: ERM & Capital Model Integration
steps: Provide reinsurance program structure data to capital modelling team for SCR and RBC
Supply ceded and retro treaty terms for internal model reinsurance benefit calculations
Validate reinsurance benefit in capital model against program as placed
Report net PML and post-retro net aggregation for ORSA internal model scenarios
Contribute reinsurance data to Solvency II SCR standard formula or internal model
Participate in ORSA process including reinsurance stress and scenario testing
Provide input to rating-agency capital model submissions on reinsurance structure
Report reinsurance counterparty credit risk concentration to ERM committee
Review and sign off on reinsurance sections of ORSA and Own Risk and Solvency report

subProcesses.name: Operational Controls Self-Assessment & Internal Audit
steps: Maintain reinsurance controls framework covering placement, cession, and settlement
Conduct annual self-assessment of reinsurance operational controls against framework
Respond to internal audit reviews of reinsurance processes and resolve findings
Support external audit review of ceded and assumed reinsurance balances
Review and enforce reinsurance authority matrix and delegated underwriting limits
Track control exceptions and implement remediation actions within agreed timelines
Report control exception status and remediation progress to reinsurance governance committee
Maintain procedure manuals and desk instructions for reinsurance operations

subProcesses.name: Regulatory Compliance Monitoring
steps: Monitor compliance with reinsurance regulatory requirements across all jurisdictions
Identify regulatory changes affecting reinsurance operations and assess impact
Coordinate with compliance on new or amended requirements affecting treaty structures
Assess gap between current reinsurance practices and updated regulatory requirements
Implement corrective actions to address identified regulatory compliance gaps
Respond to regulatory examination requests on reinsurance compliance evidence
Report regulatory compliance status and outstanding remediation items to governance committee
Maintain compliance monitoring calendar aligned with regulatory reporting deadlines
Document regulatory correspondence, examination findings, and resolution outcomes

subProcesses.name: Treaty Documentation Management
steps: Ensure treaty documentation is current, executed, and archived within policy timelines
Conduct periodic review of treaty document completeness and execution status
Identify and remediate documentation gaps for treaties lacking executed wording
Maintain treaty document inventory covering active, run-off, and commuted contracts
Enforce document retention schedule aligned with regulatory and legal requirements
Coordinate with legal on storage, retrieval, and destruction of treaty records
Report documentation completeness status to reinsurance governance committee
Support regulatory examination requests with timely production of treaty documentation
Perform annual document archive audit to verify completeness and accessibility

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Governance Committee & Policy Management
steps: Convene quarterly reinsurance governance committee with senior leadership
Present reinsurance program strategy, performance, and risk exposure for committee review
Review and approve changes to reinsurance policy, appetite, and panel governance
Maintain reinsurance policy document covering ceded, assumed, and retro principles
Review and update reinsurance authority matrix and delegated limit schedule annually
Escalate material reinsurance risks and issues to board risk committee
Maintain committee minutes, action logs, and decision records in governance register
Communicate policy updates and governance decisions to reinsurance operations teams
Ensure reinsurance governance framework aligns with regulatory and rating-agency expectations

subProcesses.name: Channel & Segment Strategy Design
steps: Compile distribution mix and channel revenue baseline by line and region
Analyze addressable market and competitor channel footprint by segment
Segment target customers and map preferred channels per segment
Evaluate channel economics, cost-to-serve, and margin contribution by channel
Define channel value propositions and product-line eligibility per channel
Set channel growth, mix, and economics targets for the planning horizon
Draft channel strategy document with investment and trade-off options
Socialize draft with regional and product stakeholders and capture feedback
Incorporate feedback and resolve cross-functional channel conflicts
Finalize and publish approved channel strategy and segment plan

subProcesses.name: Distribution Operating-Model Design
steps: Assess current distribution operating model against strategic growth and efficiency objectives
Benchmark distribution model structures across peer carriers and best-in-class insurers
Define target-state distribution operating model including roles, spans, and layers
Map accountability boundaries between field, regional, and home-office distribution functions
Design workflow and decision-rights framework for new-business and renewal handling
Identify technology and data capability gaps required to support the target operating model
Develop transition roadmap with phased milestones and change-management requirements
Obtain executive approval for target operating model and transition plan
Communicate operating model changes to distribution field leadership and partners
Track operating model implementation milestones and adjust plan based on field feedback

subProcesses.name: Channel Economics & Investment Planning
steps: Gather channel-level production, commission expense, and operating cost data for the prior period
Calculate fully loaded cost-to-acquire and cost-to-serve by channel and producer tier
Model return on channel investment using premium growth, retention, and loss-ratio inputs
Identify channels and tiers with the strongest risk-adjusted economics for incremental investment
Develop channel investment scenarios and stress-test against market and rate-cycle assumptions
Prioritize channel investment allocations and document supporting rationale
Obtain finance and distribution leadership sign-off on channel investment plan
Load approved channel investment budgets and targets into financial planning system
Monitor channel investment performance against plan each quarter
Update channel economics model annually with refreshed data and revised assumptions

subProcesses.name: Territory Design & Capacity Planning
steps: Extract current territory boundaries and producer assignments from distribution system
Score territories on premium potential, loss ratio, and white-space opportunity
Identify coverage gaps, overlap areas, and underperforming territories
Rebalance territory boundaries to close coverage gaps and equalize potential
Model producer headcount and appointment capacity per rebalanced territory
Assign account executives and producers to rebalanced territories
Validate quota allocation against territory potential and historical actuals
Circulate draft territory plan for field-manager review and challenge
Resolve disputes and finalize territory assignments
Publish territory plan and notify assigned field staff and producers

subProcesses.name: Channel Mix & Conflict Management
steps: Define channel conflict policy covering priority rules, escalation paths, and resolution SLAs
Monitor channel overlap indicators including duplicate submissions and account ownership disputes
Receive and log channel conflict cases with submitting parties and key facts
Investigate conflict root cause using submission history, territory data, and agreement terms
Apply channel priority rules and determine conflict resolution with documented rationale
Communicate resolution to all affected producers and field managers within SLA
Track repeat conflict patterns and identify systemic territory or overlap design issues
Recommend channel mix adjustments or policy updates to eliminate structural conflict sources
Review channel conflict case outcomes quarterly with distribution leadership
Update channel conflict policy and territory design guidance based on lessons learned

subProcesses.name: Distribution Channel Innovation & Roadmap
steps: Scan emerging distribution technologies, InsurTech models, and consumer-access trends
Evaluate new channel concepts against strategic fit, regulatory feasibility, and economics
Prioritize high-potential distribution innovation opportunities for pilot development
Design pilot parameters including target market, volume thresholds, and success criteria
Obtain compliance and legal sign-off on pilot channel structure and disclosures
Execute pilot launch with defined monitoring and data-collection protocols
Assess pilot results against success criteria and determine scale or exit recommendation
Develop full-scale business case for approved distribution innovations
Integrate approved new channels into the distribution operating model and capacity plan
Maintain distribution channel innovation roadmap and update quarterly with pipeline progress
