subProcesses.name: Agency & Broker Recruitment and Selection
steps: Build prospect list of target agencies and brokers from coverage-gap and white-space analysis
Qualify prospects against appetite fit, volume potential, and book-of-business criteria
Conduct introductory meetings and capture book-of-business profile and growth intent
Collect agency application, financials, ownership structure, and E&O certificate
Run background checks, ownership verification, and prior-carrier reference checks
Screen prospect against OFAC, state watchlists, and regulatory action databases
Score candidate on fit criteria and prepare appointment recommendation memo
Route recommendation to distribution leadership for approval decision
Record selection decision in distribution management system
Route approved file to contracting and notify prospect of next steps

subProcesses.name: Producer Contracting & Appointment
steps: Generate producer/agency agreement with commission schedule and binding authority terms
Route agreement for legal review and obtain execution-ready version
Deliver agreement to producer and facilitate e-signature capture
Store executed agreement in producer contract repository
Set up producer code and hierarchy in distribution master and agency management system
Determine state appointment requirements, lines of authority, and fee schedule
Submit appointment transactions to all required states via NIPR
Confirm appointment approval against state DOI status reports
Provision portal access and writing authority to the producer per agreed lines
Finalize executed producer agreement and appointment record and notify field manager

subProcesses.name: Producer License Verification
steps: Verify producer license and lines of authority in PDB before granting binding access
Confirm license is active and covers all product lines and states the producer will write
Check that each licensed line of authority matches the requested writing authority scope
Validate E&O coverage amounts against carrier minimum requirements before activation
Document license verification outcome and attach evidence to producer file
Flag producers with license gaps or mismatched authority for hold pending resolution
Coordinate with producer to obtain missing license credentials or amended appointments
Record license verification completion and release producer file to onboarding workflow

subProcesses.name: Ongoing Producer Compliance Monitoring
steps: Load daily PDB alerts feed and reconcile license status against producer master
Work license expiration and lapse exceptions to resolution within SLA
Process appointment renewals in advance of expiration and pay state fees via NIPR
Initiate appointment terminations for inactive or for-cause producers
Screen producers against OFAC, state watchlists, and regulatory-action databases on schedule
Suspend writing access immediately for non-compliant or sanctioned producers
Notify affected field manager and producer of suspension and remediation requirements
Reinstate access once compliance evidence is confirmed and documented
Conduct annual compliance attestation review for all active producers
Update and certify producer licensing and compliance record each period

subProcesses.name: Producer Onboarding & Activation
steps: Build onboarding plan and milestone checklist for the new producer
Configure portal user accounts, role permissions, and single-sign-on access
Map appetite, products, rating access, and authority limits for the producer's licensed states
Deliver welcome kit, carrier overview, and underwriting guideline package
Walk producer through quoting tools and submission portal during orientation call
Run first-quote shadow session and verify end-to-end submission and issuance workflow
Confirm all onboarding milestones complete and document exceptions
Activate producer for production writing in all licensed and appointed states
Schedule 30-day follow-up call to address early-activation questions
Compile completed producer onboarding and activation package in producer file

subProcesses.name: Producer Training & Certification
steps: Assess producer skill gaps by product line, distribution system, and compliance requirements
Assign curriculum of product, system, and compliance training modules
Publish current product appetite and underwriting guideline content to producer portal
Schedule and deliver live product and system training sessions for new producers
Administer certification assessments and capture individual scores
Issue certificate of completion for passed assessments and update records
Track completion of mandatory modules and escalate overdue participants
Assign refresher training for producers who fail certification thresholds
Deliver training updates for new products, appetite changes, and regulatory requirements
Update producer training and certification record in compliance tracking system

subProcesses.name: Early-Life Producer Engagement & Performance Monitoring
steps: Schedule structured check-in cadence for the producer's first 90 days of production
Review first-submission quality and appetite fit with the assigned field manager
Identify early barriers to production including quoting, rating, or system access issues
Provide targeted coaching or additional training to address identified barriers
Track new-producer submission volume, quote rate, and bind rate against ramp targets
Flag producers not meeting 90-day ramp milestones for field management intervention
Conduct formal 90-day performance review and document outcomes in producer file
Assess whether producer's book profile and appetite alignment meet long-term potential criteria
Escalate underperforming new producers to distribution leadership for go-or-no-go decision
Transition producer from onboarding oversight to steady-state channel management

subProcesses.name: Sales Planning & Quota Administration
steps: Compile prior-year production data by producer, territory, and product line
Develop new-business and renewal sales targets for the planning period
Allocate division-level targets to regions, territories, and individual producers
Negotiate and finalize producer-level quotas with field managers
Load approved quotas into distribution management and CRM systems
Publish quota assignments and pacing dashboards to field managers
Monitor quota attainment against plan each month and identify pacing gaps
Prepare mid-year quota revision recommendations for significant market changes
Document quota-setting methodology and assumptions for audit trail

subProcesses.name: Distribution Sales Operations Support
steps: Maintain producer master data including hierarchy, tier, and writing authority in distribution system
Process producer data changes such as address, E&O renewal, and ownership updates
Respond to producer operational inquiries on portal access, login, and system issues
Coordinate issuance of field-sales tools, rate guides, and marketing kits to producers
Process transfer of producer book-of-business upon retirement or termination
Manage producer off-boarding checklist including access revocation and file archival
Compile weekly distribution operations metrics report for field leadership
Escalate systemic producer support issues to technology and underwriting owners

subProcesses.name: Producer Pipeline & Opportunity Support
steps: Maintain producer-facing opportunity records in CRM with estimated premium and target close date
Support producers in advancing opportunities through defined pipeline stages and logging activities
Review aging and stalled producer opportunities with field managers and reassign as needed
Compile qualified producer opportunity pipeline report for new-business forecasting
Identify pipeline gaps against quota targets and brief field managers on coverage actions
Assist producers with complex account structuring and multi-line opportunity development
Coordinate cross-sell and account-rounding opportunity identification for active producers
Publish producer pipeline health and forward-looking new-business forecast each period

subProcesses.name: Quote-to-Bind Producer Support
steps: Receive producer submission and validate completeness against appetite checklist
Triage submission to appetite and route to the correct underwriting queue
Confirm receipt and provide producer with submission reference and expected turnaround
Resolve producer quoting and rating questions during the active quote phase
Coordinate quote revisions and manage additional-information requests between producer and underwriting
Communicate final quote terms and conditions to producer
Confirm bind decision and capture order-to-bind authorization details
Initiate policy issuance and confirm document delivery to producer
Log bound submission outcomes in CRM and update pipeline forecast
Close and document bound submission support case record with disposition

subProcesses.name: Renewal Retention Support
steps: Generate upcoming 90-day renewal book by producer, product, and segment
Enrich renewal roster with retention scores, loss-ratio signals, and competitor pricing intelligence
Flag at-risk renewals exceeding loss or churn thresholds for priority outreach
Prepare renewal summary and retention talking-point brief for each at-risk account
Brief producers on renewal terms, pricing rationale, and retention messaging
Coordinate remarketing or repricing analysis with underwriting for declining renewals
Track renewal decisions and capture not-renewed reasons in CRM
Escalate high-value non-renewals to distribution leadership for intervention
Compile producer renewal retention performance scorecard by segment
Report renewal outcomes against retention plan and recommend corrective actions

subProcesses.name: Field Sales Enablement & Tools
steps: Define field-sales tools and content needs based on producer feedback and gap analysis
Develop and maintain product guides, rate summaries, and underwriting appetite cards
Build and update competitive comparison sheets and cross-sell playbooks
Publish approved sales tools and resources to the producer portal
Train field managers and producers on new sales tools during rollout
Collect usage analytics and field feedback on sales tool effectiveness
Update and retire outdated tools on a quarterly review cycle
Coordinate with marketing on co-branded collateral for target segments

subProcesses.name: New Business Reporting & Forecasting
steps: Extract bound new-business data from policy admin system each reporting period
Reconcile new-business counts and premium against pipeline forecast
Calculate hit ratio, submission-to-quote, and quote-to-bind conversion rates
Analyze new-business mix by line, territory, channel, and producer tier
Identify variance drivers against plan and prior period
Prepare new-business performance narrative for distribution leadership review
Generate rolling 90-day new-business forecast by territory and channel
Distribute new-business scorecard and forecast to senior distribution management

subProcesses.name: Lead Capture & Data Quality
steps: Define lead source taxonomy and capture standards across digital, producer, and referral channels
Configure CRM lead intake forms and API integrations for all active lead sources
Capture inbound leads from all channels into CRM with source and campaign attribution
Deduplicate incoming leads against existing CRM contacts and opportunities
Validate lead data completeness against required fields for routing and scoring
Enrich lead records with demographic, firmographic, and third-party insurance data
Flag and remediate leads with data-quality failures before scoring
Archive rejected or unqualifiable leads with disposition reason for analysis

subProcesses.name: Lead Scoring & Qualification
steps: Define lead-scoring model rules based on demographic, behavioral, and intent signals
Apply lead-scoring rules to rank each lead on conversion readiness

steps: Assign risk class and table rating using company underwriting manual and actuarial guidelines
Apply flat extra premium per thousand for temporary or permanent extra mortality factors
Refer cases exceeding company retention limit to treaty reinsurer for risk classification concurrence
Render standard, rated, modified offer, or declination decision
Issue adverse action notice and report MIB codes as required by HIPAA and state insurance regulations
Prepare counteroffer communication specifying modified terms acceptable to company
Communicate underwriting offer to producer with acceptance deadline and conditional requirements
Document final underwriting decision rationale and applicable regulatory reporting in case file

subProcesses.name: Financial Underwriting & Anti-Selection Controls
steps: Assess whether requested coverage amount is justified by demonstrated insurable interest and financial need
Apply income multiples and net worth guidelines to determine maximum insurable amount
Review business insurance cases for buy-sell valuation adequacy and key person justification
Detect and flag potential indicators of speculative purchasing, stacking, or STOLI arrangements
Consult financial underwriting specialist for cases with complex ownership or unusual beneficiary structures
Determine appropriate policy structure to mitigate anti-selection risk
Document financial underwriting rationale and sources relied upon in case record
Escalate confirmed STOLI or fraud indicators to Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and compliance

subProcesses.name: Account Pricing & Rate Application
steps: Select applicable rating plan, form, and endorsement set for the coverage being priced
Retrieve actuarially approved base rates and rating factors from the current rate filing
Apply experience modification factors derived from insured loss history to the base rate
Apply schedule rating credits or debits based on risk quality attributes identified in underwriting analysis
Calculate final account premium by applying all rating factors to the exposure base
Calculate minimum premium and assess adequacy against expense and loss load targets
Determine acceptable price floor for the account aligned with portfolio profitability targets
Record rate application derivation in pricing tool and underwriting file for audit trail

subProcesses.name: Terms & Conditions Determination
steps: Select primary policy form and applicable jurisdiction-specific endorsements
Determine coverage limits, sublimits, and per-occurrence vs. aggregate structures
Set deductible levels and assess co-insurance or self-insured retention structures
Identify and apply exclusions required by underwriting guidelines or reinsurance treaty terms
Confirm war, terrorism (TRIA), cyber, and other critical exclusions are correctly applied
Review manuscript or bespoke wording requests and escalate to coverage counsel if required
Align conditions and warranties with loss control recommendations and inspection findings
Finalize terms and conditions package for inclusion in quote documentation

subProcesses.name: Authority Level Determination
steps: Identify applicable underwriting authority schedule for the line of business and product
Confirm assigned underwriter's authority level against premium size, limit, and risk complexity
Determine whether risk requires referral to senior underwriter, underwriting manager, or specialty desk
Apply aggregation and accumulation checks to determine portfolio-level capacity constraints
Assess whether emerging risk categories or novel coverage structures require chief underwriter sign-off
Document authority assessment rationale in underwriting file before advancing to pricing stage
Confirm reinsurance treaty authority conditions are satisfied before proceeding without facultative
Record authority level used on each transaction in system for audit and compliance reporting

subProcesses.name: Referral Preparation & Submission
steps: Prepare referral memorandum summarizing risk profile, exposure analysis, and proposed terms
Attach supporting documents: loss runs, inspection reports, pricing model output, and proposed wording
Identify specific approval requirements: premium endorsement, limit deviation, or appetite exception
Route referral to appropriate authority holder via workflow system with priority flag
Set response deadline aligned with broker quote deadline and internal SLA
Track referral status and follow up with authority holder if response is overdue
Receive and document referral decision with any conditions or modifications required
Return approved referral to originating underwriter with clear implementation instructions

subProcesses.name: Senior Underwriter & Chief Underwriter Review
steps: Conduct independent review of risk analysis, pricing rationale, and proposed terms
Challenge assumptions in the underwriting narrative and request additional analysis where gaps exist
Apply portfolio perspective to assess whether risk aligns with current strategy and accumulation position
Confirm compliance with treaty terms, form filing requirements, and regulatory constraints
Approve, modify, or decline referral with written rationale documented in underwriting system
Set conditions on approval where additional information or loss control commitment is required
Communicate approval decision and any conditions to referring underwriter within agreed timeframe
Retain referral record for regulatory inspection, reinsurance audit, and internal governance review

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Capacity & Facultative Assessment
steps: Determine whether risk falls within treaty automatic acceptance criteria
Calculate net and gross line positions relative to treaty retention layers
Identify need for facultative reinsurance support based on line size or class restrictions
Prepare facultative submission package for placement with reinsurers
Negotiate facultative terms and pricing with reinsurers or through reinsurance brokers
Confirm reinsurance capacity secured before issuing binding authority to underwriter
Record reinsurance participation details in policy administration system
Coordinate with reinsurance accounting for premium cession and reporting obligations

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Referral & Concurrent Underwriting
steps: Submit excess-retention life or P&C cases to treaty reinsurer for concurrent underwriting review
Provide reinsurer with complete case file including all evidence and underwriting analysis
Manage communications between reinsurer and internal underwriting team throughout review period
Reconcile differences between internal risk assessment and reinsurer's classification or pricing view
Negotiate reinsurer's terms and obtain final concurrence on rate and table rating for life cases
Document reinsurer's decision and participation percentage in policy administration system
Ensure facultative certificate or treaty cession documentation is completed before binding
Coordinate reinsurance premium cession and bordereau reporting with reinsurance accounting team

subProcesses.name: Appetite Exception & Deviation Tracking
steps: Log all appetite exceptions and guideline deviations in the exception register
Capture deviation type, approving authority, reason, and associated premium for management reporting
Aggregate exception data monthly to identify systemic guideline gaps requiring product management response
Review exception patterns with chief underwriter and product management in quarterly appetite review
Update underwriting guidelines to reflect approved exceptions that represent strategic appetite expansion
Confirm exceptions granted on a one-time basis are not recurrently applied without re-approval
Report material appetite exceptions to the underwriting governance committee for oversight
Archive exception documentation for reinsurance audit and regulatory examination access

subProcesses.name: Replacement & Suitability Review (Life)
steps: Identify replacement activity using 1035 exchange documentation and replacement notice forms
Issue state-required replacement notices to applicant and existing insurer within regulatory timeframes
Review replacement rationale for suitability: compare existing and proposed policy values and costs
Conduct best-interest assessment in accordance with NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation
Perform supervisory review of suitability determination by licensed insurance supervisor
Document disposition of replacement review including approval or escalation rationale
Escalate cases with potential churning or unsuitable replacement indicators to compliance
Retain replacement review documentation in policy file for state regulatory examination access

subProcesses.name: Indicative Pricing & Pre-Quote Assessment
steps: Receive broker request for budget indication or ballpark pricing before formal submission
Review high-level risk characteristics against appetite and current market rate levels
Apply indicative rate range to stated exposure base to derive preliminary premium indication
Communicate indicative pricing to broker with clear caveat that formal quote requires full submission
Note any coverage or terms assumptions underpinning the indication in the underwriting file
Record indication in workflow system and set follow-up to receive formal submission
Update indication if broker provides refined exposure data or revised coverage structure
Confirm indication does not constitute a binding commitment and expires within stated timeframe

subProcesses.name: Quote Preparation & Quality Review
steps: Prepare quote package including coverage summary, premium, terms, conditions, and applicable endorsements
Populate quote from approved rating model output and ensure all pricing components are reflected
Conduct quality review of quote for arithmetic accuracy, form selection, and limit and deductible correctness
Confirm all required regulatory disclosures and state-mandated notices are included in quote package
Verify that quote does not exceed underwriter's authority level without required referral approval on file
Cross-check policy wording selections against current approved and filed form library
Obtain second underwriter review for large or complex accounts per large-account peer review guidelines
Release quote to broker via portal, email, or agency management system with stated expiry date

subProcesses.name: Multi-Risk & Package Quote Coordination
steps: Identify all lines of business required in a package or multi-risk submission
Coordinate pricing across property, liability, and specialty lines desks to produce a unified package quote
Resolve inter-line coverage overlaps, gaps, and cross-liability provisions within the package structure
Apply package discount or surcharge in accordance with approved packaging guidelines
Confirm all participating lines have issued their own authority approval before releasing combined quote
Prepare combined quote document presenting all lines in a single client-facing format
Assign lead underwriter as single point of contact for broker negotiations on package accounts
Document package composition and each line's contribution to the total premium in the underwriting file

subProcesses.name: Broker Negotiation & Quote Revision
steps: Receive broker response: acceptance, rejection, or counter-proposal with alternative terms requested
Assess broker's counter-proposal against pricing floor, treaty constraints, and appetite guidelines
Obtain re-approval from referral authority if revised terms require a higher authority sign-off
Revise quote with modified terms within authority and reissue to broker with updated expiry date
Document negotiation history and final agreed terms in underwriting file
Manage competing market scenarios by assessing price adequacy against broker's market alternatives
Set final negotiation position with management input for strategic accounts above premium threshold
Communicate final binding terms to broker confirming no further amendments will be accepted

subProcesses.name: Quote Expiry & Re-pricing Management
steps: Monitor quote expiry diary and identify quotes approaching or past their stated expiry date
Contact broker to determine whether expired quote requires renewal, withdrawal, or re-pricing
Re-underwrite account using current rate levels and any updated risk information received since original quote
Apply current market rate changes or appetite shifts to the re-priced quote as appropriate
Obtain required referral approval if re-priced terms deviate materially from the original quote
Issue revised quote to broker with new expiry date and document rate change rationale
Close and archive quotes where broker confirms they are no longer pursuing coverage
Report quote pipeline aging and re-quote rates in underwriting workflow management metrics

subProcesses.name: Non-Converted Quote Closure & Analysis
steps: Identify quotes that have lapsed without a bind instruction beyond the grace period
Contact broker to confirm the reason for non-conversion: price, coverage terms, competitor, or client decision
Record non-conversion reason code in underwriting system for win-loss analytics
Assess whether non-conversion reflects a systematic pricing or appetite competitiveness issue
Close non-converted quote file and archive with all supporting documentation
Flag accounts lost to competitors for market intelligence review by underwriting management
Aggregate non-conversion data by LOB, geography, and reason code for quarterly appetite and pricing review
Report win-loss trends to underwriting management and product management for rate and appetite calibration

subProcesses.name: Bind Conditions Verification
steps: Receive broker's bind request or binder instruction from insured or MGA
Confirm quote has not expired and all conditions attached to the quote have been satisfied
Verify broker's license and appointment are current and valid for the state and line of business
Confirm that any required loss control conditions, inspection commitments, or warranties are documented
Verify reinsurance capacity confirmation is in place before executing bind for large or complex risks
Confirm premium finance or payment terms are agreed and premium deposit is committed
Check sanctions and watchlist status one final time against current bind date
Obtain required co-underwriter or partner sign-off for syndicated or shared-line programs

subProcesses.name: Policy Binding & Execution
steps: Execute bind in underwriting or policy administration system recording effective date and time
Generate binder or evidence of insurance and deliver to broker within agreed turnaround time
Notify policy administration team to initiate policy document generation and system setup
Notify billing team to generate premium invoice and establish installment schedule if applicable
Notify reinsurance accounting team of cession details for bordereau and treaty reporting
Update broker portal and CRM with bound status and key policy identifiers
Close the underwriting quote file and link to active policy record in system
Set renewal diary date in underwriting system based on policy expiry date

subProcesses.name: Premium Invoice & Payment Processing
steps: Generate premium invoice detailing gross premium, taxes, fees, and net amount payable to carrier
Issue invoice to insured or premium finance company with payment due date per policy terms
Record payment commitment and instalment schedule in billing system
Monitor premium receipt against due dates and initiate follow-up for overdue accounts
Apply received premium payments to the correct policy record and confirm allocation in system
Process premium adjustments arising from endorsements, audits, or exposure changes during the policy term
Escalate chronic non-payment situations to underwriting management for cancellation consideration
Confirm final premium settlement and close premium receivable record at policy expiry or cancellation

subProcesses.name: Policy Schedule Generation & Delivery
steps: Trigger policy schedule generation in policy administration system following confirmed bind
Verify policy schedule for accuracy: named insured, coverages, limits, deductibles, endorsements, and premium
Confirm all mandatory state disclosures, regulatory notices, and coverage selection forms are included
Prepare and dispatch policy package to insured and producing broker via agreed delivery channel
Obtain delivery confirmation or signed acknowledgement where required by state regulation
Record policy issuance date and delivery confirmation in policy administration system
Handle policy correction requests from broker or insured arising from schedule errors within rectification window
Archive final policy documents and confirm records retention period is set per policy management procedures

subProcesses.name: Life Policy Issuance & Delivery
steps: Prepare policy contract for issue and calculate initial premium based on approved underwriting offer
Generate policy contract document and required regulatory disclosure package
Confirm all delivery requirements are received: delivery receipt, amendment acceptance, and outstanding forms
Deliver policy contract to insured or producer per state delivery receipt requirements
Place policy in force in policy administration system and trigger commission payment to producer
Confirm free-look period start date is recorded and communicated to policyholder
Process free-look cancellation requests and issue refund of premium within required timeframe
Hand off completed case to policy administration team and close underwriting file

subProcesses.name: Post-Bind Documentation & Handoff
steps: Complete underwriting file checklist ensuring all required documents are present and signed
Upload signed application, final quote, bind confirmation, and reinsurance documents to document management system
Record final premium, commission, and reinsurance cession data in underwriting system
Transmit policy data to policy administration system via integration or manual data entry for issuance
Confirm policy issuance system has generated correct policy number and schedule of coverage
Notify claims team of any special conditions, warranty clauses, or coverage restrictions on the policy
Distribute welcome kit and producer correspondence as required by the product and channel
Archive closed underwriting file and confirm retention period is set per records management policy

subProcesses.name: Renewal Strategy & Portfolio Planning
steps: Pull renewal listing 90-120 days in advance of expiry sorted by premium size and strategic priority
Assess prior-year underwriting performance and loss development for each renewal account
Define renewal pricing strategy: target rate change, coverage modification, or non-renewal recommendation
Identify accounts requiring senior underwriter or management approval for renewal strategy
Align renewal strategy with current appetite guidelines and portfolio optimization objectives
Communicate renewal strategy to producing broker or agent with early engagement for strategic accounts
Set individual renewal rate change targets consistent with portfolio-level actuarial indications
Monitor renewal retention rate and premium change against plan throughout the renewal cycle

subProcesses.name: Renewal Underwriting & Re-rating
steps: Obtain updated risk information from broker including updated values, payroll, revenue, or exposure bases
Review loss activity during the expiring policy period and assess impact on renewal pricing
Re-underwrite account using current appetite guidelines and updated loss history
Apply current rate level to renewal exposure base and compare to expiring premium
Determine whether risk quality changes require coverage modifications, exclusions, or deductible changes
Prepare renewal quote and obtain referral approval if renewal terms deviate from expiring policy
Issue renewal quote to broker with adequate lead time for broker negotiation before expiry
Document renewal analysis rationale and rate change justification in underwriting file

subProcesses.name: Renewal Retention & Broker Negotiation
steps: Receive broker response to renewal quote: acceptance, counter-proposal, or indication of competing terms
Assess broker's counter-proposal against renewal pricing floor and portfolio retention objectives
Obtain re-approval from referral authority where revised renewal terms require higher authority sign-off
Revise renewal quote within authority and reissue to broker with updated terms and expiry date
Escalate strategic account renewals to underwriting management for final retention decision
Document negotiation history and final agreed renewal terms in underwriting file
Confirm binding instructions received before expiry and execute renewal bind in underwriting system
Record renewal retention outcome and rate change achieved against plan targets in performance system

subProcesses.name: Mid-Term Endorsement & Adjustment Processing
steps: Receive endorsement request from broker: exposure change, coverage addition, or policy correction
Validate endorsement request against in-force policy terms and underwriting authority
Calculate additional or return premium for the endorsement effective and expiry period
Assess whether endorsement changes require referral to higher authority given revised risk profile
Obtain required authority approval and document in endorsement file before executing change
Issue endorsement document to broker and confirm delivery to insured
Update policy administration system with revised coverage details, exposures, and premium
Notify reinsurance accounting of any mid-term cession adjustments arising from the endorsement

subProcesses.name: Non-Renewal & Cancellation Management
steps: Identify policies scheduled for non-renewal based on underwriting performance, appetite change, or risk quality
Confirm required statutory notice period for non-renewal by state and line of business
Issue non-renewal notice to insured and producing broker within required regulatory notice timeframe
Document non-renewal rationale in underwriting file for regulatory inspection and broker communication
Process mid-term cancellation requests received from insured or broker with required notice documentation
Calculate return premium due on cancellation using pro-rata or short-rate method per policy terms
Notify billing, reinsurance accounting, and claims teams of policy cancellation effective date
Archive cancelled or non-renewed policy file and confirm records retention period is set

subProcesses.name: Policy Reinstatement Management
steps: Receive reinstatement request from insured or broker following policy lapse or cancellation for non-payment
Confirm elapsed time since cancellation is within the reinstatement eligibility window per policy terms and state rules
Review any loss activity or material risk changes that occurred during the lapsed period
Obtain outstanding premium payment or payment commitment as a precondition for reinstatement
Assess whether reinstatement requires underwriting approval or health evidence for life policies
Execute reinstatement in policy administration system with correct retroactive or prospective effective date
Issue reinstatement confirmation to insured and broker documenting any coverage gap during lapsed period
Notify billing and reinsurance accounting of reinstated policy and any premium adjustments required

subProcesses.name: Coverholder & MGA Due Diligence
steps: Receive partner application from prospective coverholder, MGA, or program administrator
Verify licensing and credentials in NIPR and state DOI records for all applicable states and lines
Screen partner entity and key principals for sanctions, OFAC, and financial crime indicators
Assess financial stability using audited accounts, E&O coverage confirmation, and credit assessment
Evaluate performance history including loss ratios, claims handling record, and prior carrier references
Assess operational capabilities: systems, staffing, compliance infrastructure, and data reporting ability
Compile due diligence pack and submit to delegated authority underwriting committee for review
Approve and onboard partner or communicate declination with documented rationale

subProcesses.name: Delegated Authority Terms & Control Design
steps: Define underwriting appetite and product parameters to be delegated to the partner
Establish authority limits by class, policy limit, premium size, and geographic territory
Define claims handling authority and TPA arrangements including claims reporting thresholds
Design control framework including binding conditions, co-sign requirements, and referral triggers
Specify bordereaux reporting requirements: frequency, data fields, format, and submission deadlines
Draft delegated authority agreement incorporating all underwriting, compliance, and reporting terms
Obtain legal review and regulatory compliance sign-off on agreement terms and form filings
Execute agreement with partner following approval by delegated authority governance committee

subProcesses.name: Bordereaux Receipt & Validation
steps: Receive premium and claims bordereaux submissions from coverholders on agreed reporting cycle
Validate bordereaux data completeness against specified field requirements and submission checklist
Run automated data quality checks: field format, coverage type codes, premium calculation accuracy
Identify and log data exceptions for follow-up with coverholder data team
Reconcile bordereau premium totals to premium settlements received from coverholder or broker
Investigate and resolve premium reconciliation differences within agreed resolution timeframe
Load validated bordereaux data into policy administration and actuarial systems for analysis
Report to governance on bordereaux timeliness, quality scores, and outstanding submission deficiencies

subProcesses.name: Delegated Authority Performance Monitoring
steps: Analyze coverholder performance KPIs: loss ratio, premium volume, policy count, and claims frequency
Review portfolio mix against agreed appetite profile and flag class or geographic drift
Conduct control testing to verify coverholders are operating within defined authority terms
Review claims handling performance against SLA commitments and settlement authority compliance
Document exceptions identified during monitoring with remediation action and responsible owner
Produce quarterly performance scorecard for each coverholder and circulate to underwriting leadership
Escalate persistent underperformance or systemic control failures to delegated authority committee
Update performance monitoring record and link to next authority renewal assessment

subProcesses.name: Coverholder Audit & Authority Renewal
steps: Conduct scheduled on-site or desk-based authority audit against agreed audit scope and protocol
Test compliance with underwriting guidelines, authority limits, and control framework requirements
Communicate audit findings report to coverholder with categorized findings: critical, major, minor
Obtain coverholder response and remediation plan with committed closure dates for each finding
Track remediation progress against plan and re-test closed findings for evidence of resolution
Assess overall partner performance and compliance record in advance of authority renewal decision
Renew, modify, or terminate authority based on performance, compliance, and strategic fit assessment
Archive audit findings, remediation evidence, and renewal decision for regulatory and Lloyd's oversight access

subProcesses.name: Coverholder Offboarding & Run-Off Management
steps: Notify coverholder of authority termination decision with required contractual notice period
Cease new business binding under delegated authority effective from termination date
Transition in-force policies to direct underwriting or alternative delegated authority arrangement
Obtain final bordereaux submissions covering all in-force policies written during the authority period
Reconcile all outstanding premium settlements and recover overpaid commission where applicable
Settle outstanding claims within run-off management framework and monitor to final resolution
Confirm regulatory notification obligations are met including Lloyd's syndicate reporting where applicable
Archive complete coverholder file and confirm records retention schedule per regulatory requirements

subProcesses.name: Portfolio Performance Monitoring & Reporting
steps: Compile monthly portfolio metrics including written premium, in-force premium, and new business volumes by LOB
Calculate loss ratios, combined ratios, and expense ratios at portfolio and segment level
Analyze frequency and severity trends by class, geography, construction type, or customer segment
Identify underperforming segments using actuarial loss development and profitability analysis
Benchmark portfolio performance against plan, prior year, and market loss indices
Prepare underwriting performance dashboard for distribution to business unit and executive leadership
Communicate portfolio trends and emerging risks to chief underwriter and product management
Archive portfolio reports for regulatory examination, board reporting, and reinsurance treaty reviews

subProcesses.name: Catastrophe & Accumulation Management
steps: Maintain real-time catastrophe accumulation monitoring by peril zone, state, and county
Run catastrophe model scenarios using RMS, AIR, or equivalent platform to assess PML and TVaR
Monitor aggregate exposure against treaty and facultative treaty attachment points and per-occurrence limits
Set CAT sublimits, per-risk and per-occurrence limits aligned with reinsurance program structure
Conduct post-event exposure assessment following named storms, earthquakes, or wildfire events
Produce CRESTA zone accumulation reports for internal governance and reinsurer reporting
Adjust CAT underwriting guidelines where accumulations approach internal or reinsurance thresholds
Report aggregate CAT exposure to the CUO and risk management committee on a quarterly basis

subProcesses.name: Appetite & Portfolio Concentration Monitoring
steps: Monitor in-force portfolio composition against current appetite parameters by class, geography, and limit profile
Identify concentration risks and segments where portfolio mix is drifting outside appetite boundaries
Assess impact of new business flow on portfolio aggregate exposure and diversification targets
Produce appetite utilization report showing headroom and consumed capacity by risk category
Flag emerging portfolio trends to chief underwriter for appetite guideline review consideration
Coordinate with actuarial to validate portfolio profitability assumptions against developing loss data
Track appetite utilization against reinsurance treaty capacity limits and aggregate retention thresholds
Report portfolio composition and appetite status to underwriting governance committee each quarter

subProcesses.name: Appetite & Guideline Management
steps: Review and update underwriting appetite statements annually and following material market events
Translate appetite statements into specific guideline parameters: class codes, geographic restrictions, and limit caps
Issue underwriting bulletins and guideline amendments to underwriting teams via intranet and communication channels
Monitor compliance with appetite guidelines using policy data analytics and exception reporting
Assess impact of new product launches, regulatory changes, and market dislocations on appetite parameters
Conduct quarterly appetite review with product management, actuarial, and reinsurance teams
Document appetite decisions and rationale for regulatory and reinsurance inspection purposes
Retire deprecated appetite guidelines and archive with effective-date versioning for historical audit use

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Program Administration
steps: Maintain reinsurance treaty schedule including layers, limits, retentions, and participating reinsurers
Calculate bordereau premiums and losses ceded under proportional treaty arrangements
Prepare and submit quarterly and annual reinsurance bordereaux to treaty reinsurers on schedule
Monitor reinsurer financial strength ratings and escalate downgrades to treasury and risk management
Support reinsurance renewal preparation by providing actuarial data, exposure profiles, and loss runs
Track inward and outward facultative certificates and confirm cession accounting is complete
Respond to reinsurer audit requests and treaty compliance queries within agreed response windows
Report net and gross loss positions to finance for financial statement preparation and capital modeling

subProcesses.name: Delegated Authority Aggregate Oversight
steps: Maintain register of active coverholders, MGAs, and TPAs with current authority limits and expiry dates
Monitor delegated authority production volumes against agreed capacity limits and appetites
Review aggregate delegated authority exposure against treaty and company risk tolerance thresholds
Escalate breaches of delegated authority limits to underwriting management for immediate remediation
Assess geographic and class concentration within delegated authority portfolios against company guidelines
Produce delegated authority performance reports for Lloyd's or carrier oversight and governance bodies
Coordinate with actuarial to incorporate delegated authority results in IBNR reserving and pricing reviews
Initiate capacity reduction or authority withdrawal where portfolio performance deteriorates beyond tolerance

subProcesses.name: Underwriting Quality Assurance
steps: Define quality assurance sampling methodology including random and targeted review criteria
Select policy sample from bound book for quality review using risk-stratified sampling approach
Review sampled policies against underwriting guidelines: rate adequacy, form selection, and authority compliance
Score each reviewed policy against quality rubric and record findings in quality assurance log
Identify systemic errors including rating mistakes, form misapplication, or guideline deviations
Communicate individual findings to underwriters for corrective action and training follow-up
Escalate systemic quality issues to underwriting management with root cause analysis
Produce quarterly quality assurance report with trend analysis and improvement recommendations

subProcesses.name: Underwriting Audit & Compliance Review
steps: Plan annual underwriting audit program covering all lines of business and distribution channels
Conduct pre-audit data analysis to identify high-risk segments and anomalies for targeted file review
Execute file-based audit testing authority compliance, documentation standards, and policy accuracy
Assess regulatory compliance including state-specific form filing, rate filing, and disclosure requirements
Produce audit report with findings categorized by severity and required remediation timelines
Present audit findings to chief underwriting officer and compliance committee
Track remediation of audit findings with evidence of closure documentation required
Confirm repeat findings trigger escalation to board risk committee and enhanced monitoring program

subProcesses.name: Underwriting Performance Benchmarking
steps: Define underwriter-level performance metrics: quote-to-bind ratio, premium written, rate change achieved, and loss ratio
Extract individual and team performance data from underwriting and policy administration systems
Benchmark individual underwriter results against peer group, regional, and divisional targets
Identify top and bottom quartile performers and assess contributing factors for each cohort
Review underwriter authority utilization rates and referral frequency as efficiency indicators
Present performance benchmarking results to underwriting managers for coaching and development action
Adjust performance targets and incentive criteria based on market conditions and portfolio mix
Archive performance benchmarking records for HR calibration, succession planning, and compensation reviews

subProcesses.name: Regulatory Filing & Form Compliance
steps: Maintain inventory of all filed policy forms, endorsements, and rate filings by state and line of business
Monitor state DOI bulletins and legislative changes requiring new filings or form amendments
Prepare and submit rate and form filings to state regulators within required prior-approval or file-and-use timeframes
Track filing status through regulatory review and respond to DOI objections or information requests
Confirm approval received before deploying new or amended forms in the underwriting workflow
Update approved form library and rating tools following filing approval and communicate changes to underwriters
Conduct periodic compliance review to confirm in-force policies use currently approved and filed forms
Archive regulatory correspondence and approval records for examination and audit access

subProcesses.name: Underwriting Training & Development
steps: Assess underwriter competency gaps using quality assurance findings, audit results, and performance data
Design or procure technical training programs covering rating, coverage, forms, and risk analysis
Deliver product-specific and line-of-business training for new products or coverage expansions
Conduct authority progression assessments to evaluate readiness for increased underwriting limits
Maintain continuing education records for licensed underwriters to meet state CE requirements
Facilitate cross-training rotations for underwriters across specialty lines and primary lines
Conduct post-training knowledge assessments and track improvement in quality assurance scores
Maintain underwriting competency framework and succession plan for critical underwriting roles

subProcesses.name: Underwriting Governance & Reporting
steps: Prepare underwriting governance pack for quarterly underwriting committee meeting including performance, appetite, and audit summaries
Consolidate exception reports, authority deviation logs, and quality assurance findings for committee review
Present portfolio profitability, rate adequacy, and reserve development updates to senior leadership
Track governance committee decisions and action items through to completion with assigned owners
Produce board-level underwriting risk report summarizing material exposures, emerging risks, and appetite utilization
Maintain underwriting policy and standards documentation with version control and scheduled review dates
Coordinate with risk management and actuarial to align underwriting governance with enterprise risk framework
Archive governance meeting minutes, committee papers, and approved policy documents per records retention schedule

subProcesses.name: Strategic & Long-Range Planning
steps: Facilitate strategic planning sessions to confirm multi-year growth and margin targets
Translate strategic priorities into financial assumptions for 3-to-5-year model
Model scenarios for organic growth, M&A, and market stress across planning horizon
Integrate actuarial loss development projections into long-range plan
Stress-test plan against regulatory capital requirements and rating agency metrics
Prepare board-level long-range financial outlook with scenario narratives
Obtain board and executive approval of long-range plan
Cascade approved plan targets into business-unit performance agreements
Monitor long-range plan milestones quarterly and update assumptions
Document planning assumptions and methodology for audit and governance trail

subProcesses.name: Annual Budget Development
steps: Issue planning guidelines, assumptions, and calendar to all business units
Distribute budget templates and confirm prior-year actuals as baseline
Develop department-level expense budgets aligned to headcount and projects
Project premium volume, loss ratios, and underwriting margin by line of business
Consolidate departmental submissions into enterprise-wide budget draft
Review and challenge submissions in structured FP&A dialogue with department heads
Incorporate approved adjustments and rebalance to target capital return
Approve final budget and communicate allocations to business unit CFOs
Load approved budget into planning system and lock baseline version
Publish budget-to-actuals variance tracking framework for monthly monitoring

subProcesses.name: Rolling Forecast & Reforecast
steps: Pull latest actuals from GL and subledgers at each forecast cycle open
Update premium, claims, and expense drivers based on current pipeline data
Refresh loss reserve estimates with actuarial input for reserve adequacy
Model investment income projections using current portfolio duration and yield
Consolidate rolling 12-month forecast across all business units
Perform variance analysis comparing forecast to budget and prior forecast
Identify key forecast risks and opportunities and quantify sensitivities
Present reforecast to CFO and executive team for review and challenge
Obtain sign-off and distribute final forecast to business unit leaders
Archive forecast version and update comparative reporting database

subProcesses.name: Management Reporting & Variance Analysis
steps: Extract period actuals from GL, billing, and claims subledgers
Calculate budget-to-actual and prior-year-to-actual variances by cost center
Prepare combined ratio analysis including loss ratio, expense ratio, and LAE
Prepare management P&L and balance sheet package with commentary
Produce segment and line-of-business profitability reports
Draft CFO narrative explaining key variances and underlying business drivers
Distribute draft management pack to finance business partners for review
Incorporate feedback and finalize management reporting package
Present financial results in leadership operating review
Archive signed management reports and distribute to board reporting team

subProcesses.name: Business Performance Partnering
steps: Assign dedicated finance business partners to each business unit
Conduct monthly performance review meetings with business unit leadership
Analyze underwriting and operational KPIs to surface profitability insights
Develop ad hoc financial models to support pricing and product decisions
Quantify financial impact of proposed operational changes or investments
Track cost-efficiency and productivity metrics against benchmarks
Provide financial input to business cases for capital expenditure approval
Summarize business unit financial performance in monthly partner briefings
Escalate material financial risks or opportunities identified in partnering reviews
Maintain finance business partner playbook and standard model library

subProcesses.name: Cost Allocation & Transfer Pricing
steps: Define corporate overhead allocation methodology and drivers for the planning year
Obtain CFO and business unit approval of cost allocation methodology
Execute monthly allocation runs distributing shared-service costs to business units
Calculate intercompany management fees and service charges for affiliated entities
Prepare transfer pricing documentation supporting intercompany arrangements
Reconcile allocated costs to source cost centers and resolve variances
Communicate cost allocation results to business unit finance contacts
Review allocation methodology annually and update for organizational changes
Ensure transfer pricing policies comply with applicable tax regulations
Archive allocation workpapers for audit and regulatory examination

subProcesses.name: Capital Expenditure Governance
steps: Publish annual CapEx submission guidelines and approval thresholds
Collect CapEx requests and standardize business case format
Conduct financial analysis of proposed investments including NPV and payback
Prioritize CapEx portfolio against strategic plan and available capital budget
Present CapEx recommendations to investment committee for approval
Release approved CapEx authorizations to project and technology teams
Track CapEx spend against approved budget on a monthly basis
Review project milestones and escalate cost overruns to leadership
Conduct post-implementation reviews to assess realized vs. forecast benefits
Report CapEx utilization to CFO and board finance committee

subProcesses.name: Invoice & Receivable Creation
steps: Receive bound policy data from policy administration system
Apply premium rating schedules and endorsement adjustments to invoice calculations
Generate premium invoices for direct billed and agency billed policies
Validate invoice accuracy against policy terms and rating engine output
Issue invoice to policyholder or agency and create accounts receivable record
Handle billing exceptions including mid-term endorsements and cancellations
Record deferred premium liability for unearned premium on the balance sheet
Reconcile daily invoice issuance to policy administration system counts
Distribute invoices through preferred delivery channel (mail, email, portal)
Archive invoice records and update receivable aging schedule

subProcesses.name: Premium Receivable Accounting
steps: Record gross written premium to the premium receivable and unearned premium accounts at policy inception
Process mid-term endorsement and audit premium adjustments to open receivable balances
Recognize earned premium on a daily pro-rata or other actuarially approved basis each period
Transfer earned premium credits from unearned premium liability to written premium income
Apply installment billing schedules to receivable ledger and confirm balance against policy terms
Identify and resolve receivable postings where policy cancellation creates an overpayment credit
Reconcile premium receivable subledger to general ledger control account at period end
Prepare premium receivable roll-forward schedule showing inception, adjustments, cash received, and balance
Review and age receivable balances by policy, agent, and line of business for reporting
Archive premium receivable workpapers for financial close and regulatory examination

subProcesses.name: Cash Application & Suspense Resolution
steps: Receive daily payment files from lockbox, EFT, and online payment channels
Match incoming payments to open invoices using policy number and amount
Apply matched cash to accounts receivable and update receivable balance
Identify unmatched payments and post to suspense account with reference data
Research suspense items using payment remittance, policyholder inquiry, and agent contact
Resolve and clear suspense items by applying to correct invoice or returning funds
Process premium refunds for cancelled policies and screen disbursements against OFAC
Monitor stale suspense items exceeding defined aging threshold
Initiate escheat process for unclaimed funds meeting dormancy criteria
Reconcile daily cash receipts to bank statement and GL clearing account

subProcesses.name: Agent & Broker Account Reconciliation
steps: Extract agency bill receivable balances by agent and broker from premium subledger
Obtain agent account statements and remittance advices for the reconciliation period
Match agency remittances to billed premium invoices and identify unremitted balances
Identify net debit and net credit agent accounts and classify by aging bucket
Send account reconciliation statements to agents and brokers for confirmation
Resolve disputed items through documented follow-up with agency contacts
Escalate unresolved debit balances exceeding defined thresholds to agency management
Post accounting adjustments for agreed reconciliation items and approved write-offs
Confirm adjusted agent account balances reconcile to GL control account
Archive agent reconciliation workpapers and correspondence for audit

subProcesses.name: Billing-to-Ledger Reconciliation
steps: Extract end-of-period subledger balances from billing system
Extract corresponding GL balances from the premium receivable and earned premium accounts
Perform automated three-way reconciliation comparing billing subledger to GL
Identify reconciling items including timing differences and posting errors
Research each variance using billing system transaction history and GL journal detail
Clear reconciling items through correcting journal entries or system adjustments
Prepare billing reconciliation support package for financial close
Obtain Controller sign-off on completed billing-to-ledger reconciliation
Report reconciliation results and unresolved items to close management team
Archive reconciliation workpapers for internal audit and external examination

subProcesses.name: Delinquency Monitoring & Receivables Collections
steps: Generate accounts receivable aging reports from premium billing subledger
Identify delinquent policyholder and agency receivable balances by age bucket
Issue first dunning notice to delinquent accounts at defined aging threshold
Conduct follow-up outreach and document contact outcomes in collections log
Establish payment arrangements for delinquent accounts meeting eligibility criteria
Issue statutory non-payment cancellation notice per state regulatory requirements
Monitor cancellation notice cure period and confirm payment receipt or cancellation execution
Approve and process receivable write-offs for uncollectable balances per write-off policy
Escalate severely delinquent agency balances to external collection agency or legal counsel
Maintain delinquency metrics report and present receivable quality trends to Finance management

subProcesses.name: Subledger Close & Journal Entry Processing
steps: Publish monthly close calendar with subledger cutoff deadlines
Close premium and billing subledger and transfer balances to GL
Close claims payment and reserve subledger and transfer to GL
Close investment accounting subledger and transfer trade and income entries
Close fixed asset and depreciation subledger
Prepare and post standard recurring journal entries from template library
Prepare and post accruals for expenses, premiums earned, and loss reserves
Prepare and post eliminations for intercompany balances
Validate journal entries through automated three-way matching controls
Lock period in GL after all entries approved and posted

subProcesses.name: Fixed Asset Accounting & Depreciation Management
steps: Receive capitalization requests from project and technology teams and validate against CapEx authorization
Create fixed asset records in the asset subledger with asset class, useful life, and depreciation method
Capitalize qualifying project costs including labor, materials, and directly attributable overhead
Calculate and post monthly depreciation and amortization for all asset classes
Process asset disposals, retirements, and transfers and record gain or loss in GL
Reconcile fixed asset subledger to GL control account at period close
Perform physical asset verification and reconcile to asset register annually
Assess triggering events for impairment and conduct impairment testing under ASC 360
Prepare fixed asset roll-forward schedule for financial statement footnote disclosure
Archive capitalization documentation and depreciation schedules for audit

subProcesses.name: Account Reconciliation & Variance Resolution
steps: Generate trial balance and distribute assigned accounts to reconciliation owners
Reconcile each balance sheet account to supporting subledger or external source
Identify reconciling items and document age, owner, and expected resolution
Escalate unresolved items older than defined threshold to controller
Clear reconciling items through correcting journal entries or write-offs
Certify completed reconciliations through workflow sign-off process
Perform balance sheet flux analysis comparing period-end to prior period
Present material reconciliation exceptions to the Controller for review
Archive certified reconciliations for audit and regulatory examination
Update reconciliation status dashboard and report to close management

subProcesses.name: Intercompany Accounting & Eliminations
steps: Confirm intercompany transaction schedule with all affiliated entities
Post intercompany management fees, reinsurance premiums, and service charges
Reconcile intercompany receivable and payable balances across legal entities
Identify and resolve intercompany mismatches before consolidation
Post consolidation elimination entries for intercompany revenues and expenses
Prepare intercompany settlement instructions for treasury cash sweep
Confirm settlement of intercompany balances and clear open items
Prepare intercompany disclosure schedule for statutory and GAAP filings
Review intercompany agreements for alignment with posted transactions
Archive intercompany reconciliations and elimination workpapers

subProcesses.name: Financial Statement Preparation
steps: Extract closed trial balance and load into financial reporting tool
Map trial balance to GAAP income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement
Prepare statutory financial statements aligned to NAIC SAP requirements
Draft notes to financial statements covering significant accounting policies
Prepare segment footnote disclosures for lines of business and legal entities
Reconcile GAAP-to-statutory differences and document permanent vs. temporary items
Perform analytical review of financial statements for reasonableness
Distribute draft financial statements to Controller and CFO for review
Incorporate review comments and finalize statements
Obtain CFO certification and archive final statements in document repository

subProcesses.name: Close Management & Controls Monitoring
steps: Track task completion against close calendar using close management system
Monitor open items dashboard and escalate blockers to close manager
Validate key control checkpoints including SOX controls for each close period
Document any control deviations and submit to internal controls team
Confirm all required sign-offs obtained before advancing close milestones
Perform post-close review of quality metrics including error rates and cycle time
Report close timeline and quality results to CFO and Controller
Conduct close retrospective and identify process improvement opportunities
Update close procedures documentation to reflect process changes
Archive close checklist evidence for external auditor review

subProcesses.name: Statutory Annual & Quarterly Statement Filing
steps: Confirm filing calendar and statutory due dates for each domiciliary state
Extract statutory trial balance from insurance accounting system
Complete NAIC Annual Statement blanks including balance sheet, income statement, and exhibits
Prepare investment schedules (Schedule D, E, BA) from investment accounting records
Complete actuarial loss reserve exhibit and attach signed actuarial opinion
Prepare risk-based capital (RBC) formula calculation and IRIS ratios
Coordinate with appointed actuary on loss and premium reserve adequacy certification
Conduct internal review of statutory statements for mathematical accuracy
Obtain CFO and board-of-directors certification of statutory filings
Submit statutory filings via NAIC iSite+ and state insurance department portals
Archive filed statements and acknowledgment receipts
Respond to examiner inquiries arising from statutory filing review

subProcesses.name: Solvency & Capital Reporting
steps: Compile solvency and capital adequacy data from finance, actuarial, and investments
Prepare Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) report for group and solo entities
Calculate group capital adequacy ratios under applicable Group Capital Calculation (GCC) framework
Prepare Solvency II or NAIC-equivalent internal capital model outputs
Draft ORSA summary report for regulatory submission
Validate capital figures against statutory surplus and RBC calculations
Obtain board review and sign-off on solvency and capital disclosures
Submit ORSA summary report and group capital filing to lead state regulator
Report to regulators and respond to follow-up inquiries
Maintain solvency reporting evidence file for regulatory examination

subProcesses.name: GAAP Consolidation & External Financial Reporting
steps: Consolidate GAAP financial statements across all legal entities and segments
Prepare ASC 944-compliant insurance contract accounting disclosures
Draft MD&A section including results of operations and liquidity discussion
Prepare earnings release financial tables and press release narrative
Complete SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q) if publicly listed, or equivalent board package
Coordinate with external auditors on year-end audit and quarterly reviews
Respond to auditor requests for evidence and confirm accounting positions
Obtain audit opinion or review conclusion from external auditors
Distribute audited financial statements to regulators, rating agencies, and investors
Archive signed financial statements and audit workpapers

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Accounting & Bordereaux Reporting
steps: Receive treaty and facultative reinsurance contract terms and load into reinsurance system
Calculate ceded premium under each reinsurance treaty based on written premium volume
Calculate ceded losses based on reported claims data and treaty loss participation
Prepare ceded premium and loss bordereaux for submission to reinsurers and brokers
Reconcile ceded premium and loss accounts to reinsurance accounting subledger
Process reinsurance premium payments and loss recoveries with treasury
Pursue outstanding reinsurance recoverables and escalate aged balances
Record reinsurance deposit accounting entries for contracts meeting SFAS 113 criteria
Prepare reinsurance Schedule F exhibits for statutory annual statement
Report reinsurance recoverables and credit risk exposure to risk management

subProcesses.name: Financial Examination & Regulatory Inquiry Management
steps: Maintain a regulatory examination calendar tracking scheduled and in-progress state examinations
Designate examination coordinator and establish data room for regulator document requests
Respond to pre-examination information requests with financial data, reconciliations, and workpapers
Host examination opening conference and brief examiners on organizational structure and accounting practices
Coordinate subject-matter expert interviews between examiners and finance, actuarial, and investment staff
Track open examination findings and prepare management responses with remediation plans
Review draft examination report and submit formal responses to factual inaccuracies
Obtain final examination report and communicate findings to board audit committee
Implement agreed remediation actions and confirm completion with lead state regulator
Archive examination correspondence, responses, and final reports in regulatory evidence repository

subProcesses.name: Escheatment & Unclaimed Property Compliance
steps: Identify dormant property candidates across claim payments, premium refunds, and dividends
Validate dormancy period against applicable state unclaimed property statutes
Perform owner due-diligence outreach including letter campaigns and returned-mail research
Document due-diligence efforts and results for regulatory defensibility
Prepare unclaimed property reports by state using approved holder reporting format
Submit annual unclaimed property reports and remit funds to state custodians
Obtain state acknowledgment of filing and remittance
Maintain unclaimed property register tracking reported and remitted items
Respond to state holder audits and provide requested documentation
Review unclaimed property policies and update procedures for legislative changes

subProcesses.name: Tax Provision & Financial Reporting
steps: Obtain pre-tax income by jurisdiction from financial reporting team
Calculate current tax liability based on taxable income and applicable rates
Identify and quantify temporary differences giving rise to deferred tax assets and liabilities
Apply valuation allowance analysis to deferred tax assets based on realizability
Compute effective tax rate reconciliation and identify permanent vs. timing items
Prepare income tax provision and deferred tax roll-forward schedules
Reconcile tax provision to prior-year filed returns and identify true-up items
Review tax provision with external auditors and resolve audit adjustment questions
Record tax provision journal entries and ensure balance sheet tax account accuracy
Archive tax provision workpapers and obtain Controller sign-off

subProcesses.name: Federal & State Income Tax Compliance
steps: Compile federal consolidated tax return data from all included legal entities
Prepare federal income tax return for insurance group using applicable IRS forms (1120-PC)
Calculate life-nonlife consolidation rules and applicable intercompany tax-sharing allocations
Prepare state income and franchise tax returns for all nexus jurisdictions
Compute apportionment factors and state modifications for each filing jurisdiction
Prepare and submit tax payment estimates for all federal and state installment due dates
File returns by statutory deadlines or obtain approved extensions
Reconcile tax payments to GL accruals and adjust for under- or overpayments
Respond to tax authority notices, audits, and information document requests
Maintain tax return archive and document retention schedule per jurisdiction

subProcesses.name: Premium Tax & Insurance-Specific Tax Filings
steps: Compile gross written premium by state, line, and legal entity from billing records
Apply state premium tax rates and calculate retaliatory tax adjustments
Calculate surplus lines tax and stamping fee obligations for non-admitted business
Prepare quarterly premium tax installment payment calculations
File annual premium tax returns with each state department of revenue
Process premium tax payments through treasury and confirm state receipt
Monitor state premium tax legislative changes and update calculation models
Maintain premium tax rate table by state and line of business
Respond to state premium tax audit inquiries and provide supporting documentation
Archive premium tax filings and payment confirmations by state

subProcesses.name: Tax Audit & Controversy Management
steps: Track open federal and state tax audit examinations by jurisdiction and year
Coordinate with external tax counsel to develop audit response strategy
Compile and deliver requested documents in response to IDRs
Assess risk and reserve for uncertain tax positions under ASC 740-10 (FIN 48)
Negotiate proposed audit adjustments and evaluate settlement options
Prepare and file protests or petitions for disputed assessments
Update uncertain tax position reserves based on audit progress and settlement outcomes
Record audit settlements and final assessments in tax accounts
Communicate audit results to CFO and external auditors
Archive audit correspondence and settlement documentation

subProcesses.name: Tax Planning & Structuring
steps: Monitor legislative developments affecting insurance company taxation
Identify tax planning opportunities including loss carryback strategies and deduction timing
Evaluate tax implications of proposed acquisitions, divestitures, and restructurings
Model after-tax impact of alternative transaction structures
Prepare tax opinion memos documenting positions and supporting authority
Obtain external tax counsel review of significant planning strategies
Coordinate implementation of approved tax structures with legal and finance teams
Report material tax planning matters to board audit committee
Update tax strategy roadmap annually based on regulatory and business changes
Ensure tax planning complies with economic substance and anti-avoidance standards

subProcesses.name: Payroll & Employment Tax Compliance
steps: Confirm payroll data accuracy with HR for each payroll cycle
Calculate federal income tax withholding, FICA, and state payroll taxes
Remit payroll tax deposits within prescribed deadlines to IRS and state agencies
Prepare and file Form 941 quarterly and Form 940 annually
Prepare state unemployment insurance filings for all employee work locations
Issue W-2s to employees and file annual reconciliation with Social Security Administration
Manage contractor tax reporting and issue Form 1099-NEC for applicable vendors
Reconcile payroll tax liability accounts to GL on each payroll cycle
Respond to IRS and state payroll tax notices and penalties
Archive payroll tax records per retention schedule requirements

subProcesses.name: Daily Cash Positioning & Forecasting
steps: Capture opening bank balances from all entity bank accounts via bank data feeds
Aggregate expected inflows including premium collections, investment maturities, and reinsurance receipts
Aggregate expected outflows including claims payments, vendor disbursements, and tax payments
Calculate net daily cash position by entity and currency
Forecast short-term liquidity needs over 13-week rolling horizon
Identify surplus cash and initiate sweep to short-term investment vehicles
Identify funding shortfalls and activate credit facility or intercompany loan
Review and approve daily cash position report with Treasurer
Post daily cash movement journal entries to GL
Archive daily cash position reports and forecasting model inputs

subProcesses.name: Payment Execution & Sanctions Screening
steps: Receive payment instructions from claims, accounts payable, and treasury teams
Validate payment details against vendor or payee master data
Screen all outbound treasury payments against OFAC SDN list and other sanctions programs
Flag potential sanctions matches and route to compliance team for manual review
Release cleared payments through bank payment system or wire transfer platform
Confirm payment execution and receipt of bank acknowledgment
Post executed payments to GL and update cash position
Investigate returned or rejected payments and reprocess or escalate
Monitor same-day payment cut-off times and prioritize urgent disbursements
Maintain payment audit trail and archive wire transfer confirmations

subProcesses.name: Bank Account Management & Connectivity
steps: Maintain bank account inventory listing all accounts by entity, bank, and purpose
Process account opening, modification, and closure requests with authorized approvals
Manage bank signatory updates and authorized user access for all accounts
Establish and maintain bank API and SFTP connectivity for automated data feeds
Test and validate bank connectivity after system changes or bank upgrades
Negotiate bank service fee schedules and analyze account analysis statements
Manage corporate credit cards and commercial card programs
Conduct annual review of bank relationships and account rationalization
Ensure KYC documentation is current for all banking relationships
Report bank account inventory to internal audit and regulatory examiners on request

subProcesses.name: Cash Reconciliation & Break Resolution
steps: Receive daily bank statements for all entity accounts
Match bank transactions to GL cash entries using automated reconciliation tool
Identify unmatched items and classify as timing differences or breaks
Investigate breaks by tracing transaction to source system or bank
Post correcting journal entries to clear reconciling items
Escalate aged unresolved breaks to Controller and banking relationship manager
Prepare bank reconciliation certification for each account
Obtain Controller approval of certified bank reconciliations
Monitor bank reconciliation completion rate against close calendar deadline
Archive certified bank reconciliations for audit and examination

subProcesses.name: Liquidity Management
steps: Monitor liquidity buffers against internal risk appetite limits
Maintain liquidity reserve comprising high-quality liquid assets (HQLA) aligned to catastrophe event needs
Manage collateral pledged under derivative contracts and securities lending programs
Coordinate with investments team on asset maturities to meet liquidity projections
Activate contingency funding plan triggers if liquidity buffers breach thresholds
