Report liquidity position and buffer utilization to Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO)
Document liquidity management decisions for risk governance records
Confirm intraday liquidity availability at each major banking institution
Review counterparty credit limits to ensure liquidity sources remain accessible
Maintain and test contingency funding plan at least annually

subProcesses.name: Liquidity Stress Testing
steps: Define stress scenarios including 90-day catastrophe event, market dislocation, and credit freeze
Source scenario inputs from actuarial, investments, and risk teams for each stress run
Run regulatory and internal liquidity stress scenarios across all legal entities
Measure liquidity coverage ratio and net stable funding ratio under applicable frameworks
Assess survival horizon under each stress scenario against board-approved minimums
Identify asset liquidation and funding actions required to close projected shortfalls
Report stress test results to ALCO and senior finance leadership
Prepare regulatory liquidity stress reports and submit to lead-state regulator as required
Review and validate stress model assumptions at least annually
Archive stress scenario inputs, model outputs, and regulatory submissions

subProcesses.name: Funding, Debt & Intercompany Financing
steps: Assess funding needs for strategic initiatives, CapEx, and seasonal liquidity requirements
Evaluate funding options including credit facility draws, debt issuance, and repo
Execute debt issuance or credit facility draws in compliance with covenant requirements
Manage intercompany loan and capital contribution transactions between affiliated entities
Execute foreign exchange funding transactions for multi-currency operations
Monitor outstanding debt balances, interest schedules, and covenant compliance
Prepare quarterly debt covenant compliance certificates for lenders
Manage debt maturity schedule and plan refinancing well ahead of maturity dates
Monitor funding costs and benchmark against market rates
Report funding and debt position to CFO and board finance committee

subProcesses.name: Investment Policy & Mandate Setting
steps: Initiate annual review of Investment Policy Statement with CIO and CFO
Capture regulatory constraints including NAIC eligible investment schedules by jurisdiction
Analyze liability profile, duration, and cash flow requirements from actuarial data
Define strategic asset allocation ranges for each asset class aligned to risk appetite
Set mandate guidelines for external asset managers including benchmark, duration, and quality floors
Conduct board-of-directors and investment committee review of proposed policy changes
Approve revised Investment Policy Statement and communicate to asset managers
Distribute updated guidelines to custodian and compliance monitoring system
Validate compliance monitoring rules reflect updated policy parameters
Archive signed Investment Policy Statement with effective date

subProcesses.name: Strategic Asset Allocation & Rebalancing
steps: Analyze current portfolio composition versus strategic asset allocation targets
Assess liability-driven investment requirements including duration gap and convexity
Model scenario outcomes for proposed allocation changes under interest rate stress
Develop rebalancing plan specifying asset classes to purchase, sell, or reduce
Present rebalancing recommendation to investment committee for approval
Execute rebalancing trades through investment managers or direct trading desk
Validate post-trade portfolio composition against revised allocation targets
Confirm rebalancing is reflected in custodian and investment accounting records
Report new allocation position to ALCO and senior finance leadership
Document rebalancing rationale and maintain investment decision audit trail

subProcesses.name: Security Selection & Portfolio Construction
steps: Identify investment opportunities within approved mandate guidelines
Perform credit analysis and assess NAIC designation for fixed income securities
Evaluate relative value of candidate securities against benchmark and peers
Assess portfolio impact of adding proposed security on duration, convexity, and credit quality
Review security against investment guideline restrictions prior to recommendation
Present investment recommendation to portfolio manager or investment committee
Obtain authorization to trade and issue trade order to execution desk
Confirm trade execution and validate price, settlement date, and counterparty details
Update portfolio records in investment accounting system post-trade
Monitor newly added positions against ongoing investment guideline parameters

subProcesses.name: Trade Execution & Settlement
steps: Receive trade orders from portfolio managers and validate against investment policy limits
Execute trades via approved broker-dealers or electronic trading platforms
Confirm trade details with broker including price, quantity, settlement date, and CUSIP
Allocate executed trades to appropriate investment accounts and legal entities
Submit settlement instructions to custodian via SWIFT or custodian portal
Monitor trade settlement and resolve settlement fails with broker and custodian
Confirm final settlement and update trade blotter with settlement status
Reconcile settled positions with custodian records and investment accounting system
Report settlement metrics including fail rate and aged unsettled trades
Archive trade confirmations and settlement records for regulatory audit

subProcesses.name: Asset-Liability Management & Duration Matching
steps: Aggregate liability cash flows by product line from actuarial and policy data
Calculate asset portfolio duration, convexity, and key rate durations
Measure asset-liability duration gap and dollar-duration mismatch
Model interest rate sensitivity under parallel and non-parallel yield curve shifts
Identify rebalancing actions to reduce duration gap within board-approved tolerance
Coordinate with investment managers on ALM-driven trade recommendations
Manage derivative overlays (interest rate swaps, swaptions) to refine duration positioning
Report ALM metrics to ALCO including duration gap, sensitivity, and economic value of equity
Incorporate ALM constraints into next investment policy review cycle
Maintain ALM model documentation and validate model assumptions annually

subProcesses.name: Portfolio Valuation & Performance Reporting
steps: Receive security pricing from custodian, Bloomberg, and approved pricing vendors
Validate prices for reasonableness against prior day and market benchmarks
Apply fair value hierarchy (ASC 820 Level 1/2/3) to illiquid and alternative investments
Assess OTTI impairments and update NAIC designations for downgraded securities
Calculate total return by asset class, manager, and portfolio for reporting period
Prepare investment performance report benchmarked against approved composite index
Value portfolio at cost, amortized cost, and fair value for statutory and GAAP reporting
Deliver investment report to CFO, ALCO, and investment committee
Report net investment income, realized gains and losses to financial close team
Archive investment valuation records for year-end audit and regulatory examination

subProcesses.name: Investment Guideline Compliance Monitoring
steps: Load investment policy limits and restrictions into compliance monitoring system
Run automated pre-trade compliance check before executing each proposed trade
Run automated post-trade compliance check after each trade settles
Monitor portfolio-level concentration limits by issuer, sector, credit quality, and duration
Identify compliance breaches and notify portfolio manager and Chief Investment Officer
Document breach cause, materiality, and corrective action plan
Execute corrective trades to bring portfolio into compliance within required timeframe
Report compliance breaches and resolutions to investment committee and board
Conduct periodic independent review of compliance monitoring rule set
Archive all compliance monitoring results and breach reports

subProcesses.name: Custodian & Counterparty Management
steps: Manage custodian agreements and service level agreements for primary and sub-custodians
Reconcile custodian position and cash records to investment accounting system daily
Investigate and resolve custodian breaks including position, cash, and income discrepancies
Monitor custodian performance metrics including settlement fail rate and reconciliation accuracy
Manage counterparty credit exposure under ISDA master agreements and CSAs
Process collateral calls and returns under derivative CSA agreements
Review and approve custodian fee invoices against negotiated rate schedule
Conduct annual custodian due-diligence review and service evaluation
Maintain counterparty approved-list and credit limit schedule
Report counterparty exposure concentrations to credit risk and investment committees

subProcesses.name: Capital Adequacy Assessment & Planning
steps: Assess current capital position against RBC minimum, company action level, and internal targets
Project capital needs over a 3-to-5-year planning horizon using long-range financial plan
Run capital stress scenarios including cat event, reserve strengthening, and market shock
Evaluate economic capital requirements using internal or approved models
Compare actual and projected capital to board-approved risk appetite thresholds
Prepare capital management plan outlining capital sources and deployment options
Present capital adequacy assessment to board finance committee for review
Obtain board approval of capital management plan and capital allocation targets
Monitor capital position monthly against plan and escalate material deviations
Report capital adequacy metrics to lead-state regulator as required under ORSA

subProcesses.name: Capital Allocation
steps: Receive actuarial and risk capital model outputs and translate into allocated capital by business unit
Prepare capital allocation schedule by segment and business unit based on approved methodology
Validate allocated capital totals reconcile to group capital position
Communicate capital allocations to business unit CFOs and pricing actuaries
Link capital allocation to risk-adjusted return metrics used in performance management
Review allocation methodology with risk and actuarial teams for reasonableness
Assess changes in portfolio risk profile and update allocations at annual planning cycle
Prepare capital allocation sensitivity analysis showing impact of methodology alternatives
Report business unit capital allocations to CFO and board finance committee
Archive capital allocation workpapers and model documentation

subProcesses.name: Dividend Management
steps: Assess ordinary and extraordinary dividend capacity under state insurance holding company laws
Calculate maximum allowable ordinary dividend based on statutory surplus and RBC position
Prepare dividend application for domiciliary state regulator when extraordinary dividend threshold is exceeded
Obtain board-of-directors resolution authorizing proposed dividend
Submit dividend notice or application to insurance department and monitor approval timeline
Receive regulatory approval or no-objection confirmation before proceeding
Execute dividend payment from insurance subsidiary to holding company
Record dividend entries in GL and update statutory surplus accounts
Report dividend action and updated capital position to rating agencies and regulators
Archive board resolution, regulatory correspondence, and payment confirmation

subProcesses.name: Debt Issuance & Capital Instruments Management
steps: Evaluate capital structure and identify need for hybrid or debt capital instruments
Select appropriate capital instrument type (surplus notes, senior notes, subordinated debt)
Engage investment banks and legal counsel to structure and market the issuance
Obtain regulatory approval for surplus notes or other insurance holding company securities
Execute capital markets transaction and receive proceeds
Record proceeds, issue costs, and coupon obligations in GL
Maintain debt service schedule and ensure timely coupon and principal payments
Monitor compliance with indenture covenants and rating agency criteria
Report outstanding debt and capital instruments to board and regulators
Manage refinancing of maturing instruments and update capital plan accordingly

subProcesses.name: Rating Agency Management
steps: Prepare financial data package for rating agency review including capital, earnings, and reserves
Coordinate annual rating review meetings with AM Best, S&P, Moody's, and Fitch
Respond to rating agency information requests with timely and accurate data
Monitor rating agency criteria changes and assess impact on group ratings
Develop management commentary and financial narrative for rating agency presentations
Respond to rating watch or outlook change notifications and prepare management response
Coordinate with investor relations and communications teams on rating announcements
Report rating outcomes and analyst feedback to board and executive team
Track peer rating actions and assess implications for group's relative standing
Archive rating agency correspondence, presentations, and final rating reports

subProcesses.name: Investor Relations Support
steps: Prepare investor relations financial presentations and earnings call materials
Coordinate investor day events and roadshow presentations with corporate finance
Respond to investor and analyst inquiries regarding capital adequacy and financial performance
Monitor market sentiment and analyst reports for financial messaging accuracy
Prepare investor-facing supplement disclosures including financial supplement and statistical tables
Coordinate earnings release timing with legal, finance, and communications teams
Host or support quarterly earnings conference calls and investor Q&A sessions
Track sell-side analyst estimates and compare to internal financial forecasts
Report investor feedback and market sentiment to CFO and executive team
Archive investor presentations, earnings transcripts, and analyst correspondence

subProcesses.name: Mergers, Acquisitions & Disposition Support
steps: Perform financial due diligence on target companies including reserve adequacy and capital strength
Model pro-forma financial impact of proposed acquisition on group capital and earnings
Assess regulatory capital implications and required capital actions post-close
Prepare transaction financial analysis for board and investment committee approval
Coordinate with external advisors on valuation and deal structuring
Support regulatory filing requirements for acquisition approval by insurance departments
Execute post-close capital and legal entity integration steps
Establish intercompany financing arrangements for acquired entities
Produce post-acquisition capital reconciliation and integration status report
Archive M&A financial due diligence files and regulatory approval records

subProcesses.name: Share Repurchase & Capital Return Program Management
steps: Assess surplus capital available for return to shareholders after regulatory and rating agency capital floors
Obtain board authorization for share repurchase program including maximum volume and price parameters
Engage brokers and establish trading plan in compliance with Rule 10b5-1 or equivalent safe harbor
Monitor repurchase activity against authorized program limits and blackout period restrictions
Coordinate with treasury to fund repurchase settlements from holding company cash
Record treasury stock transactions and update equity accounts in GL
Report repurchase activity and remaining authorization to board and investors each quarter
Assess program impact on book value per share, earnings per share, and leverage ratios
Evaluate pause or suspension of program under capital stress or regulatory guidance
Archive repurchase program documentation and broker trade confirmations

subProcesses.name: Vendor Onboarding & Master Data Management
steps: Receive vendor onboarding request from business unit sponsor
Collect vendor legal name, tax ID (W-9), banking details, and OFAC screening data
Screen vendor against OFAC SDN, PEP, and debarred-party lists
Validate vendor legitimacy and obtain certificates of insurance for service vendors
Create vendor master record in ERP with assigned payment terms and GL mapping
Obtain final approval from finance and procurement leadership
Communicate vendor setup confirmation to business sponsor
Manage periodic refresh of vendor master data and deactivate dormant vendors
Conduct annual vendor statement reconciliation for high-volume suppliers
Archive vendor onboarding documentation and due-diligence evidence

subProcesses.name: Sourcing & Competitive Bidding
steps: Identify procurement need and confirm spending authority and budget availability
Define sourcing strategy including make-vs-buy analysis and market assessment
Develop request for proposal or quotation documents and evaluation criteria
Distribute RFP to qualified vendors and manage supplier Q&A process
Evaluate responses against defined criteria including price, capability, and risk
Conduct vendor presentations and reference checks for shortlisted suppliers
Select preferred vendor and present recommendation with rationale for approval
Negotiate commercial terms including pricing, payment schedule, and SLAs
Document sourcing decision and award rationale in procurement system
Notify unsuccessful vendors and archive sourcing documentation

subProcesses.name: Purchase Order & Procurement Governance
steps: Publish procurement policy defining purchase-order thresholds and competitive bid requirements
Receive purchase requisition from business unit and validate budget availability
Conduct competitive sourcing for purchases exceeding procurement policy thresholds
Issue purchase order upon completion of sourcing and vendor selection
Obtain procurement committee or CFO approval for single-source awards above threshold
Transmit approved purchase order to vendor and confirm acceptance
Monitor open purchase order deliverables against agreed schedule
Receive goods or services and confirm delivery in procurement system
Flag incomplete or disputed deliveries and coordinate with vendor for resolution
Close purchase order upon final invoice match and payment

subProcesses.name: Contract Lifecycle & Financial Obligations Management
steps: Receive contract for financial review from legal or business unit
Assess financial obligations including payment terms, penalties, and escalation clauses
Review contract against procurement policy and budget authority thresholds
Obtain CFO or designated approver sign-off for contracts with material financial exposure
Load contract into contract management system with key financial milestones
Set up accruals for committed contract payments in budget and forecast models
Monitor contract payment milestones and confirm timely vendor invoicing
Process change orders and amendments through approval and budget impact analysis
Conduct contract expiry review and assess renewal versus re-bid decision
Archive fully executed contracts and maintain financial obligations register

subProcesses.name: Supplier Performance Management
steps: Establish key performance indicators and service level metrics for each strategic supplier
Conduct periodic performance reviews with suppliers against contracted SLAs
Score supplier performance using approved scorecard methodology
Identify underperforming suppliers and issue formal performance improvement notices
Track remediation progress and escalate persistent performance failures to procurement leadership
Recognize and document exemplary supplier performance for relationship strengthening
Assess supplier financial health and business continuity risk annually
Review supplier concentration risk and develop mitigation plans for critical single-source vendors
Report supplier performance results to business unit sponsors and procurement leadership
Archive supplier performance records and use findings in renewal sourcing decisions

subProcesses.name: Procurement Compliance & Spend Analytics
steps: Extract purchase order and invoice data from ERP for spend analysis
Classify spend by category, vendor, business unit, and GL account
Identify off-contract or maverick spend and quantify savings leakage
Report procurement policy compliance rates including PO coverage and approval adherence
Conduct annual spend analysis to identify category consolidation and sourcing opportunities
Benchmark spend categories against industry and peer pricing data
Prepare quarterly procurement performance report for CFO and business unit leaders
Monitor and report savings realized versus projected from sourcing initiatives
Ensure procurement practices comply with applicable regulatory and audit requirements
Archive spend analytics reports and procurement compliance evidence

subProcesses.name: Accounts Payable & Vendor Disbursements
steps: Receive vendor invoices via mail, email, and electronic invoicing portal
Validate invoice against approved purchase order or contract using three-way match
Route invoices without purchase orders through exception approval workflow
Code invoices to correct GL account, cost center, and project code
Process invoice through AP system and schedule for payment within terms
Obtain required second approvals for invoices exceeding spend authority thresholds
Batch approved invoices for payment run and release to treasury for disbursement
Screen vendor payments against OFAC sanctions list before disbursement
Record payment entries in AP subledger and transmit to GL
Reconcile AP subledger to GL control account and resolve exceptions

subProcesses.name: Corporate Card & T&E Expense Management
steps: Issue corporate cards to authorized employees per card program policy
Employees submit expense reports with receipts via expense management platform
Apply automated policy checks for spend limits, allowed categories, and missing receipts
Route non-compliant expense reports to manager for explanation and approval
Manager reviews and approves expense reports within defined authorization limits
Finance audits sample of approved expense reports for policy compliance
Process approved expense reimbursements via payroll or AP disbursement
Reconcile corporate card statement to submitted expense reports
Post expense entries to correct GL accounts and cost centers
Report T&E spend trends and policy violation rates to management

subProcesses.name: Expense Budgeting & Cost Control
steps: Establish expense budget targets by department in coordination with FP&A
Load approved expense budgets into budget management system
Monitor actual expense spend against budget in real time via dashboard
Prepare monthly budget variance report by cost center and category
Identify departments tracking over budget and escalate to CFO
Conduct quarterly expense review meetings with department heads
Implement cost reduction initiatives identified in variance analysis
Track savings realized from approved cost reduction programs
Report expense ratio trends and benchmark against industry peers
Update expense forecasts to reflect spending trend changes

subProcesses.name: Expense Policy Governance
steps: Maintain and publish the corporate expense policy covering all major spend categories
Review expense policy annually and update for regulatory, tax, or business changes
Communicate policy updates to employees through training and intranet channels
Monitor policy exception requests and approve or deny with documented rationale
Benchmark expense policy limits against peer companies and industry norms
Assess policy effectiveness through compliance rate analysis and audit findings
Coordinate with HR and legal on policy alignment with employment and tax regulations
Escalate systemic policy violations to HR and internal audit for investigation
Track policy exception trends and recommend policy refinements to CFO
Archive approved policies, exception logs, and policy communication evidence

subProcesses.name: Cost Reduction Program Management
steps: Identify cost reduction opportunities through expense analytics and benchmarking
Define cost reduction initiative scope, target savings, and implementation timeline
Build business case for each initiative including investment required and payback period
Obtain CFO and business unit sponsor approval for cost reduction initiatives
Assign initiative owners and track implementation milestones against plan
Validate realized savings through comparison of pre- and post-initiative expense run rates
Escalate initiatives at risk of missing savings targets to finance leadership
Report cumulative savings realized versus target in quarterly management reviews
Maintain cost reduction program register and close completed initiatives
Conduct post-implementation review and document lessons learned

subProcesses.name: Expense Analytics & Reporting
steps: Aggregate expense data across all cost centers, legal entities, and GL accounts
Produce expense dashboard showing actuals versus budget by category and department
Analyze expense trends over trailing 12 months to identify run-rate changes
Decompose expense ratio movements into volume, rate, and mix components
Benchmark internal expense ratios against industry and peer company data
Prepare CFO expense pack with variance commentary and forward-looking projections
Distribute expense analytics to business unit finance partners for local review
Identify anomalies or unusual spending patterns and escalate for investigation
Report expense analytics findings to leadership operating review
Archive expense reports and analytics output for audit and examination

subProcesses.name: Capability & Workforce Demand Planning
steps: Collect business strategy inputs and headcount forecasts from division leaders
Analyze current workforce skills inventory against future capability requirements
Identify critical skill gaps and surplus roles using gap-analysis framework
Model workforce scenarios (hire, redeploy, upskill, contract) for each gap
Prioritize hiring and development investment based on risk and strategic impact
Build multi-year workforce plan with headcount targets by function and level
Obtain executive and finance sign-off on workforce plan and associated budget
Publish approved plan to HR business partners and talent acquisition team
Set quarterly demand milestones and assign ownership to HRBPs
Review plan actuals vs. forecast monthly and update assumptions as needed

subProcesses.name: Organizational Structure Design
steps: Gather organizational effectiveness data: spans, layers, reporting lines, and workload metrics
Conduct stakeholder interviews with senior leaders to surface pain points and design intent
Map current-state org charts and identify structural inefficiencies
Design target-state org structure options with spans-of-control analysis
Model impact of each design option on headcount, cost, and decision velocity
Present design options to leadership with recommendation and change implications
Obtain approval on preferred design and document rationale in org design record
Create transition-state plan covering role changes, reporting shifts, and timelines
Communicate structural changes to affected employees with HRBP facilitation
Update HRIS with new reporting relationships and org hierarchy

subProcesses.name: Job Architecture & Role Leveling
steps: Audit existing job titles, grade levels, and pay bands for internal consistency
Benchmark roles against external market surveys (Mercer, Willis Towers Watson, Radford)
Define job families and career tracks aligned to the insurance operating model
Assign grade levels to each job family tier using point-factor job evaluation methodology
Map existing roles to the new job architecture and identify reclassification needs
Obtain compensation committee approval for revised grade structure and pay bands
Communicate role mapping changes to managers and impacted employees
Update HRIS job codes, grades, and titles to reflect the approved architecture
Establish governance process for adding new roles and exceptions to the architecture
Review job architecture annually against market data and internal equity outcomes

subProcesses.name: Succession Planning & Critical Role Management
steps: Identify critical and key-person-risk roles across the organization
Assess incumbents for flight risk, retirement horizon, and performance trajectory
Nominate and evaluate internal succession candidates for each critical role
Rate candidates on readiness (ready now, 1-2 years, 3+ years) using consistent criteria
Create individual development plans for near-term successors
Document succession slates and store in talent management system with appropriate access controls
Review succession slates with CEO and board compensation committee annually
Execute targeted development actions (stretch assignments, mentoring, external programs) for slated candidates
Monitor candidate progress and update readiness ratings quarterly
Activate succession plan upon role vacancy and communicate process to stakeholders

subProcesses.name: HR Budgeting & Workforce Cost Management
steps: Collect headcount actuals and open requisition data from HRIS as budget inputs
Model fully-loaded people cost (salary, bonus, benefits, taxes, contingent labor) by department
Build annual HR operating budget covering salaries, L&D, technology, and program spend
Submit budget proposal to CFO and HR leadership for review and challenge
Incorporate approved budget into financial planning system and cost center structure
Track actual people spend against budget monthly via HR finance dashboard
Identify budget variances greater than 5% and escalate to HRBP and finance partner
Process headcount change requests (backfills, new roles, eliminations) through approval workflow
Produce quarterly workforce cost report for executive leadership
Conduct year-end reconciliation of people cost actuals vs. budget and document drivers

subProcesses.name: Organizational Change & Workforce Transition
steps: Receive change initiative brief from project sponsor or program office
Conduct stakeholder and change impact analysis across affected employee populations
Assess change readiness via surveys and leader interviews
Define change management approach, including sponsorship model, resistance mitigation, and communication strategy
Mobilize sponsorship network and assign change champion roles
Develop detailed communication and engagement plan with audience segmentation
Execute communications cadence (town halls, manager briefings, FAQs, intranet updates)
Develop and deliver change-specific training content for impacted roles
Conduct cutover readiness checkpoint: confirm adoption indicators are met before go-live
Monitor post-launch adoption metrics (utilization, survey scores, support tickets)
Run reinforcement activities (recognition, feedback loops, refresher sessions) for 90 days post-go-live
Document lessons learned and archive change playbook for future initiatives

subProcesses.name: HR Policy Development & Governance
steps: Identify need for new or revised HR policy based on regulatory change, audit finding, or business request
Research applicable federal, state, and insurance-industry regulatory requirements (EEOC, FLSA, FMLA, state DOI mandates)
Draft policy content with HR legal review and compliance sign-off
Circulate draft to HR leadership, business stakeholders, and employee resource group representatives for input
Finalize policy incorporating feedback and obtain CHRO and legal approval
Publish policy to employee handbook and HR intranet portal
Communicate policy change to all employees with effective date and manager briefing guide
Train HR team and people managers on policy requirements and application
Log policy in governance register with review cadence (typically annual)
Conduct scheduled policy review, update for regulatory changes, and repeat approval cycle

subProcesses.name: Requisition Management & Sourcing Strategy
steps: Receive hiring request from business leader and validate against approved headcount plan
Create and route job requisition for HRBP and finance approval
Confirm job description, grade level, and compensation range using approved job architecture
Select sourcing channels (LinkedIn, niche insurance job boards, agencies, employee referrals, campus) based on role type
Brief retained or contingency search firm and execute NDA and fee agreement if applicable
Post approved job requisition on ATS, career site, and external job boards
Activate employee referral program notification for the requisition
Monitor sourcing funnel metrics weekly (applications, qualified candidates, pipeline velocity)
Adjust sourcing mix if qualified-applicant threshold is not met within two weeks
Report requisition status and time-to-fill forecast to hiring manager biweekly

subProcesses.name: Candidate Screening & Interview Process
steps: Review all applications in ATS against minimum qualifications and screen out disqualified candidates
Conduct recruiter phone screen (30 min) to assess role fit, compensation expectations, and availability
Advance qualified candidates to hiring manager screen and collect structured feedback
Schedule and coordinate interview panel using interview scheduling tool integrated with ATS
Brief interviewers on competency-based question guides and scoring rubrics
Conduct structured panel interviews and collect scores within 24 hours via ATS feedback forms
Debrief hiring team on candidate assessments and identify top candidates
Administer technical or skills assessments where applicable (e.g., actuarial problems, underwriting case studies)
Check for internal candidates and ensure equitable evaluation per EEOC guidelines
Advance finalist candidate to reference and pre-offer stage

subProcesses.name: Offer Management & Pre-Employment Verification
steps: Build compensation offer within approved grade band using market data and internal equity analysis
Obtain hiring manager and HRBP approval for offer terms
Extend verbal offer to candidate and document candidate response
Issue written offer letter via ATS with benefits summary, start date, and contingencies
Initiate background check (criminal, employment, education, credit where required for licensed roles) through vendor
Initiate drug screening if required by role or state regulation
Verify producer or adjuster license status via NIPR PDB if role is licensed
Resolve any adverse background check findings through adjudication process with legal and compliance
Collect executed offer letter and I-9 eligibility documentation from candidate
Confirm start date with candidate and communicate new hire details to onboarding team

subProcesses.name: Contingent & Contract Workforce Management
steps: Receive contingent labor request and validate against approved workforce plan and SOW budget
Select staffing agency or independent contractor through approved vendor panel
Execute master services agreement, statement of work, and insurance certificate verification
Confirm worker classification (W-2 employee vs. 1099 independent contractor) per IRS and state tests
Issue access provisioning request to IT with defined scope, duration, and data access level
Brief hiring manager on co-employment risk boundaries and prohibited management practices
Track contingent worker tenure against 18-month co-employment risk threshold
Process invoices from staffing agencies and validate against SOW deliverables
Conduct periodic audit of active contingent workers to verify ongoing business need
Offboard contingent worker at contract end: revoke access, collect equipment, and close SOW

subProcesses.name: Employer Branding & Talent Marketing
steps: Define employer value proposition (EVP) based on culture survey data and candidate feedback
Develop employer branding content (employee testimonials, culture videos, career site copy)
Manage company profiles on Glassdoor, LinkedIn, and insurance-industry career platforms
Execute targeted talent marketing campaigns for hard-to-fill roles (licensed producers, actuaries, data scientists)
Maintain and update career site content quarterly to reflect current openings and culture stories
Manage campus recruiting program: university partnerships, internship pipelines, and early-career offers
Track employer brand metrics: Glassdoor rating, career site traffic, application conversion rate
Respond to candidate reviews and ratings on employer review platforms within five business days
Gather candidate experience feedback via post-application survey and report to TA leadership
Benchmark employer brand standing against peer insurance carriers annually

subProcesses.name: Offboarding & Alumni Management
steps: Receive voluntary resignation or involuntary separation notice and log in HRIS
Confirm last day, transition plan, and knowledge-transfer responsibilities with manager
Schedule and conduct exit interview to capture voluntary turnover drivers
Initiate IT access revocation and equipment return process with defined completion timeline
Process final paycheck including accrued PTO payout per state law
Provide COBRA notice and benefits continuation documentation within required timeframe
Complete WARN Act notification process if separation is part of reduction-in-force meeting threshold
Revoke insurance licenses linked to company sponsorship and notify DOI where required
Purge or archive employee data per records retention schedule and privacy policy
Maintain alumni network engagement for potential rehire and referral pipeline

subProcesses.name: Pre-Boarding Preparation
steps: Receive confirmed start date and new hire details from talent acquisition team
Create employee record in HRIS and initiate system access provisioning requests to IT
Assign onboarding buddy and notify manager of first-week schedule requirements
Prepare workstation, equipment, and access credentials for delivery before start date
Send pre-boarding package: welcome letter, first-day logistics, equipment delivery confirmation, and benefits enrollment window
Configure role-specific system access (policy administration, claims, underwriting tools) per IT access matrix
Load mandatory training assignments in LMS prior to start date
Coordinate with facilities for building access badge and workspace setup
Brief hiring manager on first-week onboarding agenda and manager responsibilities
Confirm all pre-boarding tasks complete in HRIS onboarding checklist 48 hours before start

subProcesses.name: Compliance Documentation & I-9 Verification
steps: Collect and review Form I-9 Section 1 completed by new hire on or before day one
Examine identity and employment authorization documents from List A or Lists B and C within three business days
Complete employer portion of Form I-9 Section 2 and sign attestation
Submit I-9 information to E-Verify and record case number and result in tracking system
Resolve Tentative Nonconfirmation by notifying employee and coordinating with SSA or DHS within required timeframe
Store original I-9 in compliant filing system separate from personnel file per retention requirements
Administer required new hire state notices (wage theft prevention, paid leave disclosures) per state of employment
Collect signed acknowledgment of employee handbook, code of conduct, and confidentiality agreement
Verify and log occupational license or professional certification requirements for regulated roles
Confirm all compliance documentation is complete and filed within HRIS within five business days of start

subProcesses.name: New Hire Orientation
steps: Conduct company orientation covering mission, values, code of conduct, and compliance training (AML, OFAC, harassment prevention)
Introduce new hire to team, key stakeholders, and cross-functional partners
Deliver HR orientation: benefits enrollment instructions, HR policies, and employee self-service walkthrough
Provide role-specific systems training and department introduction
Review job expectations, performance goals, and 90-day success criteria with hiring manager
Assign onboarding buddy check-in cadence for first 90 days
Ensure completion of all mandatory training modules in LMS within first 30 days
Schedule role-specific shadowing and introduction meetings for first two weeks
Collect new hire feedback on pre-boarding and day-one experience via brief survey
Document orientation completion in HRIS and close day-one onboarding tasks

subProcesses.name: Benefits Enrollment & Elections
steps: Notify new hire of benefits enrollment window (typically 30 days from start) and election deadline
Provide benefits guide, plan comparison tools, and cost calculators via employee self-service portal
Conduct benefits orientation session covering medical, dental, vision, life, disability, FSA/HSA, and 401k options
Assist employee with elections in benefits administration system and confirm submission
Enroll new hire in default coverage where applicable per plan document
Submit enrollment files to carriers and confirm coverage effective date
Process beneficiary designations for life insurance and retirement accounts
Confirm benefits confirmation statement is received by employee and elections are accurate
Advise employee on qualifying life event rules for mid-year changes outside the enrollment window
Document completed enrollment in HRIS and archive confirmation in employee benefits file

subProcesses.name: Role Integration & 90-Day Ramp
steps: Implement job shadowing schedule for first two weeks with key role incumbents
Assign initial work assignments scaled to build competence progressively
Conduct 30-day onboarding check-in with manager and new hire to surface blockers
Assess completion of mandatory training and escalate gaps to manager
Review role-specific product, system, and process knowledge at 60-day checkpoint
Collect new hire feedback on onboarding experience via pulse survey at 45 days
Identify any performance or integration concerns at 60-day manager checkpoint and escalate to HRBP if needed
Complete 90-day onboarding review: evaluate goal progress, confirm system access is correct, and assess culture integration
Obtain manager sign-off on successful completion of onboarding program
Close all onboarding tasks in HRIS and transition employee to standard performance management cadence

subProcesses.name: Onboarding Experience Measurement
steps: Design new hire experience survey instrument covering pre-boarding, orientation, and 90-day integration dimensions
Administer 30-day pulse survey to all new hires and track completion rate by department
Administer 90-day onboarding satisfaction survey upon program close and collect qualitative feedback
Analyze survey results by cohort, role type, and department to identify onboarding experience gaps
Benchmark new hire engagement scores against industry norms and prior cohort data
Report onboarding experience metrics to HR leadership quarterly with trend analysis
Identify systemic onboarding issues (access delays, unclear expectations, cultural integration gaps) and assign remediation owners
Track early attrition (0-12 months) by cohort and correlate with onboarding experience scores
Implement program improvements based on survey findings and validate impact in subsequent cohort
Present annual onboarding program effectiveness report to CHRO with recommended investments

subProcesses.name: Learning Needs Analysis & Curriculum Design
steps: Gather learning needs inputs from performance reviews, skills gap analysis, and business strategy
Prioritize learning programs by workforce impact, regulatory requirement, and strategic alignment
Define learning objectives and competency targets for each curriculum area
Select learning modalities (instructor-led, e-learning, on-the-job, cohort programs, external certifications)
Build annual learning calendar with program owners, delivery schedules, and target audiences
Approve curriculum design plans with CHRO and business sponsors
Assign L&D staff or external vendors to develop and deliver each program
Establish assessment methodology to measure learning effectiveness (Kirkpatrick levels 1-4)
Budget program development and delivery costs against L&D annual operating budget
Review and refresh curriculum map annually based on business changes and learner feedback

subProcesses.name: Learning Content Development & Curation
steps: Write instructional design brief for each new program, including audience, objectives, and format
Develop course content using authoring tools (Articulate, Captivate) or coordinate with SMEs
Curate external content from LinkedIn Learning, insurance industry associations (CPCU, LOMA, IIA), and regulatory bodies
Build scenario-based learning exercises using real insurance case studies (claims adjudication, underwriting decisions)
Review content with subject matter experts and legal/compliance for accuracy and regulatory alignment
Conduct QA review of all digital content before LMS publication
Publish approved content to LMS and assign learning paths to target employee segments
Localize or translate content for geographically distributed or multilingual workforce
Maintain content version control and update materials when regulations or products change
Archive deprecated content and communicate curriculum updates to managers

subProcesses.name: Mandatory & Regulatory Training Compliance
steps: Identify all mandatory training requirements: federal (EEOC, ADA, FLSA), state, and insurance-regulatory (DOI CE requirements, AML, OFAC)
Map mandatory training to employee populations and assign completion deadlines in LMS
Automate enrollment triggers for new hires, role changes, and annual recertification cycles
Send automated reminder notifications at 30, 14, and 3 days before completion deadline
Track completion rates by department and escalate non-compliance to managers
Generate compliance attestation report for HR leadership and legal/compliance teams
Manage producer continuing education (CE) tracking: verify credits via state DOI portals and NIPR
Process CE completion records and update licensing compliance database
Report CE compliance status to licensing team and flag producers at risk of license lapse
Maintain documentation for regulatory audit response and submit CE filings where required by state

subProcesses.name: Leadership Development Programs
steps: Define leadership competency model aligned to company values and business strategy
Identify high-potential and emerging leader populations through talent review process
Design leadership development curriculum: assessments, coaching, 360 feedback, and action learning
Source and contract external executive education providers (university programs, leadership institutes)
Enroll nominated participants and communicate program expectations to participants and managers
Deliver cohort-based leadership program with peer learning cohorts and executive sponsorship
Administer 360-degree feedback assessments and debrief results with participants and coaches
Assign executive mentors and facilitate structured mentoring relationships
Track participant progress through program milestones and collect feedback
Measure post-program outcomes: promotion rates, retention, and manager effectiveness scores at 12 months

subProcesses.name: Licensing, Certification & Continuing Education Tracking
steps: Maintain master registry of employee licenses and certifications in HRIS and licensing management system
Monitor license expiration dates and trigger renewal workflows 90 days before expiry
Coordinate pre-licensing education enrollment for employees moving into licensed producer or adjuster roles
Administer exam registration and track pass/fail outcomes in licensing system
Submit license applications and renewals to state DOI portals and NIPR as authorized agent
Process appointment and termination filings with carriers and state regulators within required timeframes
Track CE credit accumulation by state and line of authority for all licensed employees
Alert employees and managers to CE shortfalls and facilitate enrollment in approved CE courses
Audit licensing compliance quarterly and report exceptions to compliance and HR leadership
Respond to state DOI license status inquiries and produce licensing records for regulatory exams

subProcesses.name: Coaching, Mentoring & Career Pathing
steps: Define career path frameworks for key job families (underwriting, claims, actuarial, technology)
Publish career path guides on HR intranet with skill requirements, typical timelines, and lateral move options
Train managers on career conversation facilitation and internal mobility support
Establish formal mentoring program with structured matching, goal-setting, and check-in cadence
Engage certified external coaches for senior leaders and high-potential employees
Track coaching and mentoring engagement and satisfaction through program surveys
Create internal stretch assignment registry: advertise cross-functional project opportunities to employees
Facilitate internal mobility conversations when employees express interest in role changes
Report career development participation metrics to HR leadership quarterly
Collect employee career development satisfaction data in annual engagement survey and act on gaps

subProcesses.name: Goal Setting & OKR Alignment
steps: Cascade company strategic priorities and OKRs from executive team to division and department level
Facilitate annual goal-setting process with managers and employees using SMART goal framework
Ensure individual goals are linked to at least one divisional or company OKR in performance system
Review and approve goals for quality and stretch alignment with HRBP
Publish approved goals in performance management system with weighting and success metrics
Conduct mid-year check-in process: employees update goal progress and managers provide coaching notes
Track goal completion rate and quality metrics by department
Adjust goals for material business changes (reorgs, acquisitions, regulatory shifts) via documented amendment process
Archive final year-end goal achievement data as input to performance rating calibration
Report goal completion distribution to HR leadership and compensation team for bonus pool modeling

subProcesses.name: Performance Review & Calibration
steps: Open annual performance review cycle in performance management system
Communicate review timeline, rating scale, and completion expectations to all managers
Employees complete self-assessment against goals and competencies
Managers complete performance reviews with rating and narrative evidence
Facilitate manager calibration sessions by department to normalize ratings and reduce bias
Collect calibrated ratings and flag outliers for HRBP review
Obtain CHRO and business leader sign-off on final rating distribution
Release performance reviews to employees and facilitate review conversations
Document performance improvement plan requirements for employees rated below expectations
Archive completed reviews in performance system and feed calibrated ratings to compensation process

subProcesses.name: Performance Improvement Planning
steps: Identify employee underperformance through manager observation, review rating, or behavioral incident
Consult with HRBP and employment counsel to assess legal risk and appropriate intervention level
Document performance deficiencies with specific, measurable behavioral examples
Draft performance improvement plan with clear targets, timeline (30/60/90 days), and support commitments
Review PIP draft with employment counsel and HR leadership before delivery
Deliver PIP to employee with manager and HRBP present and document employee acknowledgment
Conduct weekly check-ins throughout PIP period and document progress or regression
Evaluate PIP outcomes at defined milestones: successful completion, extension, or separation decision
Process separation if PIP is unsuccessful: prepare separation agreement and severance terms
Archive PIP documentation per records retention policy and report outcomes to HR analytics

subProcesses.name: Talent Review & High-Potential Identification
steps: Schedule annual talent review sessions with each business unit leadership team
Brief leadership on talent review process, 9-box framework, and confidentiality requirements
Collect performance and potential data inputs: manager nominations, 360 data, goal achievement
Facilitate 9-box placement discussions with calibrated evidence for each employee
Identify high-potential population and document development investment plans
Flag retention risks: high performers with high flight risk requiring targeted retention actions
Produce talent profile report for CHRO and CEO summarizing bench strength by function
Link talent review outputs to succession planning, development program nominations, and compensation adjustments
Communicate outcomes to managers with coaching on how to discuss development with employees
Track year-over-year movement in talent segments and report to board compensation committee

subProcesses.name: Employee Separations
steps: Monitor voluntary turnover data monthly by department, level, and tenure cohort to identify separation patterns
Receive voluntary resignation or involuntary termination decision and validate with manager and HRBP
Consult employment counsel on involuntary separations to assess legal risk and severance obligations
Prepare separation agreement, severance terms, and release documentation for involuntary cases
Assess WARN Act applicability for group separations and initiate required notifications
Coordinate final day logistics: access revocation timeline, equipment return, and final paycheck processing
Conduct exit interview to capture voluntary turnover drivers and log findings in ER system
Provide COBRA notice and benefits continuation documentation within required timeframe
Revoke insurance licenses linked to company sponsorship and notify DOI where required
Archive separation documentation per records retention policy and report separation data to workforce planning

subProcesses.name: Employee Retention Programs
steps: Identify turnover hotspots using exit interview data, stay interview insights, and engagement survey drivers
Develop targeted retention strategies for critical roles and high-performer segments
Design and implement retention bonuses, career path interventions, and flexible work arrangements for at-risk employees
Execute stay interview program: managers conduct structured stay interviews with high performers
Track retention program effectiveness metrics: 12-month retention rate of targeted employees
Analyze exit interview data quarterly for systemic issues and report to HR leadership
Escalate systemic retention issues to business leaders with root-cause analysis and recommendations
Build rolling 12-month voluntary turnover forecast to support workforce planning
Benchmark turnover rates against insurance industry peers using SHRM and Towers Watson data
Report retention program outcomes and ROI to CHRO and business sponsors quarterly

subProcesses.name: Manager Effectiveness & HR Business Partnering
steps: Deploy manager effectiveness survey as part of annual engagement survey cycle
Analyze manager effectiveness scores by team and identify managers needing support
Assign HRBP coverage model to business units and define service-level expectations
Conduct regular HRBP strategic business reviews with division leaders
Provide managers with real-time people analytics (turnover, engagement, headcount) via HR dashboard
Facilitate manager skill-building workshops on feedback, coaching, and inclusive leadership
Partner with managers on org design, team restructuring, and workforce planning decisions
Support managers through complex employee relations situations with coaching and documentation guidance
Track HRBP satisfaction scores through semi-annual business partner survey
Report people metrics and HRBP activity summary to CHRO monthly

subProcesses.name: Compensation Strategy & Market Pricing
steps: Define total rewards philosophy: market positioning, pay-for-performance leverage, and pay equity commitment
Purchase and participate in compensation surveys (Mercer, Willis Towers Watson, Radford, LIMRA for insurance roles)
Conduct annual salary survey data analysis: age surveys to current year and regress to policy midpoints
Update salary bands and pay ranges based on market movement and internal equity analysis
Present revised compensation structure to compensation committee for approval
Communicate salary band updates to HR business partners and recruiting team
Conduct internal pay equity analysis by gender, race, and other protected classes
Identify and remediate pay equity gaps with proactive adjustments approved by CHRO
Maintain compensation structure documentation in total rewards system
Review total rewards competitiveness annually using benefits benchmarking data alongside base salary data

subProcesses.name: Annual Compensation Planning & Merit Process
steps: Calculate merit budget based on company financial performance and market movement targets
Obtain board compensation committee and CFO approval for merit and bonus pools
Build merit matrix linking performance rating and position-in-range to merit increase guideline
Open compensation planning cycle in HRIS and load approved budgets by cost center
Brief managers on merit guidelines, differentiation expectations, and system process
Managers enter merit increase and bonus recommendations in compensation planning module
HR and HRBP review manager recommendations for budget adherence, equity, and rating consistency
Obtain HR leadership approval of final compensation recommendations by department
Process approved merit increases and bonus payments in payroll with effective dates
Communicate compensation outcomes to employees via offer letters or total comp statements

subProcesses.name: Incentive Plan Design & Administration
steps: Review annual incentive plan design against business strategy and market prevalence data
Define plan eligibility, performance metrics (combined ratio, net written premium growth, loss ratio), and payout leverage
Model incentive plan financial exposure at threshold, target, and maximum performance levels
Obtain compensation committee approval for plan design and maximum payout
Document incentive plan in plan document and ensure legal review for compliance with FLSA and state law
Communicate plan design to participants with plan summary and performance targets
Track performance metrics against plan goals quarterly and model accrual estimates for finance
Calculate final incentive awards at year-end based on certified performance results
Process incentive payments through payroll with appropriate tax withholding
Produce incentive plan summary report for compensation committee showing actual vs. target payout

subProcesses.name: Pay Equity Analysis & Remediation
steps: Define pay equity analysis scope: employee populations, protected classes, and job comparator groupings
Extract compensation data from HRIS and validate completeness and coding accuracy before analysis
Conduct unadjusted (raw) pay gap analysis by gender, race, and other protected classes
Run controlled regression analysis holding constant legitimate pay factors (grade, tenure, performance, geography)
Identify statistically significant pay gaps above materiality threshold requiring remediation
Classify gap root causes: systemic bias, manager discretion, market-driven outliers, or data anomalies
Develop remediation budget proposal and obtain CHRO and CFO approval for proactive equity adjustments
Process approved equity adjustments in HRIS and apply through payroll with effective dates
Implement process controls to prevent recurrence: merit matrix guardrails, offer approval triggers, and calibration requirements
Document analysis methodology and findings in privileged work product with employment counsel and report summary to board

subProcesses.name: Producer & Sales Compensation Administration
steps: Design producer commission and sales incentive plan structures aligned to distribution strategy and profitability targets
Define commission schedules by product line, distribution channel, and producer tier with override and bonus components
Document producer compensation agreements and obtain legal review for compliance with state DOI regulations and anti-rebating laws
Load commission rates and eligibility rules into commission management system at plan year start
Calculate earned commissions from policy premium data, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations each processing cycle
Reconcile commission statements against policy and billing system data and resolve discrepancies before payment
Process producer commission payments via EFT or check disbursement on the defined payment schedule
Manage commission disputes: receive, log, investigate, and resolve producer payment inquiries within five business days
Produce 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC forms for independent agent and broker payments annually
Report producer compensation cost and distribution channel profitability to finance and sales leadership quarterly

subProcesses.name: Executive Compensation & Equity Administration
steps: Support compensation committee in setting CEO and named executive officer pay using peer group analysis
Model executive pay scenarios: base salary, short-term incentive, and long-term incentive total compensation
Administer long-term incentive plan: equity grants, vesting schedules, and performance conditions
Coordinate with stock plan administrator for equity award grant processing and participant communications
Prepare proxy statement compensation disclosure sections (CD&A, summary compensation table) with external counsel
Track executive stock ownership guidelines compliance and report to compensation committee
Manage deferred compensation plan administration: elections, investment changes, and distribution processing
Ensure Section 162(m), 409A, and say-on-pay compliance in all executive compensation designs
Respond to shareholder advisory firm (ISS, Glass Lewis) inquiries on executive pay program
Report executive compensation total cost to CFO and board annually

subProcesses.name: Benefits Strategy & Carrier Management
steps: Conduct annual benefits strategy review assessing cost trends, employee utilization, and market benchmarking
Lead annual carrier renewal process: collect renewal rates, negotiate with carriers, and model plan design changes
Evaluate benefits program options (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, EAP, FSA/HSA) against budget and employee needs
Present benefits renewal recommendations to CHRO and CFO with cost-sharing analysis
Obtain approval for plan year benefit design and employee contribution rates
Execute vendor contracts and update summary plan descriptions for the new plan year
Process carrier enrollment files and verify coverage confirmation reports after open enrollment
Reconcile monthly carrier invoices against enrollment data and resolve discrepancies within five business days
Manage qualifying life event changes throughout the plan year per IRS Section 125 rules
Review benefits program competitiveness annually and present redesign options to compensation committee

subProcesses.name: Open Enrollment Administration
steps: Build open enrollment project plan covering communications, system configuration, and employee support timeline
Configure benefits administration system for the new plan year: plan options, rates, and eligibility rules
Develop open enrollment communication campaign: benefits guide, decision-support tools, and enrollment deadlines
Publish benefits comparison tools and cost calculators on employee self-service portal
Launch open enrollment period and staff benefits help desk for employee assistance
Track enrollment completion rates daily and escalate low-participation departments to HR leadership
Process and resolve employee election errors or system issues within one business day
Close enrollment window and produce final election confirmation report
Submit enrollment data files to all carriers and confirm file acceptance within 24 hours
Distribute benefit confirmation statements to employees and resolve post-enrollment discrepancies

subProcesses.name: Voluntary Benefits & Supplemental Coverage Administration
steps: Assess employee interest in voluntary benefit offerings through annual needs survey and benchmarking data
Evaluate voluntary benefit vendor options: supplemental life, accident, critical illness, pet insurance, legal plans, and identity theft protection
Negotiate group rates and enrollment support terms with approved voluntary benefit carriers
Present voluntary benefit program options to CHRO and CFO with cost-neutral employer analysis
Configure voluntary benefit elections in benefits administration system for open enrollment
Communicate voluntary benefit options to employees with carrier-provided decision-support materials
Process employee voluntary benefit elections and deduction setup in payroll
Coordinate payroll deduction remittances to voluntary benefit carriers on the required schedule
Manage mid-year enrollment changes for qualifying life events per carrier plan documents
Review voluntary benefit utilization and employee satisfaction annually and adjust program offerings accordingly

subProcesses.name: Leave & Absence Management
steps: Receive employee leave request and verify FMLA eligibility (12-month tenure, 1,250 hours worked, covered employer threshold)
Issue FMLA Notice of Eligibility and Rights and Responsibilities form within five business days of initial notice
Provide employee with medical certification form and track return deadline (15 calendar days)
Review completed medical certification for sufficiency and request clarification or second opinion where required
Issue FMLA Designation Notice to employee confirming approved, pending, or denied designation with written rationale
Identify and coordinate applicable state leave entitlements running concurrently or consecutively with federal FMLA
Calculate pay continuation plan: integrate STD benefit, apply accrued PTO offset per policy, and confirm unpaid leave period with payroll
Coordinate with payroll and benefits to maintain correct pay, benefits continuation, and premium collection during leave
Track all open leave cases in leave management system with expected return dates, certification expiry, and escalation flags
Facilitate return-to-work: obtain fitness-for-duty certification, assess need for phased return, and coordinate modifications
Brief manager on employee leave status and expected return date without disclosing protected health information
Generate leave utilization and open-case report monthly for HR operations and compliance review
Maintain HIPAA-compliant leave records in restricted medical file separate from personnel file
Conduct year-end leave compliance self-audit covering FMLA designation accuracy and state leave coordination

subProcesses.name: Workplace Accommodation Management
steps: Receive ADA or state-equivalent reasonable accommodation request from employee or manager
Acknowledge request within five business days and initiate the interactive process with employee
Obtain supporting medical documentation from employee's treating provider
Engage HR counsel to assess accommodation request scope, undue hardship factors, and applicable state law
Evaluate proposed accommodation options: schedule modifications, remote work, assistive technology, or role transfer
Consult with manager and facilities on feasibility and operational impact of each option
Document interactive process discussions and decisions in confidential accommodation file
Issue written accommodation decision to employee with approved modifications or denial rationale
Implement approved accommodation and schedule 30-day follow-up with employee and manager
Maintain HIPAA-compliant accommodation records in restricted medical file separate from personnel file
Monitor ongoing accommodation effectiveness and adjust as employee condition or job requirements change
Conduct annual audit of open accommodation cases for compliance completeness and interactive process documentation

subProcesses.name: Retirement & Financial Wellness Programs
steps: Administer 401(k) plan: enrollment, contribution changes, fund elections, and loan processing
Conduct 401(k) annual compliance testing (ADP/ACP, top-heavy) with plan recordkeeper and ERISA counsel
Manage plan audit process: provide documentation to external auditors for Form 5500 filing
Submit Form 5500 annual report to DOL within required filing deadline
Coordinate investment committee meetings: review fund performance, fee benchmarking, and fiduciary minutes
Manage employer match and profit-sharing contributions: calculate, approve, and remit to recordkeeper
Promote employee financial wellness resources: 401(k) education, financial planning tools, and EAP financial counseling
Manage defined benefit pension plan if applicable: actuarial valuations, PBGC premium filings, and benefit distributions
Process retirement distributions, rollovers, and qualified domestic relations orders per plan document
Maintain retirement plan documents and summary plan descriptions with required annual updates

subProcesses.name: Employee Relations Case Management
steps: Receive employee complaint, grievance, or conduct concern through HR hotline, manager referral, or direct report
Log case in employee relations case management system and assign to ER specialist
Assess case severity and urgency: determine whether immediate interim action (suspension, reassignment) is needed
Consult with employment counsel on complex cases involving potential legal exposure
Conduct thorough investigation: interview complainant, respondent, and witnesses; collect documentary evidence
Document investigation findings in contemporaneous notes and final investigation report
Recommend disciplinary or corrective action based on findings and policy application
Obtain HR leadership and legal review of recommended action before delivery
Communicate outcome to relevant parties within limits of confidentiality
Monitor for retaliation following complaint resolution and document follow-up actions
Close case in ER system with disposition code and archive documentation per retention schedule
Analyze ER case trends quarterly and report hotspots to CHRO for policy and management intervention

subProcesses.name: Workplace Investigations
steps: Receive investigation trigger: harassment complaint, ethics hotline report, or manager escalation
Assign qualified investigator (internal ER or external counsel) based on case sensitivity and subject seniority
Notify complainant and respondent of investigation process, confidentiality expectations, and anti-retaliation policy
Plan investigation scope: key questions, evidence sources, and witness list
Collect and preserve evidence: emails, system access logs, surveillance footage, and physical documents
Conduct structured witness interviews with consistent question protocol and signed acknowledgments
Assess credibility of all parties using corroborating evidence and circumstantial indicators
Draft investigation report with findings of fact, policy analysis, and conclusion
Review report with employment counsel and HR leadership before communicating outcomes
Issue appropriate disciplinary action, policy reminders, or systemic changes based on investigation findings
Notify complainant of investigation completion and provide general outcome summary
Archive investigation file with restricted access per EEOC and legal hold requirements

subProcesses.name: Disciplinary Action & Progressive Discipline
steps: Identify conduct or performance issue requiring formal disciplinary response
Determine appropriate disciplinary level (verbal warning, written warning, final warning, termination) based on policy and precedent
Consult with HRBP and employment counsel to assess consistency with past practice and legal risk
Prepare disciplinary documentation with factual description of violation, policy reference, and expected behavior
Deliver disciplinary action in private meeting with employee and manager; HRBP present for written warning and above
Obtain employee signature on disciplinary notice (or document refusal to sign)
Place disciplinary notice in employee personnel file with defined expiration period
Monitor employee behavior during active disciplinary period and document compliance or further violations
Escalate to next discipline level if behavior does not improve within defined improvement period
Retain disciplinary records per applicable state and federal records retention requirements

subProcesses.name: Employee Engagement & Culture Programs
steps: Design annual employee engagement survey instrument in partnership with external survey vendor
Communicate survey purpose, confidentiality, and timeline to all employees
Administer survey and track participation rates by department with real-time reporting
Close survey and produce company-wide and department-level engagement reports
Facilitate manager action planning workshops based on survey results
Track manager action plan commitments and completion in engagement platform
Execute pulse surveys quarterly to measure progress on engagement drivers between annual surveys
Design and deliver culture programs: recognition awards, values ambassador program, company milestone events
Manage employee resource groups: charter governance, funding, and executive sponsorship
Report engagement trends and culture program ROI to CHRO and board people committee annually

subProcesses.name: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Programs
steps: Develop DEI strategy with measurable representation goals aligned to company values and EEO obligations
Conduct annual workforce representation analysis by race, gender, and veteran/disability status using EEO-1 data
File EEO-1 Component 1 report with EEOC annually and state-equivalent filings where required
Implement inclusive hiring practices: structured interviews, diverse slates, blind resume review
Partner with talent acquisition to build diverse candidate pipelines through HBCU, women's college, and diversity job board relationships
Run bias-awareness and inclusive leadership training for all people managers
Support ERG programming and measure ERG impact on belonging and representation
Track DEI metrics on executive dashboard: representation by level, pay equity gaps, ERG participation
Conduct pay equity analysis with controlled and uncontrolled regression methodology and remediate gaps
Report DEI progress to board and publish voluntary corporate responsibility or DEI report

subProcesses.name: Labor Relations & Union Contract Administration
steps: Monitor labor relations climate: employee sentiment data, organizing activity indicators, and manager intelligence
Maintain current knowledge of NLRA rights and obligations for all supervisors and HR staff through annual training
Manage collective bargaining agreement administration for unionized employee populations
Respond to union information requests within contractual timeframes
Process and investigate union grievances at Steps 1, 2, and 3 per CBA grievance procedure
Prepare for arbitration: gather evidence, brief labor counsel, and develop hearing strategy for unresolved grievances
Prepare for contract negotiations: analyze grievance trends, cost model benefit proposals, and develop BATNA
Conduct negotiations with union representatives to reach tentative agreement
Facilitate ratification vote process and communicate CBA terms to employees
Implement new CBA terms in HRIS and payroll systems and train managers on changed provisions

subProcesses.name: Payroll Processing & Administration
steps: Receive and validate payroll inputs: new hire data, terminations, pay changes, and time and attendance records
Apply pre-processing edits to catch anomalies: negative pay, missing cost center, unreasonable overtime
Process supplemental pay items: bonuses, commissions, severance, and retroactive adjustments
Calculate and apply statutory deductions: federal and state income tax withholding, FICA, and FUTA
Process voluntary deductions: 401(k), health insurance premiums, FSA/HSA, garnishments, and union dues
Reconcile gross-to-net payroll register against prior period and budget thresholds before approval
Obtain payroll approval from HR and finance controller and submit final payroll file to bank
Distribute pay stubs via employee self-service and process direct deposit and check distribution
Remit payroll taxes to IRS and state agencies by required deposit schedule (semi-weekly or monthly)
Archive payroll records and produce payroll journal entries for finance system
Process off-cycle payroll runs for termination final pay, corrections, and court-ordered payments
Respond to employee pay inquiries and resolve discrepancies within one pay cycle

subProcesses.name: HRIS Management & Data Integrity
steps: Maintain master employee records in HRIS: personal data, job data, compensation, and employment history
Process HR transactions: new hires, transfers, promotions, demotions, leaves, and terminations within SLA
Audit HRIS data quality monthly: identify and correct missing fields, invalid codes, and duplicate records
Manage HRIS system configuration changes: new fields, workflows, and security roles through change control process
Administer HRIS user access and role-based security aligned to data privacy requirements
Produce standard HR reports and data extracts for payroll, benefits, finance, and compliance stakeholders
Fulfill ad hoc data requests from HR leadership and business partners with appropriate data governance controls
Coordinate HRIS system upgrades and patches with IT: test in UAT environment before production deployment
Maintain HRIS data dictionary and field-level definitions for audit and reporting consistency
Respond to employee self-service inquiries and resolve access or data issues within one business day

subProcesses.name: HR Compliance & Employment Law Adherence
steps: Maintain current tracker of applicable federal and state employment law requirements and posting obligations
Post all required federal and state labor law notices (FLSA, FMLA, OSHA, EEO) in all work locations and remote intranet
File required employer reports: EEO-1, VETS-4212, OSHA 300/300A, and state equivalents by regulatory deadline
Conduct annual I-9 self-audit and correct deficiencies per ICE guidance
Manage response to agency charges (EEOC, DFEH, DOLWH) in coordination with employment counsel
Conduct periodic HR compliance audit covering hiring, classification, wage-and-hour, and leave practices
Maintain employee records per FLSA (3 years), ADEA (1 year), and state records retention requirements
Respond to employment verification requests, wage garnishments, and unemployment claims within required deadlines
Monitor state law changes and update HR policies, forms, and employee handbook on rolling basis
Brief HR and management teams on new employment law requirements with compliance action plans

subProcesses.name: HR Technology & Systems Administration
steps: Maintain HR technology roadmap covering HRIS, ATS, LMS, performance, compensation, and payroll systems
Manage vendor relationships for all HR technology platforms: SLA review, issue escalation, and contract renewal
Configure HRIS workflows and approval routing for HR transactions per business process requirements
Manage integrations between HR systems and downstream platforms (payroll, IT provisioning, finance)
Coordinate semi-annual system release reviews: assess new features, prioritize adoption, and test configurations
