Administer employee self-service portal content and navigation to ensure usability and accuracy
Support HR technology implementations and enhancements as business process owner and UAT lead
Monitor system performance and availability and escalate outages to IT and vendor support
Train HR staff and managers on system functionality through job aids, e-learning, and live sessions
Track HR technology satisfaction via user surveys and incorporate feedback into roadmap prioritization

subProcesses.name: HR Reporting & People Analytics
steps: Define standard HR metrics catalog: headcount, turnover, time-to-fill, engagement, diversity, pay equity, and absenteeism
Build and maintain standard HR reporting suite in analytics platform (Power BI, Workday Prism, or equivalent)
Produce monthly HR dashboard for CHRO and executive team with current month actuals and trend analysis
Deliver quarterly workforce metrics report to board people committee with year-over-year comparisons
Respond to ad hoc analytics requests from HR leadership and business partners within agreed SLA
Conduct predictive analytics projects: flight risk modeling, turnover drivers, and hiring quality analysis
Ensure HR data privacy and governance: apply data masking, access controls, and anonymization for external reports
Validate metric definitions and calculation methodologies quarterly with HR leadership to ensure consistency
Benchmark workforce metrics against insurance industry peers using SHRM, LIMRA, and consultant data
Present people analytics insights to business leaders with recommended actions and measurement plan

subProcesses.name: Employee Records & Privacy Management
steps: Establish and maintain employee records file structure: personnel file, benefits file, and I-9/medical file (separate per ADA)
Process new hire documentation and verify completeness of all required forms at onboarding
Manage access controls to employee records: restrict sensitive files to authorized HR personnel only
Fulfill employee requests to inspect or copy their own personnel file per state law requirements
Process data subject access requests and deletion requests under applicable privacy laws (CCPA, GDPR for global employees)
Manage records retention schedule: archive inactive records and dispose of expired records per legal hold and regulatory requirements
Maintain HIPAA-compliant safeguards for medical and benefits information in separate files with restricted access
Respond to legal hold notices: identify, preserve, and produce employee records for litigation or regulatory inquiry
Audit employee records completeness and accuracy annually and remediate gaps
Train HR staff on records management procedures, privacy obligations, and breach response protocols

subProcesses.name: Workforce Administration & HR Shared Services
steps: Operate HR shared services center or HR service desk as first point of contact for employee HR inquiries
Categorize and route incoming HR requests (tier 0 self-service, tier 1 SSC, tier 2 HRBP, tier 3 specialist)
Process routine HR transactions: address changes, beneficiary updates, direct deposit changes, and employment verifications
Maintain HR knowledge base and FAQ content on intranet to enable employee self-service resolution
Track HR service ticket volume, resolution time, and first-contact resolution rate in service management system
Escalate complex or sensitive cases to appropriate HR specialist or HRBP with full documentation
Process employment verification letters and respond to mortgage and background check verification requests
Manage HR service level agreements and report SSC performance metrics to HR operations leader monthly
Conduct continuous improvement reviews: analyze ticket trends to identify process gaps and self-service opportunities
Survey employees on HR service satisfaction quarterly and implement improvements based on feedback

subProcesses.name: Contract Request Intake & Triage
steps: Receive contract request from business unit via legal intake portal
Classify request type (NDA, vendor agreement, reinsurance treaty, service agreement, MOU)
Assess complexity, risk tier, and estimated turnaround time
Assign matter to appropriate in-house counsel or outside counsel panel firm
Open matter in legal matter management system and assign matter number
Confirm scope and key business objectives with requesting business unit
Identify applicable regulatory constraints (state insurance code, NAIC guidelines)
Communicate timeline and process steps to business unit stakeholder
Log intake in legal operations dashboard for pipeline tracking

subProcesses.name: Contract Drafting & Template Management
steps: Select approved standard template from legal template library
Customize template to reflect transaction-specific commercial terms
Incorporate applicable regulatory and compliance clauses (data privacy, OFAC, anti-bribery)
Draft non-standard provisions where transaction deviates from standard template
Validate indemnification, limitation of liability, and insurance requirement clauses
Circulate internal draft for business unit review and redline
Reconcile business unit comments with legal risk standards
Finalize draft for counterparty negotiation
Update template library when new standard language is approved by Legal leadership
Maintain version control log throughout drafting lifecycle

subProcesses.name: Contract Negotiation
steps: Review counterparty-proposed contract or redline against ABC Insurance standard positions
Identify non-standard, high-risk, or unacceptable clauses for escalation
Prepare issue log summarizing key negotiation positions and red lines
Conduct negotiation calls or written redline exchanges with counterparty counsel
Escalate unresolved material issues to General Counsel or Deputy General Counsel
Document negotiation history and rationale for each concession made
Confirm final agreed language is reflected accurately in execution version
Obtain sign-off from business unit that commercial terms match business intent
Perform final legal quality review before routing for approval
Update negotiation playbook with new precedents from completed negotiations

subProcesses.name: Contract Approval & Execution
steps: Determine required approval authority per delegation of authority matrix
Route execution version through DocuSign or approved e-signature workflow
Obtain required internal approvals (Finance, Risk, Compliance, C-suite) per policy
Confirm counterparty signatories have authority to bind their organization
Execute contract and capture fully executed copy in contract management system
Distribute executed contract to business unit, Finance, and relevant support functions
Record key dates (effective date, renewal date, expiration, notice deadlines) in contract register
Set automated alerts for renewal and notice period milestones
File fully executed contract in designated repository per records retention schedule

subProcesses.name: Contract Obligation Monitoring
steps: Extract and record key obligations, milestones, and performance metrics at contract execution
Monitor counterparty performance against SLAs, deliverables, and payment terms
Track insurance certificate and indemnity obligation compliance by counterparties
Flag upcoming renewal, termination-for-convenience, and auto-renewal dates
Coordinate contract amendment or variation processes when scope changes occur
Escalate material breach or performance shortfall to business unit and Legal leadership
Maintain contract register accuracy with annual portfolio review
Provide contract performance reporting to business unit leadership quarterly
Archive expired contracts per NAIC records retention guidelines

subProcesses.name: Outside Counsel Management
steps: Maintain approved outside counsel panel with defined rate structures and engagement standards
Issue engagement letter and matter-specific instructions to retained outside counsel
Define matter budget, billing guidelines, and reporting cadence at engagement outset
Review and approve outside counsel invoices against budget and billing guidelines (e-billing system)
Monitor matter progress and budget burn via monthly status reports
Conduct annual outside counsel performance evaluation against cost, quality, and diversity metrics
Benchmark panel firm rates against market surveys annually
Update panel composition and rate cards during annual panel review cycle
Coordinate knowledge transfer from outside counsel at matter close
Maintain preferred vendor agreements and diversity spend tracking for reporting

subProcesses.name: Legal Advisory Request Intake
steps: Receive legal advisory request from business unit via intake portal or direct counsel contact
Clarify legal question, applicable jurisdiction, and urgency with requestor
Classify advisory request by subject matter (insurance regulatory, corporate, employment, tax, IP)
Assess complexity and determine whether in-house or outside counsel expertise is required
Assign matter to appropriate counsel and open matter in legal matter management system
Confirm scope and expected output format with business unit stakeholder
Identify applicable regulatory constraints and relevant prior opinions in knowledge system
Communicate timeline and process steps to requestor
Log intake in legal operations dashboard for pipeline tracking

subProcesses.name: Legal Research & Opinion Drafting
steps: Research applicable statutes, regulations, case law, and NAIC model acts
Review prior ABC Insurance legal opinions on related questions for consistency
Consult outside counsel where matter requires specialist expertise or bar admission
Analyze facts against applicable legal framework and identify key risk factors
Draft written legal opinion or advice memorandum for business unit
Obtain peer review from senior counsel for material or novel legal positions
Revise draft to incorporate peer review feedback before delivery
Deliver advice with clear risk rating and recommended course of action
Document opinion in matter management system for future reference
Escalate systemic legal risk issues to General Counsel and Risk Committee

subProcesses.name: Legal Advisory Follow-Up & Knowledge Capture
steps: Confirm business unit received and understands recommended course of action
Follow up to verify business unit implemented recommended action within agreed timeline
Document implementation outcome in matter management system
Identify recurring legal questions suitable for standing guidance or FAQ publication
Publish approved standing guidance to legal knowledge management portal
Update legal opinion index with new opinions for cross-reference by counsel
Flag advisory matters that have escalated to litigation or regulatory risk for tracking
Report legal advisory volume and topic trends to General Counsel quarterly
Archive closed advisory matter per records retention schedule

subProcesses.name: Insurance Regulatory Legal Advisory
steps: Receive regulatory interpretation request triggered by new legislation, rulemaking, or DOI inquiry
Identify all applicable statutes, regulations, and NAIC model act provisions implicated
Research legislative history, regulatory preambles, and agency guidance to determine intent
Analyze gap between current ABC Insurance practices and regulatory requirements
Consult outside regulatory counsel for complex interpretations or novel legal questions
Draft legal interpretation memorandum with definitive reading and operational implications
Obtain peer review from senior regulatory counsel or General Counsel for material interpretations
Circulate final interpretation to Compliance, Underwriting, Claims, and affected business units
Document interpretation in regulatory knowledge management system for future reference
Follow up to confirm business units have implemented operational changes per legal interpretation

subProcesses.name: Employment & Labor Law Advisory
steps: Receive employment law advisory request from HR or business unit leadership
Identify applicable federal and state employment laws (FLSA, FMLA, ADA, Title VII, state equivalents)
Research current regulatory guidance, agency rulings, and recent case law relevant to the matter
Assess legal risk and advise on legally compliant course of action
Draft employment-related agreements, policies, or communications as requested
Coordinate with outside employment counsel for matters requiring litigation risk assessment
Review proposed disciplinary actions, terminations, and severance arrangements for legal compliance
Advise on wage-and-hour compliance audits and corrective actions
Document advisory outcome and recommended actions in matter management system
Escalate matters with litigation risk to litigation counsel and HR leadership

subProcesses.name: Legal Training & Business Unit Counsel Support
steps: Assess annual legal training needs across business units in coordination with Compliance and HR
Develop legal training curriculum on high-priority topics (contract principles, antitrust, privacy, ethics)
Deliver legal awareness training to business units and newly onboarded employees
Publish plain-language legal guidance notes on frequently encountered legal issues
Maintain ABC Insurance legal intranet with current policies, templates, and guidance
Provide embedded counsel support to high-activity business units (Underwriting, Distribution, Claims)
Host quarterly legal update briefings for business unit leadership on regulatory and case law developments
Respond to routine legal questions from business units within published SLA
Track training completion rates and report to General Counsel and Compliance annually
Conduct post-training effectiveness survey and refine curriculum based on feedback

subProcesses.name: Litigation Intake & Matter Opening
steps: Receive new litigation matter from service of process, demand letter, or claim referral
Log matter in legal matter management system with jurisdiction, adverse party, and claim type
Classify litigation type (coverage dispute, bad faith, employment, commercial, regulatory enforcement)
Assign matter to in-house litigation counsel or outside litigation panel firm
Notify relevant business unit, Claims, and Finance of new litigation matter
Identify and notify insurer's reinsurance contacts where reinsurance recovery is implicated
Establish initial reserve in coordination with Claims and Finance per reserve policy
Confirm insurance coverage applicable to the claim (E&O, D&O, EPL, general liability)
Document all relevant facts, deadlines, and parties in matter management system

subProcesses.name: Legal Hold & Evidence Preservation
steps: Issue legal hold notice immediately upon notice of litigation or anticipated litigation
Identify custodians with potentially relevant documents based on matter facts
Distribute legal hold notice to all identified custodians via legal hold management system
Suspend routine destruction of records for categories identified in hold notice
Coordinate with IT to preserve relevant ESI (emails, documents, chat, data systems)
Confirm custodian acknowledgment of hold notice and log responses
Conduct targeted collection of key custodian data for attorney review
Maintain running custodian list as matter facts develop and new parties are identified
Refresh hold notice upon material change in scope or addition of new custodians
Release legal hold promptly upon final resolution and exhaustion of all appeal periods

subProcesses.name: Litigation Strategy & Defense Management
steps: Analyze case merits, liability exposure, and litigation risk at matter opening
Develop litigation strategy and budget with outside litigation counsel
Review and approve litigation strategy, key motions, and settlement authority thresholds
Monitor case timeline, court deadlines, and discovery obligations via matter management system
Approve material pleadings, dispositive motions, and expert retention before filing
Coordinate witness preparation with business unit and outside counsel
Attend key depositions and hearings as oversight of outside counsel
Update reserve quarterly in coordination with Claims and Finance as matter progresses
Report significant litigation developments to General Counsel and Risk Committee
Assess appellate risk and strategy upon adverse trial court rulings

subProcesses.name: Settlement & Alternative Dispute Resolution
steps: Prepare settlement evaluation memorandum with liability analysis and range of outcomes
Obtain settlement authority approval per delegation of authority matrix
Engage mediator or arbitrator where ADR clause applies or is strategically advisable
Conduct mediation or arbitration with outside counsel representation
Negotiate final settlement terms including payment, release scope, and confidentiality
Document settlement agreement and obtain required internal approvals for execution
Coordinate settlement payment with Finance and Claims
Obtain full and final release or consent order as applicable
Record settlement outcome and resolution metrics in matter management system

subProcesses.name: Litigation Close & Post-Matter Review
steps: Confirm all appeal deadlines have expired or appeals are resolved before formal close
Finalize matter files and hand off to records management per retention schedule
Conduct post-matter review to identify lessons learned for legal risk management
Update litigation reserves to zero upon final payment confirmation
Prepare final matter close report for Legal leadership and Risk Committee
Identify recurring claim patterns for reporting to Underwriting and Product Management
Release legal hold after confirming all appeal periods have expired
Archive matter file in legal document management system
Update litigation metrics dashboard with final costs, cycle time, and outcome data

subProcesses.name: Complaint & Pre-Litigation Dispute Handling
steps: Receive and log customer, agent, or third-party complaint in complaint management system
Triage complaint by severity, regulatory sensitivity, and litigation risk
Coordinate with Claims, Customer Service, or Underwriting to investigate complaint merits
Draft response to complainant within required state DOI timeframe
Escalate complaints involving allegations of bad faith or statutory violation to litigation counsel
Track state Department of Insurance (DOI) complaint referrals and prepare regulatory responses
Monitor complaint trends and report to Compliance and Claims leadership quarterly
Implement corrective actions where complaint identifies systemic process failure
Maintain complaint register and response time metrics for DOI examination readiness
Close complaint file upon resolution and confirmation of complainant receipt of response

subProcesses.name: Reinsurance Dispute & Arbitration
steps: Receive referral from Reinsurance of disputed collection or coverage disagreement with reinsurer
Review reinsurance contract file, billing history, and loss records to assess legal merits of dispute
Advise Reinsurance on legal rights, obligations, and dispute resolution options under treaty or facultative agreement
Issue formal legal notice of dispute to reinsurer's counsel per arbitration clause or applicable law
Represent ABC Insurance in pre-arbitration settlement discussions with reinsurer's legal counsel
Select arbitration panel per ARIAS-US or applicable arbitration clause procedures
Prepare arbitration submissions, legal briefs, evidence, and witness testimony
Represent ABC Insurance at arbitration hearings and manage outside reinsurance counsel throughout proceeding
Advise Reinsurance and Finance on legal implications of arbitration award and recovery options
Document arbitration outcome and legal precedents for future treaty negotiation support

subProcesses.name: Regulatory Change Monitoring & Impact Assessment
steps: Monitor legislative and regulatory developments across all jurisdictions where ABC Insurance operates
Subscribe to and review NAIC proceedings, bulletin releases, and model act adoptions
Track state legislature bill activity and regulatory rulemaking dockets relevant to insurance operations
Assess business impact of proposed regulations on Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, and Distribution
Prepare regulatory impact memoranda summarizing change requirements and compliance timelines
Circulate impact assessments to Legal, Compliance, and affected business units for input
Prioritize regulatory changes by implementation effort and effective date
Maintain regulatory change log with status tracking from proposal through effective date
Brief General Counsel and executive leadership on material regulatory developments quarterly
Coordinate cross-functional implementation teams for significant regulatory changes

subProcesses.name: Regulatory Filing & Approval Management
steps: Identify regulatory filing requirements triggered by product changes, rate changes, or corporate actions
Prepare rate, rule, and form filings for submission to state insurance departments via SERFF
Coordinate with Actuarial for rate support exhibits and with Product for form and rule documentation
Draft regulatory compliance certifications and actuarial opinions for inclusion in filings
Track filing status in SERFF and respond to state DOI objections within prescribed timeframes
Negotiate with DOI staff to resolve filing objections and obtain approvals
Escalate unresolved objections or adverse DOI decisions to General Counsel and SVP Product
Maintain filing approval register by state and product line
Coordinate filing withdrawal or refiling when DOI objects to material terms
Report filing cycle times and approval rates to Legal Operations and Product leadership

subProcesses.name: Insurance Department Examination Management
steps: Receive and acknowledge Notice of Examination from domiciliary or non-domiciliary insurance department
Appoint internal examination coordinator and outside examination counsel
Respond to pre-examination information requests within regulatory deadlines
Coordinate examination document production across Claims, Finance, Compliance, Underwriting, and IT
Manage on-site or remote examination process and examiner access
Review draft examination report for factual accuracy and respond to preliminary findings

subProcesses.name: Regulatory Relationships & DOI Liaison

Coordinate regulatory outreach in advance of significant product launches or corporate transactions
Represent ABC Insurance at state insurance department stakeholder roundtables and industry forums

Assess business impact of proposed legislation on Underwriting, Distribution, Claims, and pricing

subProcesses.name: Lobbying & Advocacy Management

Prepare legislative testimony, comment letters, and position papers on material insurance legislation

Manage political action committee (PAC) contributions and reporting in compliance with campaign finance law
Track lobbying spend and file required lobbying disclosure reports with state and federal authorities
Review and approve lobbyist activity reports for accuracy before regulatory filing

subProcesses.name: Federal Legislative Affairs

Prepare ABC Insurance positions on federal insurance legislation for submission to congressional committees
Coordinate responses to requests for information from federal agencies (Treasury, FIO, FRB, FSOC)

Brief senior leadership on federal regulatory and legislative risks affecting insurance operations

Track federal lobbying spend and file required House and Senate lobbying disclosure reports

subProcesses.name: Stakeholder & Coalition Engagement
steps: Build and maintain relationships with key insurance department commissioners and senior regulatory staff

Coordinate participation in industry coalition advocacy campaigns on shared legislative priorities
Manage ABC Insurance membership and engagement in trade associations (ACLI, NAMIC, APCIA, CIAB)
Represent ABC Insurance on trade association committees and working groups
Prepare executive talking points and briefing materials for stakeholder engagement meetings
Plan and execute executive participation in industry conferences and regulatory forums
Organize site visits and briefings for legislators and regulators at ABC Insurance facilities
Track and report stakeholder engagement activities and relationship outcomes quarterly

subProcesses.name: Political Contributions & Compliance
steps: Develop annual PAC strategy and contribution plan aligned with ABC Insurance legislative priorities
Collect voluntary employee PAC contributions and maintain contribution authorization records
Administer PAC contribution approval process per PAC committee authorization procedures
Process approved PAC contributions to candidate and party committees in compliance with FEC rules
File quarterly and pre-election FEC campaign finance disclosure reports accurately and timely
File state-level PAC registration and reporting in all states where ABC Insurance operates a PAC
Monitor lobbying expenditure thresholds triggering registration and reporting obligations by jurisdiction
Conduct annual political compliance training for government affairs and senior leadership staff
Maintain prohibition list of candidates and committees ineligible for PAC contributions per policy

subProcesses.name: Policy Research & Position Development
steps: Research regulatory and legislative policy alternatives to develop ABC Insurance advocacy positions
Analyze economic and actuarial impact of proposed legislative changes on insurance markets
Benchmark ABC Insurance positions against industry peers and trade association policy platforms
Consult with Underwriting, Actuarial, and Product on technical implications of proposed legislation
Draft position papers, white papers, and comment letters articulating ABC Insurance policy positions
Obtain internal review of policy positions from General Counsel, CEO, and affected business leaders
Submit formal comment letters to regulatory agencies and legislative bodies on priority issues
Publish approved policy positions on government affairs intranet for internal stakeholder alignment
Track regulatory and legislative responses to ABC Insurance advocacy and assess effectiveness
Archive policy research, position papers, and submissions per records retention schedule

subProcesses.name: Privacy Rights Request Handling
steps: Receive privacy rights request via web form, email, phone, or mail
Authenticate requestor identity per applicable law (CCPA, state insurance privacy regulations)
Classify request type (access, deletion, correction, portability, opt-out of sale/sharing)
Determine applicable law and associated response deadline by requestor jurisdiction
Search relevant systems of record (policy admin, claims, CRM, marketing) for requestor data
Coordinate with IT and business units to locate data in all applicable data stores
Compile and quality-review data package for completeness and accuracy
Apply exemptions (legal hold, regulatory retention obligation, fraud investigation) where applicable
Fulfill request and respond within statutory deadline (45 days CCPA; 30 days GLBA-state variants)
Document request disposition and evidence of timely response in DSAR tracking system
Escalate data subject objections or appeals to Privacy Counsel for resolution

subProcesses.name: Privacy Impact Assessment
steps: Scope privacy review upon identification of new processing activity, product, or vendor
Determine whether full DPIA or lighter privacy review is required based on risk threshold
Map data flows: data types collected, sources, uses, sharing, retention, and deletion
Assess processing against applicable privacy law by jurisdiction (CCPA/CPRA, GLBA, state insurance privacy rules)
Identify and document privacy risks associated with proposed processing activity
Evaluate necessity and proportionality of data collection to stated business purpose
Assess third-party data processor agreements for adequate privacy and security provisions
Document findings and approve DPIA with sign-off from Privacy Officer and Legal counsel
Track remediation to closure for all identified risks and required controls
Update privacy notice and consent mechanisms where new processing requires disclosure changes
File DPIA in privacy records management system for regulatory examination readiness

subProcesses.name: Privacy Advisory & Data Handling Guidance
steps: Receive privacy advisory request from business unit, product team, or vendor management
Identify applicable privacy framework (GLBA, HIPAA where applicable, CCPA/CPRA, state insurance laws)
Research applicable consent, disclosure, and data minimization requirements
Provide data-handling and consent guidance in written advisory to requestor
Review marketing campaign and consumer communication materials for privacy compliance
Advise on cross-border data transfer requirements and standard contractual clauses
Maintain privacy policies and standards current with regulatory and contractual obligations
Conduct privacy due diligence review of new vendor and third-party data processor relationships
Deliver privacy training and awareness to business units and new employees
Advise on privacy-by-design requirements for new IT systems and product features
Track privacy advisory matters in matter management system for trend analysis

subProcesses.name: Privacy Incident & Breach Management
steps: Receive and triage potential privacy incident from IT Security, employee report, or external notification
Conduct preliminary assessment to determine whether incident constitutes a reportable data breach
Engage IT Security, Legal, and outside breach counsel to assess scope and root cause
Determine affected data types (PII, PHI, SSN, financial account information) and affected individual count
Assess notification obligations under applicable state breach notification laws and GLBA Safeguards Rule
Prepare regulatory notification to state insurance departments and Attorney General offices within required deadlines
Coordinate individual notification letters with identity protection services enrollment as required
Notify affected policyholders, agents, and employees per applicable state law timelines
Document breach investigation, notification decisions, and evidence of timely filing
Prepare post-incident remediation plan addressing root cause and control gaps
Report breach metrics and remediation status to board Audit Committee and CISO

subProcesses.name: Vendor Privacy & Data Processing Governance
steps: Maintain inventory of third-party data processors handling ABC Insurance personal information
Conduct privacy and security due diligence on new vendors before contract execution
Negotiate and execute data processing agreements (DPAs) and BAAs where applicable
Review vendor privacy and security controls against ABC Insurance vendor risk standards
Monitor vendor compliance with contractual data handling requirements annually
Require vendor notification of sub-processor changes and security incidents per DPA terms
Conduct periodic reassessment of high-risk vendor data processing relationships
Manage vendor data deletion and return obligations upon contract termination
Maintain DPA register with renewal dates and applicable data transfer mechanisms
Escalate material vendor privacy failures to CISO, Legal, and Procurement leadership

subProcesses.name: Privacy Governance & Regulatory Reporting
steps: Maintain enterprise privacy program governance structure including Privacy Officer role
Conduct annual privacy program assessment against NIST Privacy Framework or ISO 29100
Update privacy notices (website, policy documents, mobile app) for regulatory or operational changes
Prepare annual privacy report for board Audit Committee covering DSAR volume, breaches, and program maturity
Respond to state insurance department privacy regulation inquiries and examination requests
Manage opt-out and consent preference records across marketing and data sharing programs
Maintain records of processing activities (RoPA) as required by applicable privacy law
Coordinate with Compliance on GLBA Annual Privacy Notice issuance requirements
Track emerging state privacy legislation and assess impact on ABC Insurance data practices
File required privacy-related regulatory reports (FTC Safeguards Rule certifications, state-specific filings)

subProcesses.name: Governance Policy & Charter Management
steps: Maintain master inventory of governance policies, board charters, and committee terms of reference

Draft proposed revisions to governance policies and committee charters
Route proposed revisions through Legal, Compliance, and executive review before board submission
Present policy revisions to Board or committee for approval and record vote in minutes
Publish approved governance documents on internal governance portal
Ensure governance documents reflect current NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure requirements
Maintain delegation of authority matrix and update for organizational changes
Track and implement NAIC model act adoption requirements for governance disclosures
Archive superseded governance documents per records retention schedule

subProcesses.name: Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure & Regulatory Filing
steps: Prepare NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure (CGAD) for each domiciliary jurisdiction
Compile board and committee composition, independence, and skills data for CGAD narrative
Document executive compensation governance, including clawback and risk-adjustment policies
Describe risk oversight framework, ERM integration, and audit committee oversight in CGAD
Obtain General Counsel or Chief Compliance Officer certification of CGAD accuracy
File CGAD with domiciliary insurance department by June 1 statutory deadline
Respond to regulatory examiner questions arising from CGAD review
Prepare related governance sections of Annual Statement (Schedule Y — organizational chart)
Maintain Schedule Y subsidiary/affiliate data and file updates with state regulators
Track CGAD confidentiality status and manage public disclosure requests per state law

subProcesses.name: Executive & Director Compensation Governance
steps: Support Compensation Committee annual review of executive compensation philosophy and peer benchmarking
Prepare Compensation Committee materials: CEO and NEO pay proposals, tally sheets, risk assessments

Maintain director fee and equity award records and coordinate payment with Finance and HR

Maintain related-party transaction register for Audit Committee review

subProcesses.name: Shareholder & Parent Company Relations

Draft and file upstream extraordinary dividends notices with domiciliary insurance departments
Manage capital contributions and surplus note issuances including regulatory filings
Prepare intercompany agreements and loans for board and regulatory approval

subProcesses.name: Enterprise Risk Oversight & Governance Reporting

subProcesses.name: Legal Entity Governance Standards

subProcesses.name: Board Meeting Planning & Logistics

subProcesses.name: Legal Entity Administration & Maintenance

Maintain entity qualification records and foreign corporation certificates in entity database

subProcesses.name: Affiliated Transaction & Holding Company Act Compliance

subProcesses.name: Intellectual Property Management

subProcesses.name: Enterprise Strategy Alignment & Target-State Definition

subProcesses.name: Market Opportunity & Problem Definition
steps: Initiate market scan and gather competitive intelligence across target lines of business

subProcesses.name: Stakeholder Engagement & Voice-of-Customer Research

Incorporate feedback into updated product concept brief ahead of design phase
Maintain customer research repository and link findings to corresponding product decisions

subProcesses.name: Product Innovation & Concept Screening

Assess technology and operational readiness required to support the proposed product concept
Perform competitive benchmarking to evaluate differentiation and pricing positioning

Assign concept to product development squad and set milestone schedule for next stage

subProcesses.name: Business Case Development & Investment Approval
steps: Develop Business Case document covering market size, premium projections, loss ratio, and expense assumptions

Quantify required investment in systems configuration, regulatory filings, and operational setup
Obtain actuarial sign-off on pricing assumptions and loss development factors used in the business case
Calculate expected return on investment and payback period against internal hurdle rates
Validate funding availability with Finance and confirm alignment with annual operating plan
Present business case to Investment Review Board for capital allocation approval
Incorporate board feedback and resubmit if additional analysis is required
Record approval decision and funding allocation in project register
Communicate approval to product owner and initiate formal product development workstream

subProcesses.name: Product Roadmap Planning & Prioritization
steps: Consolidate approved product concepts and in-flight initiatives into a unified product roadmap

Identify dependencies between product launches and IT, Operations, and Distribution readiness
Publish roadmap to executive dashboard and share with divisional leads for alignment
Conduct quarterly roadmap reviews to reprioritize based on performance data and market shifts
Manage roadmap change requests through defined intake and approval process
Track roadmap adherence metrics and report variance to Product Governance Committee
Archive superseded roadmap versions with change rationale for audit trail

subProcesses.name: Coverage & Terms Design
steps: Confirm opportunity scope by finalizing covered perils, exclusions, and target customer segments
Design insuring agreements, policy conditions, and coverage definitions aligned to approved product concept
Draft endorsements, extensions, and optional coverage modules consistent with the core policy structure
Define deductible structures, sub-limits, and coinsurance provisions in line with actuarial guidance
Draft eligibility criteria and risk classification tiers for the new product
Review coverage language with Legal and Compliance for regulatory conformance and plain-language standards
Conduct coverage peer review with senior underwriters across affected lines of business
Incorporate Legal, Compliance, and underwriting feedback into revised coverage design
Obtain Chief Underwriting Officer sign-off on final coverage terms
Publish finalized coverage design package to product repository for use in form and rate development

subProcesses.name: Underwriting Guidelines Design
steps: Define submission requirements and risk information standards for the new product
Develop underwriting appetite rules specifying eligible risk characteristics and mandatory declination criteria
Establish authority levels and referral thresholds for underwriters by risk size and complexity
Design risk classification tiers and map characteristics to coverage terms and rate factors
Draft pricing guidance and schedule rating parameters for underwriter discretion
Define coinsurance, reinsurance retention guidance, and facultative referral triggers within guidelines
Conduct underwriting guidelines peer review with senior underwriters and line leadership
Incorporate feedback and obtain Chief Underwriting Officer approval of final guidelines
Publish approved underwriting guidelines to the underwriting knowledge base and training library
Establish periodic guidelines review cycle and assign owner for ongoing maintenance

subProcesses.name: Actuarial Rating Methodology Development
steps: Develop Rating Methodology defining rating variables, base rates, and relativities for the product
Source credible loss data from internal experience, ISO, NCCI, and reinsurer benchmarks
Build classification plan mapping risk characteristics to rating tiers and premium factors
Develop minimum premium schedules and expense loadings consistent with target loss ratio
Construct rate adequacy analysis demonstrating actuarial support for indicated rates
Develop & Certify Product Illustrations showing sample premium calculations across risk profiles
Obtain Appointed Actuary certification of rate filing support package
Coordinate with Pricing Analytics to configure rating engine rules and rate tables
Perform parallel-testing of new rates against historical book to validate relativities
Document rating methodology in state-specific actuarial memoranda for regulatory submission

subProcesses.name: Policy Form Drafting & Filing Preparation
steps: Draft Forms & Filings including policy jacket, declarations page, coverage forms, and all endorsements
Align form language with approved coverage terms and underwriting guidelines
Conduct internal Legal review for ambiguity, misrepresentation risk, and compliance with state statutes
Perform readability review and apply plain-language revisions to consumer-facing forms
Prepare state-specific form variations to accommodate jurisdictional requirements and mandatory provisions
Assemble filing package including actuarial memorandum, rate support exhibits, and form exhibits
Complete SERFF (System for Electronic Rate and Form Filings) entry for each target state
Submit Regulatory Filings to state departments of insurance and track submission confirmation
Respond to DOI objections and information requests within required timeframes
Obtain approved and certified form sets and archive in compliance repository by state and effective date

subProcesses.name: Regulatory Approval Management & State Licensing
steps: Maintain state-by-state filing tracker showing submission date, status, and anticipated approval date
Assign filing counsel or regulatory affairs lead for each priority state submission
Monitor DOI dockets for comparable competitor filings and precedent decisions
Prepare and submit responses to DOI questions within statutory response windows
Negotiate with DOI staff on objected provisions and document agreed modifications
Escalate high-priority or politically sensitive filing issues to Chief Compliance Officer
Record approval orders and deemed-approved statuses by state in the regulatory filing database
Coordinate with Compliance to update state availability matrix upon each approval
Notify Distribution and Operations of approved states and effective dates for launch readiness
Archive all correspondence, approval orders, and certified form sets by state for examination readiness

subProcesses.name: Product Configuration & System Readiness
steps: Define Requirements for policy administration system configuration including coverage codes, rating tables, and form assignments
Develop Approach for configuration by mapping product specifications to system data model
Coordinate with IT Product Configuration team to build rate tables and coverage rules in the policy system
Validate & Review configured product against design specifications using structured test scripts
Perform user acceptance testing with underwriting and operations representatives
Identify and resolve defects through structured defect log and retesting cycle
Obtain Business Sign-Off confirming configuration matches approved coverage terms and rates
Approve & Publish product configuration to production environment following change-control approval
Train underwriting, customer service, and billing staff on new product features and system workflows
Confirm operational readiness across all supporting functions before new business effective date

subProcesses.name: Product Launch & Go-to-Market Execution
steps: Develop go-to-market plan covering launch states, distribution channels, and phased rollout schedule
Produce product training materials, sales guides, and underwriting quick-reference cards for distribution partners
Brief appointed agents, brokers, and wholesale partners on product features, appetite, and submission process
Coordinate marketing communications including product announcements, web content, and collateral
Confirm quoting and binding capability in all relevant distribution systems and portals
Execute soft launch in initial states and monitor early submission quality and loss patterns
Capture launch-week issues through rapid-feedback loop with underwriting, operations, and IT support
Escalate critical launch defects to PMO for immediate remediation tracking
Communicate full launch readiness to senior leadership and transition product to in-force management team
Document lessons learned from launch execution and incorporate into product launch playbook

subProcesses.name: Demand Shaping & Initiative Intake
steps: Initiate & Capture demand by operating a structured intake portal for project and initiative requests from all divisions
Collect intake submissions including business sponsor, problem statement, expected benefits, and rough cost estimate
Analyze & Assess each intake request for strategic alignment, regulatory necessity, and business value
Classify demand by type (regulatory mandate, strategic initiative, operational improvement, product enabler)
Conduct preliminary sizing with Finance and Technology to estimate effort and cost range
Score intake items against weighted prioritization criteria approved by the Investment Review Board
Facilitate quarterly demand review sessions with divisional sponsors and portfolio leadership
Execute & Process approved demand into the active project pipeline with assigned resources
Validate & Control pipeline capacity by matching approved demand against available delivery bandwidth
Finalize & Handoff confirmed initiatives to Program Delivery with charter and sponsor commitment documented

subProcesses.name: Investment Prioritization & Funding
steps: Maintain portfolio register capturing all active, pipeline, and on-hold initiatives with key attributes
Apply strategic scoring model to rank portfolio items by value, urgency, and risk
Facilitate trade-off workshops when competing priorities exceed available funding or capacity
Model portfolio scenarios showing cost, benefit, and delivery-timeline implications of alternative investment mixes
Assess total cost of ownership including capital expenditure, operating expenditure, and ongoing run costs for each candidate
Conduct benefit-cost analysis and calculate NPV, IRR, and payback period against internal hurdle rates
Present prioritized portfolio and funding recommendation to Executive Portfolio Committee for ratification
Facilitate capital allocation review with CFO, CTO, and divisional CEOs and document decisions
Process final capital allocation decisions into approved project budgets and spending authority matrix
Communicate priority and funding decisions to all affected sponsors and delivery teams

subProcesses.name: Capacity Planning & Resource Allocation
steps: Maintain a rolling 12-month capacity plan covering PMO, product, and business-change resources
Assess resource demand from the approved portfolio and identify utilization gaps or overloads
Classify resource needs by skill type (project management, business analysis, product management, change management)
Work with HR and functional leaders to confirm available FTE and contractor capacity by quarter
Allocate named resources to approved projects and record assignments in resource management tool
Identify resource conflicts and facilitate trade-off conversations with sponsoring executives
Manage on-boarding of contract and contingent resources to meet surge demand
Monitor actual utilization against plan and reforecast capacity monthly
Escalate persistent capacity shortfalls to Portfolio Committee for make-or-buy decision
Report resource utilization trends and cost-per-project-type metrics to PMO leadership quarterly

subProcesses.name: Portfolio Performance Monitoring & Reporting
steps: Define portfolio health metrics including schedule adherence, budget variance, and benefits realization rate
Collect status reports from all active project managers on a weekly basis
Aggregate project data into portfolio-level dashboard covering cost, schedule, scope, and risk
Identify portfolio-level patterns including systemic schedule slippage, recurring scope creep, or funding pressure
Facilitate monthly portfolio review with PMO leadership and divisional sponsors
Produce monthly Portfolio Status Report for the Executive Leadership Team
Track escalated risks and issues at portfolio level and confirm accountability for resolution
Report regulatory-mandated projects separately with compliance deadline adherence highlighted
Present quarterly portfolio health scorecard to Board Risk & Audit Committee as required
Maintain historical portfolio performance data for benchmarking and continuous improvement analysis

subProcesses.name: Portfolio Governance & Committee Operations
steps: Establish and maintain portfolio governance framework including committee terms of reference and decision rights
Schedule and prepare agendas for Investment Review Board, Portfolio Committee, and Executive Portfolio Reviews
Produce pre-read packs including portfolio dashboard, escalation log, and decision papers
Facilitate governance meetings and capture decisions, actions, and rationale in meeting minutes
Track action items from governance forums and follow up on outstanding items before next meeting
Manage governance escalation process for projects requiring executive intervention
Review and update governance framework annually to reflect changes in organizational structure or risk appetite
Ensure governance records are maintained and accessible for internal audit and regulatory examination
Train project sponsors and managers on governance process and gate-review requirements
Report governance compliance metrics (stage-gate adherence, documentation completeness) to PMO leadership

subProcesses.name: In-Year Budget Reallocation & Financial Control
steps: Monitor approved project budgets against spend actuals through monthly financial reviews
Identify variances between actual spend and approved budgets and investigate root causes
Manage in-year budget reallocation requests resulting from scope changes, initiative cancellations, or new priorities
Process budget change requests through the Investment Review Board for material scope or cost changes
Maintain contingency reserve management log and document drawdowns with justification
Reconcile portfolio-level expenditure with Finance cost codes and cost centres monthly
Forecast portfolio cost-at-completion and update full-year spend projection each month
Report portfolio spend variance and cost efficiency metrics to the CFO and Investment Review Board
Manage release of unspent approved budgets at year-end in accordance with Finance close procedures
Produce annual portfolio financial reconciliation and archive for audit and regulatory review

subProcesses.name: Project Initiation & Charter Development
steps: Receive approved initiative from portfolio intake and assign experienced project manager
Conduct project kick-off workshop with sponsor, key stakeholders, and delivery team
Define project objectives, success criteria, and measurable outcomes aligned to the business case
Document project scope boundaries and explicitly list out-of-scope items to prevent creep
Identify key stakeholders and complete a stakeholder power-interest map
Assess project complexity, risk profile, and delivery methodology (waterfall, agile, hybrid)
Develop Project Charter and obtain sponsor sign-off before proceeding to planning
Register the project in the PPM (Project & Portfolio Management) tool with all baseline attributes
Confirm resource commitments with functional managers and record in project charter
Brief steering committee on charter contents and governance cadence for the project lifecycle

subProcesses.name: Project Planning & Schedule Management
steps: Decompose project scope into a detailed work breakdown structure with deliverable-level tasks
Estimate effort and duration for each task using historical data and expert judgment
Sequence tasks and identify critical path, near-critical paths, and schedule float
Develop resource-loaded project schedule and reconcile against confirmed resource availability
Define project milestones and align to portfolio governance stage gates
Identify external dependencies and agree handshake dates with supplier and partner teams
Obtain steering committee approval of baseline project schedule before execution begins
Publish approved schedule in PPM tool and distribute to all project team members
Establish weekly schedule update cadence with task owners and define variance thresholds for escalation
Maintain schedule change log and rebaseline schedule through formal change control when scope changes

subProcesses.name: Project Budget & Cost Control
steps: Develop detailed project budget from approved business case and confirmed resource plan
Establish cost breakdown structure aligned to work breakdown structure for accurate tracking
Obtain Finance sign-off on project budget and confirm cost codes for expenditure capture
Process purchase orders and vendor contracts through procurement within project budget authority
Track actuals against budget monthly using Finance system data and project manager inputs
Forecast cost-at-completion each month and report variance against approved budget
Manage contingency reserve through formal change control and document drawdowns with justification
Identify cost overrun risk early and present remediation options to steering committee
Process budget change requests through the Investment Review Board for material scope or cost changes
Produce final cost reconciliation report at project close and archive with project completion record

subProcesses.name: Risk & Issue Management
steps: Establish project risk register at initiation and conduct structured risk identification workshop
Assess each risk for probability, impact, and proximity using the enterprise risk scoring matrix
Assign risk owners and develop specific mitigation, transfer, or acceptance response plans
Monitor risk triggers weekly and update likelihood and impact ratings as the project progresses
Log project issues as they arise and classify by severity and business impact
Assign issue owners and agree resolution actions with target dates for each open issue
Escalate risks or issues exceeding project-level thresholds to steering committee within 24 hours
Track escalated risks and issues through resolution and record outcome in risk register
Report risk and issue status at each steering committee meeting with trend analysis
Conduct risk retrospective at project close and incorporate lessons into enterprise risk playbook

subProcesses.name: Dependency Management
steps: Maintain a dependency log capturing all cross-project and cross-function dependencies for the delivery
Facilitate weekly dependency review with PMO and affected project managers to track status
Resolve dependency conflicts through structured negotiation and escalate unresolved conflicts to portfolio level
Manage third-party vendor and partner dependencies including contractual milestone tracking
Coordinate business subject matter expert availability across competing project demands
Identify new dependencies arising during execution and add them to the dependency log promptly
Communicate dependency status and risk to project managers and steering committee at each review
Track and resolve blockers preventing team progress and report removal of blockers in weekly stand-ups
Produce dependency heat-map showing cross-project exposure and present to Portfolio Committee monthly
Archive dependency log at project close and incorporate dependency lessons into PMO delivery guidance

subProcesses.name: Stakeholder Management
steps: Maintain stakeholder engagement log and confirm key decisions are signed off by accountable parties
Facilitate steering committee meetings and prepare briefing packs, status summaries, and decision papers
Manage upward stakeholder communication including executive briefings and board-level updates
Coordinate cross-divisional business readiness activities (training, process change, communications) before go-live
Assess stakeholder sentiment at each project phase and adjust engagement approach as required
Manage conflicting stakeholder priorities through structured facilitation and escalation to sponsor
Confirm that all project decisions have documented sign-off from the accountable stakeholder
Brief new stakeholders joining the project on scope, status, risks, and governance arrangements
Produce stakeholder communication updates at key project milestones and distribute to the engagement log audience
Archive stakeholder engagement records at project close for audit and lessons-learned reference

subProcesses.name: Stage-Gate Review & Delivery Governance
steps: Define stage-gate criteria and deliverable checklists for each phase of the project lifecycle
Prepare gate-review pack including schedule status, budget position, risk profile, and outstanding issues
Conduct formal stage-gate review with PMO and sponsoring executive before phase transition
Assess readiness against gate criteria and document pass, conditional pass, or hold decision
Track conditions placed on conditional-pass decisions and confirm resolution before next gate
Maintain gate review log as part of the project's audit record
Escalate gate-hold situations to Portfolio Committee with recommended resolution path
Confirm that all stage-gate deliverables meet quality standards before advancing
Brief steering committee on gate outcome and next-phase mobilization plan
Archive gate review documentation in the project repository for post-delivery audit

subProcesses.name: Project Closure & Lessons Learned
steps: Confirm all project deliverables are accepted by the business sponsor against defined acceptance criteria
Ensure all contractual obligations to vendors and partners are completed and invoices cleared
Transition ongoing support and run responsibilities to business operations or IT operations teams
Complete financial close by reconciling final spend against budget and releasing unused contingency
Obtain formal project sign-off from sponsor and notify Portfolio Management of project completion
Conduct structured lessons-learned workshop with project team and key stakeholders
Document lessons learned in the enterprise knowledge base categorized by theme and project type
Archive all project documentation, contracts, and governance records in the project repository
Update the benefits register with baseline metrics for post-implementation benefits tracking
Produce final Project Completion Report for the PMO dashboard and Investment Review Board

subProcesses.name: Agile Delivery Framework & Standards
steps: Define and maintain the enterprise agile delivery framework (Scrum, SAFe, or hybrid) for business change programmes
Publish agile delivery standards including sprint cadence, definition of done, and ceremony norms
Provide coaching and facilitation support to business-side product owners and delivery squads
Establish agile maturity assessment criteria and evaluate team adherence quarterly
Develop and maintain a library of agile templates including backlog formats, sprint review agendas, and retrospective guides
Coordinate with IT Agile Centre of Excellence to ensure alignment on shared delivery practices
Manage the onboarding of new squads to the agile framework including training and tooling setup
Facilitate scaled agile ceremonies (PI Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt) for large programmes
Track team velocity trends and identify squads requiring additional PMO coaching
Report agile adoption metrics and delivery throughput to PMO leadership quarterly

subProcesses.name: Product Backlog Management & Sprint Planning
steps: Facilitate backlog grooming sessions with business product owners and subject-matter experts to refine user stories
Ensure user stories are written to agreed standards with clear acceptance criteria and business value articulation
Prioritize product backlog in collaboration with business sponsor using MoSCoW or WSJF scoring
Coordinate sprint planning ceremonies to confirm team capacity and sprint commitment
Validate that sprint goals are aligned to programme milestone commitments and portfolio priorities
Manage backlog dependencies with other squads and flag cross-team blockers to the Release Train Engineer
Track sprint progress daily through stand-ups and update the backlog tool (Jira or equivalent)
Facilitate sprint review with business stakeholders and capture feedback for backlog refinement
Conduct sprint retrospective and implement at least one agreed process improvement per sprint
Publish sprint velocity, burn-down, and backlog health metrics to PMO dashboard after each sprint

subProcesses.name: Business Acceptance Testing Coordination
steps: Define business acceptance testing (BAT) scope, entry criteria, and exit criteria for each release
Develop BAT test plan covering business scenarios, edge cases, and regulatory requirements
Recruit and brief business testers from underwriting, claims, operations, and compliance functions
Prepare test data sets representing realistic policyholder, claim, and billing scenarios
Facilitate BAT execution and provide triage support for defects raised by business testers
Log and prioritize defects in the defect management tool with business impact classification
Track defect resolution by IT and retest fixed defects within agreed turnaround times
Produce daily BAT status reports showing pass rates, open defects, and risk-to-release-date
Facilitate go/no-go decision meeting with business sponsor on BAT completion and residual defect risk
Archive BAT results, defect log, and sign-off documentation for regulatory and audit purposes

subProcesses.name: Business Readiness Planning
steps: Identify business readiness criteria that must be met before each release can go live
Coordinate business process documentation updates and system user guide revisions ahead of release
Plan and schedule business user training sessions aligned to release timeline
Assess readiness of operations, underwriting, claims, and distribution leads against each criterion
Track business readiness completion status and report weekly to project sponsor and release manager
Identify readiness gaps and develop remediation plans with accountable business owners
Confirm that all impacted staff have completed required training before the release go-live date
Conduct release readiness review with Operations, Underwriting, Claims, and Distribution leads
Obtain business go/no-go sign-off confirming operational readiness for each planned release
Archive business readiness evidence pack including sign-offs and training completion records

subProcesses.name: Release Planning & Communication
steps: Develop release plan covering release scope, included features, excluded items, and delivery timeline
Confirm release scope with business product owner and sponsors and document agreed boundaries
Prepare release communication plan covering impacted staff, agents, and customers
Draft and review all release communications including go-live notifications and post-release summaries
Coordinate business communications with Marketing, HR, and Distribution on impacted audiences
Support post-release hypercare period by coordinating rapid resolution of business-impacting issues
Capture user feedback in the first week post-release and triage issues to the appropriate support team
Conduct release retrospective and update business readiness checklist for future releases
Report release outcomes including defects discovered post-go-live to steering committee
Archive release plan, communications, and retrospective outputs in the project repository

subProcesses.name: Release Calendar & Deployment Coordination
steps: Maintain the enterprise release calendar coordinating business, IT, and infrastructure release windows
Review proposed release dates for conflicts with financial close, regulatory reporting, or peak business periods
Coordinate freeze periods and blackout windows with IT operations and business operations teams
Manage release scheduling decisions through the Change Advisory Board with business PMO representation
Track deployment activities on release day and maintain a release status log for business stakeholders
Coordinate business user communications on release day including go-live confirmation messages
Manage rollback decision process if critical issues emerge during deployment, engaging business sponsor
Monitor post-deployment business metrics for 48 hours and confirm normal operating performance
Debrief with IT and business teams within one week of each major release
Update the release calendar and lessons-learned log after each deployment cycle

subProcesses.name: Continuous Improvement & Agile Retrospective Management
steps: Facilitate structured retrospectives at squad, programme, and portfolio levels on a regular cadence
Capture improvement actions with owners and target dates using a standardised retrospective tool
Track completion of retrospective actions and report impediments preventing improvement
Aggregate improvement themes across squads to identify systemic delivery issues for PMO intervention
Benchmark delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, defect escape rate) against industry agile benchmarks
Publish quarterly continuous improvement report showing improvement actions completed and outcomes
Share high-impact improvement practices across squads through communities of practice
Escalate systemic blockers to PMO leadership and Portfolio Committee for structural resolution
Incorporate improvement outcomes into the agile delivery framework standards update cycle
Recognise and reward high-performing squads through PMO delivery excellence programme

subProcesses.name: Change Impact Assessment & Readiness Planning
steps: Receive confirmed project scope and assess scale of business change across impacted divisions and roles
Conduct change impact assessment workshop with process owners to map current-state vs. future-state impacts
Quantify impact by function, geography, and role using a structured impact heat-map
Assess organisational change capacity and current change load on impacted teams
Identify high-risk change impacts requiring targeted interventions (job redesign, policy revision, retraining)
Develop change readiness baseline assessment using staff survey or structured interviews
Produce Change Impact Report and share with project sponsor and steering committee
Develop organisational change management plan covering strategy, milestones, and resource requirements
Obtain sponsor endorsement of change management plan before execution phase begins
Establish change management workstream within the project with named change lead and agreed budget

subProcesses.name: Stakeholder Engagement & Communications Planning
steps: Develop stakeholder map covering all groups impacted by or influential to the change
Assess each stakeholder group's current awareness, desire, knowledge, ability, and reinforcement (ADKAR)
Define targeted engagement strategy for each stakeholder tier from Board to front-line staff
Develop change communications plan covering key messages, channels, timing, and responsible senders
Draft all change communications including emails, town hall presentations, and FAQ documents
Facilitate leadership alignment sessions to ensure consistent messaging from senior sponsors
Execute communications according to plan and track delivery and open-rate metrics
Capture and respond to stakeholder questions and concerns through defined feedback channels
Adjust communications approach based on feedback and changing stakeholder sentiment
Archive communications artefacts and engagement records for audit and knowledge management

subProcesses.name: Training Design & Delivery
steps: Conduct training needs analysis identifying skill and knowledge gaps created by the change
Design training curriculum covering new processes, system features, and role-specific workflows
Develop training materials including e-learning modules, instructor-led session guides, and job aids
Coordinate with subject-matter experts to validate training content accuracy before delivery
Schedule training sessions aligned to go-live timeline and ensure adequate coverage across all impacted roles
Deliver training through appropriate modalities (classroom, virtual, on-the-job coaching) by role
Track training completion rates and identify non-compliant staff for remediation outreach
Assess training effectiveness through knowledge checks, simulation, or structured observation
Provide refresher training or targeted coaching for teams showing low post-go-live proficiency
Archive training materials and completion records in the LMS for compliance and audit

subProcesses.name: Resistance Management & Sponsor Activation
steps: Identify early resistance signals through stakeholder sentiment monitoring and manager feedback
Diagnose root causes of resistance (awareness, desire, knowledge, confidence, reinforcement gaps)
Develop targeted resistance management interventions tailored to each resistance profile
Engage line managers as change agents and provide them with coaching conversation guides
Activate executive sponsors to deliver visible, consistent, and accountable change leadership
Facilitate one-on-one coaching for leaders who are themselves ambivalent about the change
Monitor resistance trends throughout the project and adjust interventions based on outcomes
Escalate persistent high-impact resistance to steering committee with recommended executive action
Celebrate early adopters and change champions to build positive social proof
Document resistance management interventions and outcomes in change management record

subProcesses.name: Go-Live Readiness Assessment
steps: Conduct pre-go-live readiness assessment covering training completion, process sign-off, and support model readiness
Verify that all business readiness criteria defined in the readiness plan have been met
Brief all supervisors and team leaders on go-live day procedures and escalation paths
Confirm readiness of the dedicated support model including floor-walkers, rapid-response help-desk, and triage process
Produce and distribute go-live day runbook to all operational teams and support staff
Obtain formal go-live sign-off from business sponsor confirming readiness to proceed
Communicate go-live confirmation to all impacted staff, agents, and relevant third parties
Establish monitoring cadence for operational performance metrics from go-live day onward
Confirm escalation contacts and response commitments are in place across IT, operations, and change teams
Archive go-live readiness assessment evidence for project record and regulatory compliance

subProcesses.name: Hypercare Management
steps: Activate hypercare support model on go-live day including floor-walkers, rapid-response help-desk, and issue triage process
Operate a daily hypercare stand-up to triage issues and coordinate rapid resolution
Capture go-live issues and classify by business impact and urgency for prioritised remediation
Communicate resolution status to impacted staff through consistent and timely updates
Assess user adoption metrics (system log-ins, process compliance, error rates) throughout hypercare
Escalate unresolved high-impact issues to project sponsor and IT leadership for executive intervention
Monitor operational performance metrics across the first two weeks post-launch and compare to baseline
Adjust staffing levels of floor-walkers and help-desk based on issue volume trends during hypercare
Transition from hypercare to steady-state support when adoption metrics meet defined thresholds
Produce Go-Live & Hypercare Completion Report for the project sponsor and PMO dashboard

subProcesses.name: Adoption Measurement & Sustainability
steps: Define adoption KPIs covering behavioural, process compliance, and system usage dimensions
Establish baseline adoption metrics at go-live and set 30-, 60-, and 90-day targets
Collect adoption data through system analytics, manager observation, and structured pulse surveys
Analyse adoption trends and identify business units or roles falling below target thresholds
Design targeted reinforcement interventions for underperforming groups (coaching, refresher training, recognition)
Engage line management in reinforcing new behaviours through performance conversations and team briefings
Track adoption improvement against targets and report monthly to the project sponsor
Formally declare change adoption success when sustained performance meets or exceeds targets
Embed new ways of working into job descriptions, performance objectives, and standard operating procedures
Archive adoption measurement records and produce Adoption Completion Report for benefits tracking

subProcesses.name: Benefits Identification & Business Case Validation
steps: Work with sponsoring business unit to identify and articulate all expected benefits at project initiation
Categorize benefits by type (financial, operational efficiency, risk reduction, customer experience, compliance)
Quantify financial benefits with Finance using agreed assumptions and confirm non-financial benefits with owners
Map each benefit to the specific project deliverable or capability change that will enable it
Validate benefit assumptions against historical data from comparable past initiatives
Confirm the benefits register is consistent with the approved investment business case
Obtain business case endorsement from the Benefits Owner and Chief Financial Officer
Register all benefits in the enterprise benefits management repository with baseline values and targets
Brief project manager and change lead on benefits register to ensure delivery alignment
Include benefits register as a standing agenda item in steering committee reviews throughout delivery

subProcesses.name: Benefits Dependency Mapping
steps: Capture expected benefits for each approved initiative in a benefits register at intake
Map benefit dependencies to specific business capabilities, products, or process changes required for realization
Assign a benefits owner from the sponsoring business unit for each benefit line
Identify enabling conditions and intermediate outcomes that must occur before each benefit can be realized
Document dependency chain from project output through to measurable business outcome for each benefit
Assess risks to the dependency chain including adoption shortfalls, market changes, and operational constraints
Review dependency map with project sponsor and delivery lead to confirm completeness and accuracy
Incorporate dependency map into the project risk register and flag dependency risks for tracking
Update dependency map at each stage-gate review to reflect scope changes or delivery adjustments
Archive finalized dependency map in the benefits management repository at project handover

subProcesses.name: Benefits Baseline & Measurement Framework
steps: Gather Evidence by establishing baseline performance data for each benefit metric before go-live
Define data sources, measurement methodology, and reporting frequency for every benefit line
Agree benefit measurement accountabilities with business unit owners outside the project team
Design benefits measurement dashboard to track progress toward targets post-delivery
Confirm that required data feeds and reporting infrastructure are available for ongoing measurement
Set interim benefit milestones at 3-month, 6-month, and 12-month post-go-live intervals
Validate baseline data quality and resolve gaps or inconsistencies before go-live
Publish baseline metrics report and confirm with Finance that financial baseline is accepted
Brief Benefits Owner on measurement process and reporting responsibilities at project handover
Archive baseline dataset in the benefits management repository as the reference point for realization tracking

subProcesses.name: Post-Implementation Benefits Tracking
steps: Track Benefits Realization Against Business Cases at scheduled 3-, 6-, and 12-month review points
Collect benefit actuals from data owners and cross-check against benefit measurement framework
Calculate benefit realization rate (actual versus projected) for each benefit line
Analyse drivers of variance between realized and projected benefits using root-cause analysis
Identify corrective actions required to recover benefits that are below trajectory
Engage Benefits Owner and business sponsor in agreeing remediation actions for under-realized benefits
Report benefits realization status to Investment Review Board at each quarterly portfolio review
Escalate material benefit shortfalls to Executive Leadership Team for strategic response
Adjust future benefit projections when structural changes in the business environment affect achievability
Maintain cumulative benefits realization record for each initiative in the enterprise benefits repository

subProcesses.name: Benefits Realization Reporting
steps: Consolidate benefit actuals from all active and recently completed initiatives into a portfolio-level benefits report
Calculate aggregate benefits delivered against total portfolio investment to derive portfolio-level ROI
Produce monthly benefits tracking summary for the PMO dashboard and distribute to portfolio sponsors
Prepare quarterly Benefits Realization Report for the Investment Review Board with trend analysis
Highlight initiatives where benefit realization is significantly ahead of or behind business case projections
Include benefits realization metrics in executive portfolio governance packs at each reporting cycle
Compare realized benefits against approved business cases and report cumulative variance to date
Coordinate with Finance to reconcile financial benefits realized with general ledger cost-saving records
Publish annual Benefits Realization Report to Investment Review Board and archive for audit
Provide summary benefits performance data to the Chief Financial Officer for annual operating plan review

subProcesses.name: Benefits Realization Review & Closure
steps: Conduct formal benefits realization review at the 12-month post-go-live checkpoint for each initiative
Assess whether all benefit lines have been fully realized, partially realized, or require extended tracking
Obtain sign-off from Benefits Owner and business sponsor on final realization status for each benefit
Document reasons for any shortfall in benefit realization and record agreed remediation or acceptance
Confirm that financial benefits have been validated by Finance and reflected in business unit budgets
Formally close the benefits tracking file for initiatives that have met all realization targets
Retain extended benefits tracking for initiatives where realization is ongoing beyond the 12-month window
Capture benefits realization lessons and submit to the enterprise knowledge base categorized by benefit type
Produce Benefits Realization Closure Report for the PMO archive and Investment Review Board record
Update the portfolio benefits register to reflect closed and ongoing benefit tracking status for each initiative

subProcesses.name: Executive Portfolio Governance & Performance Review
steps: Plan & Scope the governance calendar for quarterly Executive Portfolio Reviews and Investment Review Board sessions
Gather Evidence by consolidating portfolio performance data, benefits realization status, and risk register updates
Prepare executive briefing packs with portfolio dashboard, escalation log, and investment performance analysis
Assess & Test portfolio health against strategic objectives and delivery commitments using balanced scorecard
Facilitate Executive Portfolio Review meeting and capture decisions and action items
